import uuid

from django.contrib.auth.base_user import AbstractBaseUser
from django.contrib.postgres.fields import ArrayField
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.db.models.expressions import RawSQL
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.accounts.managers import UserManager


class Users(AbstractBaseUser):
    class AccountStatus(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = 'active', 'Active'
        BLOCKED = 'blocked', 'Blocked'
        CLOSED = 'closed', 'Closed'

    class BloodType(models.TextChoices):
        A_POS = 'A+', 'A+'
        A_NEG = 'A-', 'A-'
        B_POS = 'B+', 'B+'
        B_NEG = 'B-', 'B-'
        AB_POS = 'AB+', 'AB+'
        AB_NEG = 'AB-', 'AB-'
        O_POS = 'O+', 'O+'
        O_NEG = 'O-', 'O-'
        UNKNOWN = 'unknown', 'Unknown'

    class VerificationStatus(models.TextChoices):
        NONE = 'none', 'None'
        PENDING = 'pending', 'Pending'
        VERIFIED = 'verified', 'Verified'
        REJECTED = 'rejected', 'Rejected'

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    uuid = models.UUIDField(unique=True, editable=False, db_default=RawSQL('uuidv7()', []))
    phone_hash = models.CharField(unique=True, max_length=128)
    phone_enc = models.TextField()
    password = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)
    last_login = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)
    display_name = models.CharField(max_length=150)

    is_admin = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_staff = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_superuser = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    account_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=AccountStatus.choices,
        default=AccountStatus.ACTIVE,
    )
    blocked_until = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)

    preferred_language = models.CharField(max_length=35, default="en")
    home_area = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)

    emergency_contact_name = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)
    emergency_contact_phone_enc = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)

    blood_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=10,
        choices=BloodType.choices,
        default=BloodType.UNKNOWN,
    )
    is_willing_to_donate = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_willing_to_donate_blood = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_willing_to_donate_items = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    physical_ok = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    good_eyesight = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    needs_glasses = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    can_lift_heavy = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    can_work_outdoor = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    has_leader_experience = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    new_to_volunteer = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    skills = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=50), default=list, blank=True)

    needs_meal_support = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    needs_travel_support = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    accepts_unpaid = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    verification_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=VerificationStatus.choices,
        default=VerificationStatus.NONE,
    )

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)

    objects = UserManager()

    USERNAME_FIELD = "phone_hash"
    REQUIRED_FIELDS = ["display_name"]

    class Meta:
        managed = False
        db_table = "users"

    def has_perm(self, perm, obj=None):
        return self.is_superuser or self.is_admin

    def has_module_perms(self, app_label):
        return self.is_superuser or self.is_admin


class AuthOtp(models.Model):
    class Purpose(models.TextChoices):
        LOGIN = 'login', 'Login'
        QR_REGISTRATION = 'qr_registration', 'QR Registration'

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    phone_hash = models.TextField()
    code_hash = models.TextField()
    purpose = models.CharField(
        max_length=30,
        choices=Purpose.choices,
        default=Purpose.LOGIN,
    )
    attempt_count = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    expires_at = models.DateTimeField()
    consumed_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)

    class Meta:
        managed = False
        db_table = "auth_otp"


class AuthOtpChallenge(models.Model):
    class Purpose(models.TextChoices):
        LOGIN = 'login', 'Login'
        QR_REGISTRATION = 'qr_registration', 'QR Registration'

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    otp = models.ForeignKey(
        'AuthOtp',
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='challenges',
        db_column='otp_id',
    )
    challenge_token_hash = models.TextField(unique=True)
    purpose = models.CharField(
        max_length=30,
        choices=Purpose.choices,
        default=Purpose.LOGIN,
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    expires_at = models.DateTimeField()
    consumed_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)
    request_id = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)
    identity_nonce_hash = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True, unique=True)

    class Meta:
        managed = False
        db_table = "auth_otp_challenge"

        MOCK_SELFIE = 'mock_selfie', 'Mock Selfie'

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = 'pending', 'Pending'
        APPROVED = 'approved', 'Approved'
        REJECTED = 'rejected', 'Rejected'

    class ComparisonStatus(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = 'pending', 'Pending'
        MATCH = 'match', 'Match'
        NO_MATCH = 'no_match', 'No Match'
        NEEDS_REVIEW = 'needs_review', 'Needs Review'

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    user = models.ForeignKey("accounts.Users", models.PROTECT, related_name="verification_images")
    image_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=30,
        choices=ImageType.choices,
    )
    image_path = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    file_format = models.CharField(max_length=10, default="jpeg")
    file_sha256 = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, null=True)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=Status.choices,
        default=Status.PENDING,
    )
    comparison_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=ComparisonStatus.choices,
        default=ComparisonStatus.PENDING,
    )
    comparison_score = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=4, blank=True, null=True)
    is_current = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    reviewed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Users",
        models.PROTECT,
        related_name="userverificationimages_reviewed_by_set",
        blank=True,
        null=True,
    )
    reviewed_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)
    note = models.TextField(blank=True, null=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)

    class Meta:
        managed = False
        db_table = "user_verification_images"
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["user", "image_type"],
                condition=Q(is_current=True),
                name="uq_current_verification_image",
            )
        ]

"""
DRF BFF Tests for Tokenized Authentication, Legacy Compatibility & Compact Bootstrap
File: backend/apps/accounts/tests/test_bff_auth_tokenized.py

Covers Phase 3 Tickets AUTH-02, AUTH-03, ATT-01, API-01:
- POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/ (public, returns challenge token & delivery metadata)
- POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/ (public, accepts token + code only, returns DRF token)
- Error mapping to stable HTTP statuses & machine-readable codes
- Legacy auth deprecation Warning header (299)
- GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/ (minimal query count, email is explicit null, decrypted phone, capabilities)
"""

import secrets
from django.db import connection
from django.test import TestCase, override_settings
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from apps.accounts.models import Users
from apps.coordination.models import CoordinatorProfiles
from common.security import (
    compute_phone_hash,
    encrypt_phone,
    normalize_phone,
)
from services import auth_service, coordinator_service


def _unique_phone() -> str:
    return f"+959{secrets.randbelow(100000000):08d}"


class BffAuthTokenizedTests(TestCase):
    """Integration tests for tokenized auth BFF endpoints and /me/bootstrap/."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.client = APIClient()

    # --- Tokenized OTP Request Endpoint ---

    def test_tokenized_otp_request_endpoint_success(self):
        """POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/ issues auth_session_token and truthful delivery metadata."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone, "purpose": "login"},
                format="json",
            )
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["status"], "dev_code_available")
        self.assertIn("auth_session_token", res.data)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["expires_in"], 180)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["code_length"], 6)
        self.assertIn("dev_code", res.data)
        self.assertEqual(len(res.data["dev_code"]), 6)

        delivery = res.data["delivery"]
        self.assertFalse(delivery["delivered"])
        self.assertFalse(delivery["configured"])

    def test_tokenized_otp_request_suppresses_dev_code_in_production(self):
        """dev_code is strictly excluded when ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE is False."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=False, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=False, ENVIRONMENT="production"):
            res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone},
                format="json",
            )
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res.data)
        self.assertIn("auth_session_token", res.data)

    def test_tokenized_otp_request_idempotency_with_request_id(self):
        """Repeating request with identical request_id returns the same active challenge."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        req_id = "req-test-uuid-12345"
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            res1 = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone, "request_id": req_id},
                format="json",
            )
            res2 = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone, "request_id": req_id},
                format="json",
            )
        self.assertEqual(res1.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(res2.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(res1.data["auth_session_token"], res2.data["auth_session_token"])

    # --- Tokenized OTP Verify Endpoint ---

    def test_tokenized_otp_verify_success_without_phone(self):
        """POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/ accepts token + code only (NO phone) and returns DRF Token."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            req_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone},
                format="json",
            )
            session_token = req_res.data["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res.data["dev_code"]

            verify_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/",
                {
                    "auth_session_token": session_token,
                    "code": dev_code,
                    "display_name": "Test Verified User",
                },
                format="json",
            )

        self.assertEqual(verify_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertIn("token", verify_res.data)
        self.assertIn("user", verify_res.data)
        user_data = verify_res.data["user"]
        self.assertEqual(user_data["display_name"], "Test Verified User")
        self.assertIn("id", user_data)
        self.assertIn("uuid", user_data)
        self.assertEqual(user_data["verification_status"], "none")

    def test_tokenized_otp_verify_invalid_code_error_mapping(self):
        """Wrong code returns HTTP 400 with machine-readable error code 'invalid_code'."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            req_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone},
                format="json",
            )
            session_token = req_res.data["auth_session_token"]

            verify_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/",
                {
                    "auth_session_token": session_token,
                    "code": "000000",
                },
                format="json",
            )
        self.assertEqual(verify_res.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(verify_res.data.get("error", {}).get("code"), "invalid_code")

    def test_tokenized_otp_verify_invalid_challenge_error_mapping(self):
        """Bogus challenge token returns HTTP 400 with code 'invalid_challenge' (Section 4.3)."""
        verify_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/",
            {
                "auth_session_token": "nonexistent-challenge-token-that-cannot-exist-12345678",
                "code": "123456",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(verify_res.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(verify_res.data.get("error", {}).get("code"), "invalid_challenge")

    def test_tokenized_otp_verify_replay_fails_with_challenge_consumed(self):
        """Replaying a verified challenge token returns HTTP 409 'challenge_consumed'."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            req_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/",
                {"phone": phone},
                format="json",
            )
            session_token = req_res.data["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res.data["dev_code"]

            v1 = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/",
                {"auth_session_token": session_token, "code": dev_code},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(v1.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)

            # Replay
            v2 = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/",
                {"auth_session_token": session_token, "code": dev_code},
                format="json",
            )
        self.assertEqual(v2.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(v2.data.get("error", {}).get("code"), "challenge_consumed")

    # --- Legacy Deprecation Headers ---

    def test_legacy_auth_routes_emit_deprecation_warning(self):
        """Legacy /api/v1/auth/otp/request/ and /api/v1/auth/otp/verify/ include HTTP Warning header."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        req_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/auth/otp/request/",
            {"phone": phone},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(req_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertIn("Warning", req_res.headers)
        self.assertIn("299", req_res.headers["Warning"])
        self.assertIn("Deprecated", req_res.headers["Warning"])

        code = req_res.data.get("dev_code")
        if code:
            verify_res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/auth/otp/verify/",
                {"phone": phone, "code": code},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(verify_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
            self.assertIn("Warning", verify_res.headers)
            self.assertIn("299", verify_res.headers["Warning"])

    # --- Compact Session Bootstrap (/api/v1/me/bootstrap/) ---

    def test_me_bootstrap_unauthenticated_returns_401(self):
        """Unauthenticated call to /api/v1/me/bootstrap/ returns 401."""
        res = self.client.get("/api/v1/me/bootstrap/")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

    def test_me_bootstrap_returns_compact_identity_and_null_email(self):
        """
        Authenticated volunteer user bootstrap returns:
        - user: id, uuid, display_name, phone (decrypted), email: null (never phone fallback)
        - coordinator: status: 'none', can_access_workspace: False
        - capabilities: volunteer: True, coordinator: False
        """
        raw_phone = _unique_phone()
        ph = normalize_phone(raw_phone)
        user = Users.objects.create(
            phone_hash=compute_phone_hash(ph),
            phone_enc=encrypt_phone(ph),
            display_name="Bootstrap Volunteer",
            account_status="active",
            verification_status="none",
        )
        token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=user)

        self.client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Token {token.key}")

"""
PostgreSQL Database Invariant & Concurrency Tests for OTP Challenge (v0.12.0)
File: backend/apps/accounts/tests/test_otp_challenge_invariants.py

Covers Phase 1 Tickets AUTH-01 and AUTH-04:
- Unique challenge hash constraint
- Exact otp_id foreign key binding
- Challenge expiry cap (<= auth_otp.expires_at)
- Single-use consumption & second-use rejection
- Failed-attempt counter increments on exact bound auth_otp row
- Attempt limit exhaustion ('too_many_attempts')
- Concurrent / parallel verify race safety (strictly one succeeds)
- Independence: newer OTP requests cannot satisfy older challenges
- Purpose mismatch rejection
- Dual expiry clock enforcement (challenge clock & OTP clock)
- Preservation of existing phone-based OTP request rate limit trigger
- Key separation validation & token helpers
"""

import threading
from datetime import timedelta
import secrets

from django.db import connection, connections, IntegrityError, DatabaseError
from django.test import TransactionTestCase
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.accounts.models import AuthOtp, AuthOtpChallenge, Users
from common.security import (
    compute_challenge_token_hash,
    compute_otp_hash,
    compute_phone_hash,
    generate_challenge_token,
    generate_otp_code,
    normalize_phone,
    validate_key_separation,
)


def _unique_phone() -> str:
    return f"+959{secrets.randbelow(100000000):08d}"


class OtpChallengeDatabaseInvariantTests(TransactionTestCase):
    """
    Direct database tests against PostgreSQL enforcing database-first invariants.
    Uses TransactionTestCase to enable true concurrent thread execution and row locking.
    """

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.phone = _unique_phone()
        self.phone_hash = compute_phone_hash(normalize_phone(self.phone))
        self.code = "123456"
        self.code_hash = compute_otp_hash(self.code)

    def _create_otp(self, code: str = None, purpose: str = "login", ttl_minutes: int = 5) -> int:
        c_hash = compute_otp_hash(code) if code else self.code_hash
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO auth_otp (phone_hash, code_hash, purpose, expires_at)
                VALUES (%s, %s, %s, now() + make_interval(mins => %s))
                RETURNING id
                """,
                [self.phone_hash, c_hash, purpose, ttl_minutes],
            )
            return cursor.fetchone()[0]

    def _create_challenge(
        self,
        otp_id: int,
        token: str = None,
        ttl_seconds: int = 180,
        purpose: str = "login",
        request_id: str = None,
        nonce_hash: str = None,
    ) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
        raw_token = token or generate_challenge_token()
        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token)
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                SELECT create_otp_challenge(%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
                """,
                [otp_id, token_hash, ttl_seconds, purpose, request_id, nonce_hash],
            )
            challenge_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        return challenge_id, raw_token, token_hash

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Unique Challenge Hash Constraint
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_unique_challenge_hash_enforced(self):
        """Inserting two challenge rows with identical token hashes must violate uniqueness."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp()
        raw_token = generate_challenge_token()
        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token)

        # First insert succeeds
        self._create_challenge(otp_id, token=raw_token)

        # Second insert with identical token_hash must fail
        with self.assertRaises((IntegrityError, DatabaseError)):
            with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                cursor.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO auth_otp_challenge (otp_id, challenge_token_hash, purpose, expires_at)
                    VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() + INTERVAL '180 seconds')
                    """,
                    [otp_id, token_hash],
                )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Exact otp_id Foreign Key Binding
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_exact_otp_id_foreign_key_binding(self):
        """Challenge row referencing a non-existent auth_otp.id must be rejected."""
        fake_otp_id = 999999999
        raw_token = generate_challenge_token()
        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token)

        with self.assertRaises((IntegrityError, DatabaseError)):
            with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                cursor.execute(
                    """
                    SELECT create_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 180, 'login', NULL, NULL)
                    """,
                    [fake_otp_id, token_hash],
                )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Expiry Cap (challenge.expires_at <= otp.expires_at)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_expiry_cap_cannot_exceed_parent_otp_expiry(self):
        """Database trigger trg_01_auth_otp_challenge_guard blocks challenge outliving parent OTP."""
        # Create OTP expiring in 60 seconds
        otp_id = self._create_otp(ttl_minutes=1)
        raw_token = generate_challenge_token()
        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token)

        # Attempt to insert challenge expiring in 120 seconds directly
        with self.assertRaises(DatabaseError) as ctx:
            with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                cursor.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO auth_otp_challenge (otp_id, challenge_token_hash, purpose, expires_at)
                    VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() + INTERVAL '120 seconds')
                    """,
                    [otp_id, token_hash],
                )
        self.assertIn("challenge_expiry_exceeds_otp", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_create_otp_challenge_helper_caps_ttl_at_180s(self):
        """create_otp_challenge caps requested TTL to 180 seconds and parent OTP expiry."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp(ttl_minutes=10)
        # Request 600s TTL; helper must cap at 180s
        chal_id, _, _ = self._create_challenge(otp_id, ttl_seconds=600)

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                SELECT expires_at - created_at FROM auth_otp_challenge WHERE id = %s
                """,
                [chal_id],
            )
            diff = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            # Difference should be exactly 180 seconds (+/- 1s execution jitter)
            self.assertLessEqual(diff.total_seconds(), 181)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(diff.total_seconds(), 179)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Single-Use Consumption & Second-Use Rejection
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_single_use_consumption_and_second_use_rejection(self):
        """verify_otp_challenge succeeds once, consumes both rows, and rejects a second verify."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="654321")
        _, _, token_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id)
        valid_code_hash = compute_otp_hash("654321")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            # First verification -> 'ok'
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status, phone_hash, otp_id FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash, valid_code_hash],
            )
            row1 = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(row1[0], "ok")
            self.assertEqual(row1[1], self.phone_hash)
            self.assertEqual(row1[2], otp_id)

            # Confirm rows are marked consumed in DB
            cursor.execute("SELECT consumed_at FROM auth_otp_challenge WHERE challenge_token_hash = %s", [token_hash])
            chal_consumed = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            self.assertIsNotNone(chal_consumed)

            cursor.execute("SELECT consumed_at FROM auth_otp WHERE id = %s", [otp_id])
            otp_consumed = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            self.assertIsNotNone(otp_consumed)

            # Second verification -> 'challenge_consumed'
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status, phone_hash, otp_id FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash, valid_code_hash],
            )
            row2 = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(row2[0], "challenge_consumed")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Failed Attempt Counter Increments on Exact Bound auth_otp Row
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_wrong_code_increments_failed_attempts_on_exact_otp_row(self):
        """Calling verify_otp_challenge with wrong code increments attempt_count and does NOT consume."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="111111")
        _, _, token_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id)
        wrong_code_hash = compute_otp_hash("999999")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status, phone_hash, otp_id FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash, wrong_code_hash],
            )
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(row[0], "invalid_code")

            # Check auth_otp attempt count incremented to 1
            cursor.execute("SELECT attempt_count, consumed_at FROM auth_otp WHERE id = %s", [otp_id])
            otp_attempts, otp_consumed = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(otp_attempts, 1)
            self.assertIsNone(otp_consumed)

            # Check challenge is still unconsumed
            cursor.execute("SELECT consumed_at FROM auth_otp_challenge WHERE challenge_token_hash = %s", [token_hash])
            chal_consumed = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            self.assertIsNone(chal_consumed)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Max Attempt Limit Exhaustion ('too_many_attempts')
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_max_attempts_exceeded_rejects_subsequent_verifications(self):
        """After reaching setting_int('otp_max_attempts') (5), verify_otp_challenge returns 'too_many_attempts'."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="222222")
        _, _, token_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id)
        wrong_hash = compute_otp_hash("000000")
        correct_hash = compute_otp_hash("222222")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            # 5 failed attempts
            for _ in range(5):
                cursor.execute(
                    "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                    [token_hash, wrong_hash],
                )
                self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "invalid_code")

            # 6th attempt (even with correct code) must fail with 'too_many_attempts'
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash, correct_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "too_many_attempts")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Concurrent Parallel Verify Race Safety
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_concurrent_parallel_verify_race_safety(self):
        """
        Two parallel threads executing verify_otp_challenge for the same challenge.
        Deterministic FOR UPDATE locking ensures strictly ONE succeeds with 'ok'
        and the other receives 'challenge_consumed'.
        """
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="333333")
        _, _, token_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id)
        valid_code_hash = compute_otp_hash("333333")

        results = []
        barrier = threading.Barrier(2)

        def worker(thread_idx: int):
            # Close existing connection to ensure worker gets an independent DB connection
            connections.close_all()
            barrier.wait()
            with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                cursor.execute(
                    "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                    [token_hash, valid_code_hash],
                )
                status = cursor.fetchone()[0]
                results.append((thread_idx, status))

        t1 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(1,))
        t2 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(2,))

        t1.start()
        t2.start()
        t1.join()
        t2.join()

        # Consolidate statuses
        statuses = [r[1] for r in results]
        self.assertEqual(len(statuses), 2)
        self.assertEqual(statuses.count("ok"), 1, f"Expected exactly one 'ok', got {statuses}")
        self.assertEqual(statuses.count("challenge_consumed"), 1, f"Expected one 'challenge_consumed', got {statuses}")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Independence: Newer OTP Requests Cannot Satisfy Older Challenges
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_newer_otp_request_cannot_satisfy_older_challenge(self):
        """Code from OTP-2 cannot be used to verify Challenge-1 (bound to OTP-1)."""
        otp_1 = self._create_otp(code="111111")
        _, _, token_hash_1 = self._create_challenge(otp_1)

        otp_2 = self._create_otp(code="222222")
        _, _, token_hash_2 = self._create_challenge(otp_2)

        code_2_hash = compute_otp_hash("222222")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            # Using OTP-2's code against Challenge-1 must fail
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash_1, code_2_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "invalid_code")

            # Using OTP-2's code against Challenge-2 succeeds
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [token_hash_2, code_2_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "ok")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Purpose Mismatch Rejection
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_purpose_mismatch_rejection(self):
        """Trigger prevents mismatched purpose insert, and verify rejects mismatched purpose query."""
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="444444", purpose="login")
        chal_id, _, token_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id, purpose="login")
        valid_code_hash = compute_otp_hash("444444")

        # 1. Calling verify_otp_challenge with wrong purpose ('qr_registration')
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:

                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'qr_registration')",
                [token_hash, valid_code_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "invalid_challenge")

        # 2. Trigger blocks creating challenge with purpose mismatched from parent OTP
        raw_token2 = generate_challenge_token()
        token_hash2 = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token2)
        with self.assertRaises(DatabaseError) as ctx:

                    VALUES (%s, %s, 'qr_registration', now() + INTERVAL '180 seconds')
                    """,

                )
        self.assertIn("purpose_mismatch", str(ctx.exception))

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Dual Expiry Clock Enforcement
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_both_expiry_clocks_enforced(self):
        """If either the challenge expires OR the parent OTP expires, challenge_expired is returned."""
        # Case A: Challenge expired, but OTP still valid
        otp_id = self._create_otp(code="555555", ttl_minutes=10)
        _, _, chal_hash = self._create_challenge(otp_id)
        code_hash = compute_otp_hash("555555")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            # Shift created_at back so expires_at > created_at check constraint is satisfied
            cursor.execute(
                """
                UPDATE auth_otp_challenge
                   SET created_at = now() - INTERVAL '200 seconds',
                       expires_at = now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
                 WHERE challenge_token_hash = %s
                """,
                [chal_hash],
            )
            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [chal_hash, code_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "challenge_expired")

        # Case B: Parent OTP expired in the past
        phone2 = _unique_phone()
        p_hash2 = compute_phone_hash(normalize_phone(phone2))
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO auth_otp (phone_hash, code_hash, purpose, created_at, expires_at)
                VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() - INTERVAL '120 seconds', now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds')
                RETURNING id, expires_at
                """,
                [p_hash2, code_hash],
            )
            otp_id2, otp_expires_at = cursor.fetchone()

            raw_token3 = generate_challenge_token()
            chal_hash3 = compute_challenge_token_hash(raw_token3)
            cursor.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO auth_otp_challenge (otp_id, challenge_token_hash, purpose, created_at, expires_at)
                VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() - INTERVAL '120 seconds', %s)
                """,
                [otp_id2, chal_hash3, otp_expires_at],
            )

            cursor.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM verify_otp_challenge(%s, %s, 'login')",
                [chal_hash3, code_hash],
            )
            self.assertEqual(cursor.fetchone()[0], "challenge_expired")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. Existing Phone Rate-Limit Trigger Preserved
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_existing_phone_rate_limit_trigger_preserved(self):
        """Database trigger trg_01_otp_rate_limit on auth_otp continues to cap requests at 5/hour."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        p_hash = compute_phone_hash(normalize_phone(phone))
        c_hash = compute_otp_hash("999999")

        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            # 5 inserts allowed
            for _ in range(5):
                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO auth_otp (phone_hash, code_hash, purpose, expires_at) VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() + INTERVAL '5 minutes')",
                    [p_hash, c_hash],
                )

            # 6th insert triggers trg_01_otp_rate_limit exception
            with self.assertRaises(DatabaseError) as ctx:
                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO auth_otp (phone_hash, code_hash, purpose, expires_at) VALUES (%s, %s, 'login', now() + INTERVAL '5 minutes')",
                    [p_hash, c_hash],
                )
            self.assertIn("otp_rate_limited", str(ctx.exception))

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 12. Key Separation & Token Helpers
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_key_separation_and_token_helpers(self):
        """Verify token generation entropy, HMAC hashing, and key separation validation."""
        validate_key_separation()  # Must not raise under configured settings

        token1 = generate_challenge_token()
        token2 = generate_challenge_token()
        self.assertNotEqual(token1, token2)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(token1), 40)

        hash1 = compute_challenge_token_hash(token1)
        hash2 = compute_challenge_token_hash(token1)
        self.assertEqual(hash1, hash2)
        self.assertEqual(len(hash1), 64)

        code_hash = compute_otp_hash("123456")
        self.assertEqual(len(code_hash), 64)
        # Verify code hash using OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET differs from challenge hash using AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET
        self.assertNotEqual(hash1, code_hash)

"""

Covers all 16 acceptance test requirements:

11. Skill management (normalization of skills)
12. Availability rule creation (weekly rules set and atomic replacement)

14. Availability checking (delegation to PostgreSQL is_user_available)

def _unique_phone() -> str:

    digits = f"{secrets.randbelow(100000000):08d}"
    return f"+959{digits}"


def _make_user(phone: str = None, name: str = "Test User", **kwargs) -> Users:
    """Helper to create a user with proper phone hashing and encryption."""
    raw_phone = phone or _unique_phone()
    normalized = normalize_phone(raw_phone)
    return Users.objects.create(
        phone_hash=compute_phone_hash(normalized),
        phone_enc=encrypt_phone(normalized),
        display_name=name,
        **kwargs,
    )

class OtpRequestTests(TestCase):
    def test_otp_request_returns_sent(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        result = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "sent")
        self.assertIn("delivery", result)

    def test_otp_request_masks_code_in_production(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=False):
            result = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            self.assertNotIn("dev_code", result)

    def test_otp_request_exposes_code_in_debug(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True):
            result = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            self.assertIn("dev_code", result)

    def test_otp_request_api_endpoint(self):

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["status"], "sent")


# =============================================================================
# 2. OTP EXPIRATION TESTS
# =============================================================================

class OtpExpirationTests(TestCase):
    def test_expired_otp_returns_expired(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True):
            req = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            code = req["dev_code"]

        # Manually expire the OTP in the database (keeping expires_at > created_at)
        p_hash = compute_phone_hash(normalize_phone(phone))
        past = django_tz.now() - timedelta(minutes=10)
        AuthOtp.objects.filter(phone_hash=p_hash).update(
            created_at=past,
            expires_at=past + timedelta(minutes=5),
        )

        result = auth_service.verify_login_otp(phone, code)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(result["result"], "expired")

        # Test via API
        client = APIClient()
        response = client.post("/api/v1/auth/otp/verify/", {"phone": phone, "code": code})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["error"]["code"], "expired")

# 3. OTP ATTEMPT LIMITS TESTS
# =============================================================================

class OtpAttemptLimitTests(TestCase):
    def test_attempt_limit_exceeded_returns_too_many_attempts(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True):
            req = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            code = req["dev_code"]

        # 5 wrong attempts (default otp_max_attempts is 5)
        for _ in range(5):
            res = auth_service.verify_login_otp(phone, "9999")
            self.assertFalse(res["ok"])

        # Even correct code fails now with too_many_attempts
        result = auth_service.verify_login_otp(phone, code)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(result["result"], "too_many_attempts")

        # API returns 429
        client = APIClient()
        response = client.post("/api/v1/auth/otp/verify/", {"phone": phone, "code": code})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["error"]["code"], "too_many_attempts")

            auth_service.verify_login_otp(phone, code)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "account_blocked")

# 9. PROFILE UPDATE TESTS
# =============================================================================

class ProfileUpdateTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = _make_user(name="Profile User")
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)

    def test_update_profile_valid_fields(self):
        updated = profile_service.update_user_profile(
            self.user,
            {"display_name": "Updated Name", "blood_type": "O+", "can_lift_heavy": True},
        )
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.user.display_name, "Updated Name")
        self.assertEqual(self.user.blood_type, "O+")
        self.assertTrue(self.user.can_lift_heavy)

    def test_update_profile_api_patch(self):
        response = self.client.patch("/api/v1/me/", {"display_name": "Patched Name", "home_area": "Downtown"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["display_name"], "Patched Name")
        self.assertEqual(response.data["home_area"], "Downtown")

    def test_update_profile_rejects_privileged_fields(self):
        # Service level
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            profile_service.update_user_profile(self.user, {"is_admin": True})
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "field_not_allowed")

        # API level (via serializer validation)
        response = self.client.patch("/api/v1/me/", {"is_admin": True})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

    def test_update_profile_rejects_unknown_fields(self):
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            profile_service.update_user_profile(self.user, {"unrecognized_field": "val"})
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "field_not_allowed")

        response = self.client.patch("/api/v1/me/", {"unrecognized_field": "val"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

    def test_emergency_contact_pairing_constraint(self):
        # Name without phone must fail
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            profile_service.update_user_profile(self.user, {"emergency_contact_name": "Mom"})
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "emergency_contact_mismatch")

        # Both name and phone must succeed
        profile_service.update_user_profile(
            self.user,
            {"emergency_contact_name": "Mom", "emergency_contact_phone": "+959111222333"},
        )
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.user.emergency_contact_name, "Mom")
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.user.emergency_contact_phone_enc)

        # Clearing name clears phone
        profile_service.update_user_profile(self.user, {"emergency_contact_name": ""})
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(self.user.emergency_contact_name)
        self.assertIsNone(self.user.emergency_contact_phone_enc)

        self.assertEqual(len(created_new), 1)
        self.assertEqual(VolunteerAvailabilityRules.objects.filter(user=self.user).count(), 1)

            ]

        self.assertEqual(len(res.data["rules"]), 1)

# 13. AVAILABILITY EXCEPTIONS TESTS
# =============================================================================

class AvailabilityExceptionsTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = _make_user(name="Exceptions User")
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)

    def test_upsert_and_delete_exception(self):
        # Create exception
        exc = availability_service.upsert_availability_exception(
            self.user.id,
            {"date": "2026-12-25", "is_available": False, "note": "Christmas holiday"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(exc["is_available"], False)
        self.assertEqual(exc["note"], "Christmas holiday")

        # Update same date (unique constraint upsert)
        exc_updated = availability_service.upsert_availability_exception(
            self.user.id,
            {"date": "2026-12-25", "is_available": True, "note": "Available now"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(exc_updated["id"], exc["id"])
        self.assertEqual(exc_updated["is_available"], True)
        self.assertEqual(VolunteerAvailabilityExceptions.objects.filter(user=self.user).count(), 1)

        # Delete exception
        availability_service.delete_availability_exception(self.user.id, exc["id"])
        self.assertEqual(VolunteerAvailabilityExceptions.objects.filter(user=self.user).count(), 0)

    def test_exceptions_api(self):
        res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/me/availability/exceptions/",
            {"date": "2026-11-20", "is_available": False, "note": "Out of town"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        exc_id = res.data["id"]

        del_res = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/me/availability/exceptions/{exc_id}/")
        self.assertEqual(del_res.status_code, status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

# 14. AVAILABILITY CHECKING TESTS (SQL is_user_available)
# =============================================================================

class AvailabilityCheckingTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = _make_user(name="Avail Check User")
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)

    def test_no_rules_means_available_by_default(self):
        start = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)  # Monday
        end = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 14, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        self.assertTrue(availability_service.check_user_availability(self.user.id, start, end))

    def test_recurring_rules_checking(self):
        # Set rule for Monday (weekday 1) from 09:00 to 17:00
        availability_service.set_weekly_availability_rules(
            self.user.id,
            [{"weekday": 1, "start_time": time(9, 0), "end_time": time(17, 0)}],
        )

        # Monday 10:00 - 12:00 -> within rule -> Available (True)
        mon_start = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        mon_end = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        self.assertTrue(availability_service.check_user_availability(self.user.id, mon_start, mon_end))

        # Tuesday (weekday 2) -> outside rule -> Not Available (False)
        tue_start = datetime(2026, 11, 17, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        tue_end = datetime(2026, 11, 17, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        self.assertFalse(availability_service.check_user_availability(self.user.id, tue_start, tue_end))

    def test_blackout_exception_overrides_rule(self):
        # Monday rule 09:00 - 17:00
        availability_service.set_weekly_availability_rules(
            self.user.id,
            [{"weekday": 1, "start_time": time(9, 0), "end_time": time(17, 0)}],
        )
        # Blackout on 2026-11-16 (Monday)
        availability_service.upsert_availability_exception(
            self.user.id,
            {"date": date(2026, 11, 16), "is_available": False, "note": "Sick day"},
        )

        mon_start = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        mon_end = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        self.assertFalse(availability_service.check_user_availability(self.user.id, mon_start, mon_end))

    def test_availability_check_api(self):
        payload = {
            "start_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z",
            "end_at": "2026-11-16T12:00:00Z",
        }
        res = self.client.post("/api/v1/me/availability/check/", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertIn("available", res.data)
        self.assertIn("schedule_conflict", res.data)

class UserToUserAccessRestrictionsTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user_a = _make_user(name="User A")
        self.user_b = _make_user(name="User B")
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user_a)

    def test_user_cannot_modify_other_user_profile(self):
        # A modifies self profile
        profile_service.update_user_profile(self.user_a, {"display_name": "A Updated"})
        self.user_b.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.user_b.display_name, "User B")

    def test_user_cannot_delete_other_user_exception(self):
        exc_b = availability_service.upsert_availability_exception(
            self.user_b.id,
            {"date": "2026-12-01", "is_available": False},
        )
        # User A attempts to delete User B's exception -> returns 404 masked
        res = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/me/availability/exceptions/{exc_b['id']}/")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        # Verify B's exception was not deleted
        self.assertEqual(
            VolunteerAvailabilityExceptions.objects.filter(id=exc_b["id"]).count(), 1
        )

# LOGOUT TEST
# =============================================================================

class LogoutTests(TestCase):
    def test_logout_invalidates_token(self):
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True):
            req = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            code = req["dev_code"]

        auth_res = auth_service.verify_login_otp(phone, code)
        token_key = auth_res["token"]
        user = auth_res["user"]

        client = APIClient()
        client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Token {token_key}")

        # Profile accessible
        res1 = client.get("/api/v1/me/")
        self.assertEqual(res1.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)

        # Logout
        logout_res = client.post("/api/v1/auth/logout/")
        self.assertEqual(logout_res.status_code, status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

        # Subsequent request with invalidated token fails
        res2 = client.get("/api/v1/me/")
        self.assertEqual(res2.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

"""
Unit and Integration Tests for Tokenized Auth Service & Safe Dev-Code Guard (Phase 2A)
File: backend/apps/accounts/tests/test_tokenized_auth_service.py

Covers Phase 2 Tickets AUTH-02 and AUTH-03:
- 6-digit OTP generation and tokenized challenge issuance
- Truthful ConsoleOtpDeliveryAdapter reporting (never claims SMS delivered)
- dev_code gating: strictly suppressed in production even if DEBUG=True
- Full verification lifecycle using only auth_session_token + code
- Request-ID idempotency (reissuing active challenge without rate-limit burn)
- Stable DomainError translations (invalid_challenge, invalid_code, challenge_expired,
  challenge_consumed, otp_rate_limited, account_blocked, account_closed)
- Failed attempt persistence on wrong code
- Sensitive-field redaction for phone, OTP, challenge token, and DRF token
- Legacy request_login_otp and verify_login_otp backward compatibility

import secrets

    compute_challenge_token_hash,

def _unique_phone() -> str:
    return f"+959{secrets.randbelow(100000000):08d}"


class TokenizedAuthServiceTests(TestCase):
    """Integration tests for tokenized auth challenge service against PostgreSQL."""

    def test_tokenized_otp_request_dev_code_available_when_flag_enabled(self):
        """When local dev/test flag is enabled, response includes dev_code and truthful delivery."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="development"):
            res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)

        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "dev_code_available")
        self.assertIn("auth_session_token", res)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(res["auth_session_token"]), 40)
        self.assertEqual(res["expires_in"], 180)
        self.assertEqual(res["code_length"], 6)

        # Delivery metadata must be truthful: never claim SMS sent
        delivery = res["delivery"]
        self.assertFalse(delivery["delivered"])
        self.assertFalse(delivery["configured"])
        self.assertEqual(delivery["channel"], "console")
        self.assertEqual(delivery["provider"], "console")

        # dev_code must be 6 numeric digits
        self.assertIn("dev_code", res)
        self.assertEqual(len(res["dev_code"]), 6)
        self.assertTrue(res["dev_code"].isdigit())

    def test_tokenized_otp_request_dev_code_suppressed_when_flag_disabled(self):
        """When ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE is False, dev_code is omitted and status is console_simulated."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=False, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=False, ENVIRONMENT="staging"):
            res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)

        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "console_simulated")
        self.assertIn("auth_session_token", res)
        self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res)
        self.assertFalse(res["delivery"]["delivered"])

    def test_dev_code_strictly_suppressed_in_production_even_if_debug_true(self):
        """
        CRITICAL SAFETY TEST (AUTH-03):
        Assert dev_code is NEVER returned when production configuration is detected,
        even if DEBUG is misconfigured to True.
        """
        phone = _unique_phone()
        # Case A: ENVIRONMENT is set to 'production' with DEBUG=True
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="production"):
            res_tokenized = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res_tokenized)
            self.assertNotEqual(res_tokenized["status"], "dev_code_available")

            res_legacy = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone)
            self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res_legacy)

        # Case B: SETTINGS_MODULE contains 'production' with DEBUG=True
        phone2 = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(
            DEBUG=True,
            ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True,
            SETTINGS_MODULE="config.settings.production",
        ):
            res_tokenized2 = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone2)
            self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res_tokenized2)

            res_legacy2 = auth_service.request_login_otp(phone2)
            self.assertNotIn("dev_code", res_legacy2)

    def test_tokenized_otp_successful_verification_lifecycle(self):
        """Full successful handshake: request challenge -> verify with code -> DRF token issued."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            req_res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            auth_session_token = req_res["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res["dev_code"]

        # Client only sends auth_session_token + dev_code (NO phone number!)
        verify_res = auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(
            auth_session_token=auth_session_token,
            code=dev_code,
            display_name="Handshake Volunteer",
        )

        self.assertTrue(verify_res["ok"])
        self.assertIn("token", verify_res)
        user_dto = verify_res["user"]
        self.assertEqual(user_dto["display_name"], "Handshake Volunteer")

        # Confirm token exists in database
        token_obj = Token.objects.filter(key=verify_res["token"]).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(token_obj)
        self.assertEqual(token_obj.user_id, user_dto["id"])

    def test_request_id_idempotency_returns_active_challenge(self):
        """Retrying an in-flight request with the same request_id returns the existing challenge."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        req_id = f"client-req-{secrets.token_hex(8)}"

        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            res1 = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone, request_id=req_id)
            res2 = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone, request_id=req_id)

        self.assertEqual(res1["auth_session_token"], res2["auth_session_token"])
        self.assertTrue(res2.get("idempotent_reissue"))
        self.assertLessEqual(res2["expires_in"], 180)

    def test_invalid_challenge_token_raises_domain_error(self):
        """Unknown or malformed auth_session_token raises HTTP 400 invalid_challenge."""
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(
                auth_session_token="completely_unknown_token_value",
                code="123456",
            )
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_challenge")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 400)

    def test_invalid_code_raises_domain_error_and_increments_attempts(self):
        """Wrong code raises HTTP 400 invalid_code and increments attempt count on auth_otp row."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            req_res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            auth_session_token = req_res["auth_session_token"]

        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(
                auth_session_token=auth_session_token,
                code="000000",
            )
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_code")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 400)

        # Inspect DB: parent auth_otp attempt count must be 1
        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(auth_session_token)
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                SELECT o.attempt_count
                  FROM auth_otp o
                  JOIN auth_otp_challenge c ON c.otp_id = o.id
                 WHERE c.challenge_token_hash = %s
                """,
                [token_hash],
            )
            attempts = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(attempts, 1)

    def test_challenge_consumed_raises_409(self):
        """Second verification on the same challenge raises HTTP 409 challenge_consumed."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            req_res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            auth_session_token = req_res["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res["dev_code"]

        # First verify succeeds
        res1 = auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(auth_session_token, dev_code)
        self.assertTrue(res1["ok"])

        # Second verify raises 409 challenge_consumed
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(auth_session_token, dev_code)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "challenge_consumed")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 409)

    def test_challenge_expired_raises_domain_error(self):
        """Expired challenge raises HTTP 400 challenge_expired."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            req_res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            auth_session_token = req_res["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res["dev_code"]

        token_hash = compute_challenge_token_hash(auth_session_token)
        # Shift created_at and expires_at into the past
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute(
                """
                UPDATE auth_otp_challenge
                   SET created_at = now() - INTERVAL '200 seconds',
                       expires_at = now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
                 WHERE challenge_token_hash = %s
                """,
                [token_hash],
            )

        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(auth_session_token, dev_code)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "challenge_expired")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 400)

    def test_too_many_attempts_exhaustion_raises_429(self):
        """After 5 failed code attempts, verify raises HTTP 429 otp_rate_limited."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        with override_settings(DEBUG=True, ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE=True, ENVIRONMENT="test"):
            req_res = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
            auth_session_token = req_res["auth_session_token"]
            dev_code = req_res["dev_code"]

        for _ in range(5):
            with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
                auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(auth_session_token, "000000")
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_code")

        # 6th attempt (even with valid dev_code) must fail with 429 otp_rate_limited
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(auth_session_token, dev_code)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "otp_rate_limited")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 429)

    def test_account_closed_rejection(self):
        """Users with account_status='closed' are rejected on OTP request."""
        phone = _unique_phone()
        norm = normalize_phone(phone)
        p_hash = compute_phone_hash(norm)
        Users.objects.create(
            phone_hash=p_hash,
            phone_enc=encrypt_phone(norm),
            display_name="Closed User",
            account_status="closed",
            is_active=False,
        )

        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(phone)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "account_closed")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 403)

    def test_sensitive_field_redaction_keeps_secrets_out_of_logs(self):
        """redact_sensitive_data strips phone, raw OTP, challenge token, and DRF token."""
        payload = {
            "phone": "+95912345678",
            "raw_phone": "+95912345678",
            "phone_enc": "sensitive_enc",
            "phone_hash": "sensitive_hash",
            "otp": "123456",
            "code": "123456",
            "raw_code": "123456",
            "token": "drf_bearer_token_abc",
            "auth_session_token": "opaque_session_challenge_xyz",
            "safe_event_id": 42,
            "status": "ok",
        }
        redacted = redact_sensitive_data(payload)
        self.assertNotIn("phone", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("raw_phone", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("phone_enc", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("otp", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("code", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("token", redacted)
        self.assertNotIn("auth_session_token", redacted)
        self.assertEqual(redacted["safe_event_id"], 42)
        self.assertEqual(redacted["status"], "ok")

_api_phone_idx = 9000


def _api_phone():
    global _api_phone_idx
    _api_phone_idx += 1
    return f"+959{_api_phone_idx:08d}"


def _make_api_user(name, is_admin=False, verified=False):
    ph = normalize_phone(_api_phone())
    return Users.objects.create(
        phone_hash=compute_phone_hash(ph),
        phone_enc=encrypt_phone(ph),
        display_name=name,
        is_admin=is_admin,
        verification_status="verified" if verified else "none",
    )

    # --- Manual Check-In URL Parity & Canonical Authoritative Payload (ATT-01) ---

    def test_manual_checkin_canonical_and_aliased_authoritative_payload(self):
        vol_c = _make_api_user("Volunteer C")
        EventApplications.objects.create(
            event=self.event,
            user=vol_c,
            source="browse",
            conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(vol_c, self.event.id)

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.coord)

        # 1. Canonical route: POST /api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/
        res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/",
            {"event_id": self.event.id, "user_id": vol_c.id, "note": "Checked in via canonical route"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        # Assert full authoritative mutation response shape
        self.assertIn("attendance_id", res.data)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["event_id"], self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["user_id"], vol_c.id)
        self.assertEqual(res.data["status"], "checked_in")
        self.assertEqual(res.data["method"], "coordinator_manual")
        self.assertIsNotNone(res.data["checkin_at"])
        self.assertEqual(res.data["recorded_by_user_id"], self.coord.id)
        self.assertFalse(res.data["already_checked_in"])

        # 2. Idempotent repeat: same route returns already_checked_in=True
        repeat_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/",
            {"event_id": self.event.id, "user_id": vol_c.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(repeat_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertTrue(repeat_res.data["already_checked_in"])
        self.assertEqual(repeat_res.data["attendance_id"], res.data["attendance_id"])

        # 3. Flat compatibility alias: /api/v1/attendance/manual-checkin/
        vol_d = _make_api_user("Volunteer D")
        EventApplications.objects.create(
            event=self.event,
            user=vol_d,
            source="browse",
            conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(vol_d, self.event.id)
        alias_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/manual-checkin/",
            {"event_id": self.event.id, "user_id": vol_d.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(alias_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(alias_res.data["status"], "checked_in")
        self.assertFalse(alias_res.data["already_checked_in"])

        # 4. Event-scoped alias: /api/v1/events/{event_id}/check-in/
        vol_e = _make_api_user("Volunteer E")
        EventApplications.objects.create(
            event=self.event,
            user=vol_e,
            source="browse",
            conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(vol_e, self.event.id)
        scoped_res = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v1/events/{self.event.id}/check-in/",
            {"user_id": vol_e.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(scoped_res.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(scoped_res.data["status"], "checked_in")
        self.assertFalse(scoped_res.data["already_checked_in"])

    # --- Authorization & Owner-as-Monitor Mode (W51, W52) ---

    def test_owner_as_monitor_mode_blocks_mutations(self):
        # Event owner is owner_id, but current_coordinator_id is coord!
        # Owner in monitor mode must be blocked with HTTP 403 (owner_monitor_readonly)
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.owner)

        # Attempt to create QR token
        res_qr = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v1/coordinator/events/{self.event.id}/qr-tokens/",

            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res_qr.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        self.assertIn("owner_monitor_read_only", str(res_qr.data).lower())

        # Attempt manual checkin
        res_chk = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v1/events/{self.event.id}/check-in/",
            {"user_id": self.vol.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res_chk.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        self.assertIn("owner_monitor_read_only", str(res_chk.data).lower())

    # --- 404 Resource Masking ---

    def test_resource_masked_404_on_unauthorized_roster(self):
        # Third party coordinator requests attendance roster of this event
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.unauth_coord)

        res = self.client.get(f"/api/v1/coordinator/events/{self.event.id}/attendance/")
        # Must return 404 masking instead of 403
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        self.client.logout()
        res = self.client.get(f"/api/v1/events/{self.event.id}/onboarding/")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

from datetime import timedelta
