def _new_phone():
    return f"+959{secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000}"


def _make_usr(name, is_admin=False, verified=False):
    ph = normalize_phone(_new_phone())
    return Users.objects.create(
        phone_hash=compute_phone_hash(ph),
        phone_enc=encrypt_phone(ph),
        display_name=name,
        is_admin=is_admin,
        verification_status="verified" if verified else "none",
    )


def _setup_coordinator(admin, name="Lead Coordinator"):
    user = _make_usr(name, verified=True)
    coordinator_service.apply_for_coordinator(user, "Organization vetting")
    coordinator_service.approve_coordinator(admin, user.id, "Approved")
    user.refresh_from_db()
    return user


class Phase7ServicesIntegrationTests(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.admin = _make_usr("Admin User", is_admin=True)
        cls.coord = _setup_coordinator(cls.admin, "Lead Coord")
        cls.vol = _make_usr("Volunteer A")
        cls.vol_b = _make_usr("Volunteer B")

    def setUp(self):
        start = timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=2)
        end = start + timedelta(hours=4)
        self.event = Events.objects.create(
            owner_id=self.coord.id,
            current_coordinator_id=self.coord.id,
            title="Service Test Event",
            start_at=start,
            end_at=end,
            acceptance_mode="auto",
            auto_assign_enabled=True,
            require_onboarding_ack=True,
            onboarding_text="Please wear closed-toe shoes and bring hydration.",
            latitude=1.3521,
            longitude=103.8198,
            geo_radius_m=500,
            geo_checkin_enabled=True,
            require_checkin_confirmation=False,
        )
        self.post = EventPosts.objects.create(
            event=self.event,
            title="Greeter",
            required_headcount=10,
        )
        Events.objects.filter(id=self.event.id).update(status="published")
        Events.objects.filter(id=self.event.id).update(status="active")
        start_active = timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=10)
        Events.objects.filter(id=self.event.id).update(start_at=start_active)
        self.event.refresh_from_db()

        # Apply to event -> auto-accepted and assigned
        self.app = EventApplications.objects.create(
            event=self.event,
            user=self.vol,
            source="browse",
            conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
        )

    # --- Onboarding Service Tests ---

    def test_onboarding_service_lifecycle_and_status(self):
        # Initial status before acknowledgment
        status = onboarding_service.get_event_onboarding_status(self.vol, self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(status["event_id"], self.event.id)
        self.assertTrue(status["require_onboarding_ack"])
        self.assertFalse(status["acknowledged"])

        # Acknowledge
        ack = onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(ack.event_id, self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(ack.user_id, self.vol.id)

        # Re-fetch status
        status_after = onboarding_service.get_event_onboarding_status(self.vol, self.event.id)
        self.assertTrue(status_after["acknowledged"])

        # Idempotency
        ack2 = onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(ack.id, ack2.id)

    # --- QR Service Tests ---

    def test_qr_service_create_preview_redeem_and_revoke(self):
        # Create token
        token_data = qr_service.create_event_qr_token(
            self.coord,
            self.event.id,
            purpose="checkin",
            max_uses=2,
            ttl_minutes=60,
        )
        raw_token = token_data["raw_token"]
        self.assertIsNotNone(raw_token)
        qr_id = token_data["id"]

        # Preview token (consumes nothing)
        preview = qr_service.preview_qr_token(raw_token)
        self.assertTrue(preview["is_valid"])
        self.assertEqual(preview["event_id"], self.event.id)
        self.assertEqual(preview["purpose"], "checkin")

        # First volunteer acknowledges onboarding
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)

        # Redeem token for checkin
        redeem_result = qr_service.redeem_qr_token(self.vol, raw_token)
        self.assertEqual(redeem_result["result"], "checked_in")
        self.assertEqual(redeem_result["event_id"], self.event.id)

        # Check used count in DB
        qr_obj = QrTokens.objects.get(id=qr_id)
        self.assertEqual(qr_obj.used_count, 1)

        # Revoke token
        revoked = qr_service.revoke_event_qr_token(self.coord, qr_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(revoked.revoked_at)

        # Preview after revocation
        preview_revoked = qr_service.preview_qr_token(raw_token)
        self.assertFalse(preview_revoked["is_valid"])
        self.assertEqual(preview_revoked["reason"], "revoked")

    def test_qr_service_rollback_on_multi_step_join(self):
        # Create join_event token
        token_data = qr_service.create_event_qr_token(
            self.coord,
            self.event.id,
            purpose="join_event",
            max_uses=1,
            ttl_minutes=60,
        )
        raw_token = token_data["raw_token"]
        qr_id = token_data["id"]

        # Simulate exception during EventApplications.objects.create
        with patch("services.qr_service.EventApplications.objects.create", side_effect=RuntimeError("Simulated DB Crash")):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                qr_service.redeem_qr_token(self.vol_b, raw_token)

        # Verify transaction rolled back completely: used_count is still 0!
        qr_obj = QrTokens.objects.get(id=qr_id)
        self.assertEqual(qr_obj.used_count, 0)
        self.assertFalse(EventApplications.objects.filter(user=self.vol_b, event=self.event).exists())

    # --- Attendance Service Tests ---

    def test_manual_checkin_and_checkout_lifecycle(self):
        # Onboarding acknowledged first
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)

        # Manual check in by coordinator
        att = attendance_service.manual_check_in(
            self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id, note="Checked in by coordinator desk"
        )
        self.assertEqual(att.status, "checked_in")
        self.assertEqual(att.method, "coordinator_manual")
        self.assertEqual(att.recorded_by_user_id, self.coord.id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(att.checkin_at)

        # Check out by volunteer
        att_out = attendance_service.check_out(self.vol, att.id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(att_out.checkout_at)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(att_out.checkout_at, att.checkin_at)

        # Self-service history conceals T4 coordinates
        history = attendance_service.get_user_attendance_history(self.vol)
        self.assertEqual(len(history), 1)
        self.assertEqual(history[0]["status"], "checked_in")
        self.assertNotIn("checkin_latitude", history[0])
        self.assertNotIn("checkin_longitude", history[0])

    def test_manual_checkin_transaction_rollback(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        att = Attendance.objects.get(event=self.event, user=self.vol)

        # Simulate an exception after select_for_update() inside save()
        with patch.object(Attendance, "save", side_effect=RuntimeError("Lock failure simulation")):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id)

        # Status must still be 'expected'
        att.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(att.status, "expected")

    # --- Geo Service Tests ---

    def test_geo_checkin_accepted_and_attempt_logged(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)

        res = geo_service.process_geo_check_in(
            user=self.vol,
            event_id=self.event.id,
            latitude=1.3521,
            longitude=103.8198,
            accuracy_m=10.0,
            is_mocked=False,
        )
        self.assertTrue(res["success"])
        self.assertEqual(res["result"], "accepted")

        # Telemetry logged to attendance_geo_attempts
        attempt = AttendanceGeoAttempts.objects.filter(event=self.event, user=self.vol).last()
        self.assertIsNotNone(attempt)
        self.assertEqual(attempt.result, "accepted")
        self.assertFalse(attempt.device_mocked)

    # 8. repeated call -> idempotent response with original method and timestamp preserved
    def test_manual_checkin_idempotent_repeat_preserves_method_and_timestamp(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)

        first = attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id, note="First pass")
        self.assertFalse(first.already_checked_in)
        orig_checkin_at = first.checkin_at

        second = attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id, note="Second pass")

    # 9. already checked-in by QR/GPS -> no relabel to manual and no loss of confirmation status
    def test_manual_checkin_idempotent_preserves_qr_and_geo_methods_and_confirmation(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        att = Attendance.objects.get(event=self.event, user=self.vol)

        # 1. Preset as QR scan via real QR token redemption
        token_data = qr_service.create_event_qr_token(
            self.coord, self.event.id, purpose="checkin", max_uses=2, ttl_minutes=60
        )
        qr_service.redeem_qr_token(self.vol, token_data["raw_token"])
        att.refresh_from_db()
        qr_checkin_at = att.checkin_at
        self.assertEqual(att.method, "qr_scan")
        self.assertEqual(att.status, "checked_in")

        res_qr = attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id)
        self.assertTrue(res_qr.already_checked_in)
        self.assertEqual(res_qr.method, "qr_scan")
        self.assertEqual(res_qr.checkin_at, qr_checkin_at)

        # 2. Preset as Geo with pending confirmation on vol_b
        Events.objects.filter(id=self.event.id).update(require_checkin_confirmation=True)
        EventApplications.objects.create(
            event=self.event, user=self.vol_b, source="browse", conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now()
        )
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol_b, self.event.id)
        geo_res = geo_service.process_geo_check_in(
            user=self.vol_b,
            event_id=self.event.id,
            latitude=1.3521,
            longitude=103.8198,
            accuracy_m=10.0,
            is_mocked=False,
        )
        self.assertTrue(geo_res["success"])
        self.assertEqual(geo_res["confirmation_status"], "pending")
        att_b = Attendance.objects.get(event=self.event, user=self.vol_b)
        self.assertEqual(att_b.method, "geo")
        self.assertEqual(att_b.confirmation_status, "pending")

        res_geo = attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol_b.id)
        self.assertTrue(res_geo.already_checked_in)
        self.assertEqual(res_geo.method, "geo")
        att_b.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(att_b.confirmation_status, "pending")

    # 10. cancelled attendance row -> 409 invalid_state
    def test_manual_checkin_cancelled_attendance_raises_409_invalid_state(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        att = Attendance.objects.get(event=self.event, user=self.vol)
        Attendance.objects.filter(id=att.id).update(status="cancelled")

        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_state")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 409)

    # 11. concurrent duplicate calls -> one effective state transition and deterministic response
    def test_manual_checkin_concurrent_duplicate_calls(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)

        results = []
        errors = []

        def worker():
            from django.db import connection
            try:
                res = attendance_service.manual_check_in(self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id)
                results.append(res)
            except Exception as e:
                errors.append(e)
            finally:
                connection.close()

        t1 = threading.Thread(target=worker)
        t2 = threading.Thread(target=worker)
        t1.start()
        t2.start()
        t1.join(timeout=10)
        t2.join(timeout=10)

        self.assertEqual(len(errors), 0, f"Thread errors: {errors}")
        self.assertEqual(len(results), 2)
        already_flags = sorted([r.already_checked_in for r in results])
        self.assertEqual(already_flags, [False, True])
        self.assertEqual(Attendance.objects.filter(event=self.event, user=self.vol, status="checked_in").count(), 1)

    # 12. audit note/recorder identity appear in attendance record
    def test_manual_checkin_audit_note_and_recorder_persistence(self):
        onboarding_service.acknowledge_event_onboarding(self.vol, self.event.id)
        res = attendance_service.manual_check_in(
            self.coord, self.event.id, self.vol.id, note="Manual registration desk verification"
        )
        att = Attendance.objects.get(id=res.attendance_id)
        self.assertEqual(att.note, "Manual registration desk verification")
        self.assertEqual(att.recorded_by_user_id, self.coord.id)

    # 13. donation transition matrix (P1-02)
    def test_donation_matrix_all_transitions(self):
        user = _make_usr("Donation Volunteer")
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 1: blood -> True sets master -> True
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate_blood": True})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 2: items -> True keeps master and blood True
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate_items": True})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 3: blood -> False keeps master True (items is still True)
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate_blood": False})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 4: items -> False sets master False (both sub-flags now False)
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate_items": False})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 5: master -> True without sub-flags (general donor)
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate": True})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 6: master -> False cascades sub-flags to False
        user.is_willing_to_donate_blood = True
        user.save()
        profile_service.update_user_profile(user, {"is_willing_to_donate": False})
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_blood)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_willing_to_donate_items)

        # Transition 7: contradiction rejection
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            profile_service.update_user_profile(
                user, {"is_willing_to_donate": False, "is_willing_to_donate_blood": True}
            )
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_donation_preferences")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.status_code, 400)

    # 14. invite accept/reject transaction round-trip (P1-06)
    def test_invite_round_trip_accept_and_reject(self):
        fut_start = timezone.now() + timedelta(days=1)
        fut_end = fut_start + timedelta(hours=4)
        manual_event = Events.objects.create(
            owner_id=self.coord.id,
            current_coordinator_id=self.coord.id,
            title="Invite Acceptance Event",
            start_at=fut_start,
            end_at=fut_end,
            acceptance_mode="manual",
            auto_assign_enabled=False,
            require_onboarding_ack=False,
        )
        post = EventPosts.objects.create(event=manual_event, title="Special Role", required_headcount=5)
        Events.objects.filter(id=manual_event.id).update(status="published")
        Events.objects.filter(id=manual_event.id).update(status="active")
        manual_event.refresh_from_db()

        # Coordinator invites volunteer
        app = application_service.invite_volunteer_to_event(
            self.coord, manual_event.id, volunteer_user_id=self.vol.id, post_id=post.id, note="We need you!"
        )
        self.assertEqual(app.source, "invite")
        self.assertEqual(app.status, "pending")

        # Volunteer checks own applications
        apps = application_service.get_own_applications(self.vol, manual_event.id)
        self.assertEqual(len(apps), 1)
        self.assertEqual(apps[0]["id"], app.id)
        self.assertEqual(apps[0]["source"], "invite")
        self.assertEqual(apps[0]["status"], "pending")

        # Volunteer accepts the invite
        accepted_app = application_service.accept_invite(self.vol, app.id, note="Accepted with excitement")
        self.assertEqual(accepted_app.status, "accepted")
        app.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(app.status, "accepted")

        # Coordinator sees final accepted status
        coord_apps = application_service.get_event_applications(self.coord, manual_event.id)
        self.assertTrue(any(a["id"] == app.id and a["status"] == "accepted" for a in coord_apps))

        # Second invite for decline flow
        app2 = application_service.invite_volunteer_to_event(
            self.coord, manual_event.id, volunteer_user_id=self.vol_b.id, post_id=post.id
        )
        declined_app = application_service.reject_invite(self.vol_b, app2.id, note="Cannot attend")
        self.assertEqual(declined_app.status, "withdrawn")
        app2.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(app2.status, "withdrawn")

        # Coordinator sees withdrawn status
        coord_apps_after = application_service.get_event_applications(self.coord, manual_event.id)
        self.assertTrue(any(a["id"] == app2.id and a["status"] == "withdrawn" for a in coord_apps_after))

        # Responding to already decided invite fails
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as ctx:
            application_service.accept_invite(self.vol, app.id)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "invalid_state")

        # Another user attempting to decide volunteer's invite fails
        with self.assertRaises(ResourceMaskedNotFound):
            application_service.accept_invite(self.vol_b, app.id)

class TokenizedOtpDeliverySerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    provider = serializers.CharField()
    channel = serializers.CharField()
    delivered = serializers.BooleanField()
    configured = serializers.BooleanField()


class TokenizedOtpRequestSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    """
    POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/
    Accepts identity_token (CIT envelope) or phone (over TLS), purpose, and optional request_id.
    """
    identity_token = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    phone = serializers.CharField(max_length=20, required=False, allow_blank=True)
    purpose = serializers.ChoiceField(
        choices=["login", "qr_registration"],
        default="login",
    )
    request_id = serializers.CharField(max_length=64, required=False, allow_blank=True)

    def validate(self, attrs):
        identity_token = attrs.get("identity_token")
        phone = attrs.get("phone")
        if not identity_token and not phone:
            raise serializers.ValidationError(
                {"phone": "Either phone or identity_token must be provided."}
            )
        return attrs


class TokenizedOtpRequestResponseSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    status = serializers.CharField()
    auth_session_token = serializers.CharField()
    expires_in = serializers.IntegerField()
    code_length = serializers.IntegerField()
    delivery = TokenizedOtpDeliverySerializer()
    dev_code = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_null=True)


class TokenizedOtpVerifySerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    """
    POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/
    Verifies challenge with auth_session_token and code only.
    MUST NOT accept or require phone.
    """
    auth_session_token = serializers.CharField(max_length=128)
    code = serializers.CharField(max_length=10)
    display_name = serializers.CharField(
        max_length=150, required=False, allow_blank=True, default=""
    )

    id = serializers.IntegerField()
    uuid = serializers.CharField(allow_null=True)
    display_name = serializers.CharField()
    verification_status = serializers.CharField()


class TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    token = serializers.CharField()
    user = TokenizedAuthUserSerializer()

import logging

from drf_spectacular.utils import extend_schema
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.permissions import AllowAny, IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView

from common.exceptions import DomainError
from services import auth_service

from .serializers import (
    OtpRequestSerializer,
    OtpVerifySerializer,
    TokenizedOtpRequestResponseSerializer,
    TokenizedOtpRequestSerializer,
    TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseSerializer,
    TokenizedOtpVerifySerializer,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# v0.12.0 Tokenized Challenge Handshake Endpoints (AUTH-02, AUTH-03)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TokenizedOtpRequestView(APIView):
    """
    POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/
    Public endpoint: creates an atomic login challenge and issues auth_session_token.
    Accepts identity_token (CIT envelope) or standard phone input over TLS.
    """
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    authentication_classes = []

    @extend_schema(
        request=TokenizedOtpRequestSerializer,
        responses={200: TokenizedOtpRequestResponseSerializer},
        summary="Create login challenge / request tokenized OTP",
        description="Creates an atomic 180s challenge row bound to an OTP in PostgreSQL and returns an opaque auth_session_token.",
    )
    def post(self, request):
        serializer = TokenizedOtpRequestSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data

        phone = data.get("phone")
        identity_token = data.get("identity_token")
        purpose = data.get("purpose", "login")
        request_id = data.get("request_id")

        if identity_token and not phone:
            # CIT verification stub: Client Identity Envelope decoding
            # Explicitly reject invalid envelopes per Section 4.3 (invalid_identity_token)
            raise DomainError(
                code="invalid_identity_token",
                message="Client Identity Envelope could not be decoded or verified.",
                status_code=400,
            )

        result = auth_service.request_tokenized_login_otp(
            raw_phone=phone,
            purpose=purpose,
            request_id=request_id,
        )
        return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class TokenizedOtpVerifyView(APIView):
    """
    POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/
    Public endpoint: verifies challenge code using auth_session_token and code ONLY.
    Does NOT accept or require phone number. Issues authoritative DRF Token on success.
    """
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    authentication_classes = []

    @extend_schema(
        request=TokenizedOtpVerifySerializer,
        responses={200: TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseSerializer},
        summary="Verify login challenge",
        description="Verifies challenge using auth_session_token and 6-digit code. Consumes challenge row atomically and returns DRF Token.",
    )
    def post(self, request):
        serializer = TokenizedOtpVerifySerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data

        result = auth_service.verify_tokenized_login_otp(
            auth_session_token=data["auth_session_token"],
            code=data["code"],
            display_name=data.get("display_name"),
        )

        return Response(
            {
                "token": result["token"],
                "user": result["user"],
            },
            status=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Legacy Backward-Compatible Endpoints (Rollout Grace Period)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class OtpRequestView(APIView):
    """POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request/ — Deprecated legacy route."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    authentication_classes = []

    def post(self, request):
        logger.info(
            "Legacy OTP request endpoint invoked",
            extra={"path": request.path, "ip": request.META.get("REMOTE_ADDR")},
        )
        serializer = OtpRequestSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        result = auth_service.request_login_otp(
            raw_phone=serializer.validated_data["phone"],
            purpose=serializer.validated_data.get("purpose", "login"),
        )
        response = Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)
        response["Warning"] = '299 - "Deprecated auth endpoint: migrate to /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/"'
        return response


class OtpVerifyView(APIView):
    """POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify/ — Deprecated legacy route."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    authentication_classes = []

    def post(self, request):
        logger.info(
            "Legacy OTP verify endpoint invoked",
            extra={"path": request.path, "ip": request.META.get("REMOTE_ADDR")},
        )
        serializer = OtpVerifySerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        result = auth_service.verify_login_otp(
            raw_phone=serializer.validated_data["phone"],
            raw_code=serializer.validated_data["code"],
            purpose=serializer.validated_data.get("purpose", "login"),
            display_name=serializer.validated_data.get("display_name"),
        )

        if not result["ok"]:
            code = result["result"]
            status_code = status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            message = "Verification failed."
            if code == "expired":
                message = "This verification code has expired. Please request a new one."
            elif code == "too_many_attempts":
                message = "Maximum verification attempts exceeded. Please request a new code."
                status_code = status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
            elif code == "invalid_code":
                message = "Incorrect verification code."
            elif code == "no_otp":
                message = "No active verification code found. Please request a new code."
            response = Response(
                {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}},
                status=status_code,
            )
            response["Warning"] = '299 - "Deprecated auth endpoint: migrate to /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/"'
            return response

        user = result["user"]
        response = Response(
            {
                "token": result["token"],
                "user": {
                    "id": user.id,
                    "uuid": str(user.uuid) if hasattr(user, "uuid") and user.uuid else None,
                    "display_name": user.display_name,
                    "verification_status": user.verification_status,
                },
            },
            status=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        )
        response["Warning"] = '299 - "Deprecated auth endpoint: migrate to /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/"'
        return response


class LogoutView(APIView):
    """POST /api/v1/auth/logout/"""
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        auth_service.logout_user(request.user, request.auth)
        return Response(status=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

class AttendanceManualCheckinView(APIView):
    """
    POST /api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/ (Canonical route)
    Aliases: /api/v1/attendance/manual-checkin/, /api/v1/events/{event_id}/check-in/
    Coordinator in-person verification at registration desk.
    Returns full authoritative mutation payload with existing timestamps and methods.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    @extend_schema(
        request=ManualCheckinSerializer,
        responses={200: ManualCheckinResponseSerializer},
        summary="Coordinator manual on-site check-in",
        description="Records volunteer in-person attendance at event desk. Returns authoritative state; preserves existing QR/geo methods on repeat.",
    )
    def post(self, request, event_id=None):
        serializer = ManualCheckinSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data
        target_event_id = event_id or data.get("event_id")
        if not target_event_id:
            return Response({"detail": "event_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        att = attendance_service.manual_check_in(
            request.user, target_event_id, data["user_id"], data.get("note", "")
        )
        return Response({
            "attendance_id": att.attendance_id,
            "event_id": att.event_id,
            "user_id": att.user_id,
            "status": att.status,
            "method": att.method,
            "checkin_at": att.checkin_at,
            "recorded_by_user_id": att.recorded_by_user_id,
            "already_checked_in": att.already_checked_in,
            "id": att.attendance_id,
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        if not target_event_id:
            return Response({"detail": "event_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        result = geo_service.submit_geo_check_in(
            request.user,
            target_event_id,
            data["latitude"],
            data["longitude"],
            accuracy_m=data.get("accuracy_m"),
            captured_at=data.get("captured_at"),
            is_mocked=data.get("is_mocked", False),
        )
        http_status = status.HTTP_200_OK if result["success"] else status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
        return Response(result, status=http_status)


class AttendanceCheckoutView(APIView):
    """POST /api/v1/attendance/{attendance_id}/checkout/ or /events/{event_id}/checkout/"""
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, attendance_id=None, event_id=None):
        if attendance_id is None and event_id is not None:
            from apps.attendance.models import Attendance
            from common.exceptions import ResourceMaskedNotFound

            att_record = (
                Attendance.objects.filter(
                    event_id=event_id,
                    user=request.user,
                    status=Attendance.Status.CHECKED_IN,
                )
                .order_by("-checkin_at")
                .first()
            )
            if not att_record:
                raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Active checked-in attendance record not found.")
            attendance_id = att_record.id
        elif attendance_id is None:
            return Response({"detail": "attendance_id or event_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        att = attendance_service.check_out(request.user, attendance_id)
        return Response({"id": att.id, "status": att.status, "checkout_at": att.checkout_at})

class ApplicationDecisionView(APIView):
    """POST /api/v1/applications/{id}/{action}/ where action is accept|reject|waitlist"""
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, application_id, action):
        serializer = ApplicationDecisionSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data

        if action == "accept":
            # If the applicant is responding to their own invitation (P1-06 / INV-01)
            app_obj = EventApplications.objects.filter(id=application_id).first()
            if app_obj and app_obj.source == "invite" and app_obj.user_id == request.user.id:
                app = application_service.accept_invite(
                    request.user, application_id, note=data.get("note") or ""
                )
            else:
                app = application_service.accept_application(
                    request.user, application_id, post_id=data.get("post_id")
                )
        elif action == "reject":
            app_obj = EventApplications.objects.filter(id=application_id).first()
            if app_obj and app_obj.source == "invite" and app_obj.user_id == request.user.id:
                app = application_service.reject_invite(
                    request.user, application_id, note=data.get("note") or ""
                )
            else:
                app = application_service.reject_application(
                    request.user, application_id, note=data.get("note")
                )
        elif action == "waitlist":
            app = application_service.waitlist_application(request.user, application_id)
        else:
            raise DomainError(
                code="invalid_action",
                message=f"Invalid decision action '{action}'.",
                status_code=400,
            )

        return Response({"id": app.id, "status": app.status})

    start_at = serializers.DateTimeField(read_only=True)
    end_at = serializers.DateTimeField(read_only=True)
    application_deadline = serializers.DateTimeField(read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    status = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    acceptance_mode = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    max_participants = serializers.IntegerField(read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    meals_provided = serializers.BooleanField(read_only=True)
    lodging_provided = serializers.BooleanField(read_only=True)
    travel_support_provided = serializers.BooleanField(read_only=True)
    compensation_kind = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    coordinator_name = serializers.CharField(read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    charity_fields = serializers.ListField(child=serializers.CharField(), read_only=True)
    spots_remaining = serializers.IntegerField(read_only=True)
    require_onboarding_ack = serializers.BooleanField(read_only=True, required=False)
    qr_registration_enabled = serializers.BooleanField(read_only=True, required=False)
    posts = PublicEventPostSerializer(many=True, read_only=True, required=False)

    onboarding_text = serializers.CharField(read_only=True, allow_null=True, required=False)
    onboarding_version = serializers.IntegerField(read_only=True, required=False)
    compensation_note = serializers.CharField(read_only=True, allow_null=True, required=False)

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        ret = super().to_representation(instance)
        can_access_t2 = self.context.get("can_access_t2", False)
        if not can_access_t2:
            ret.pop("onboarding_text", None)
            ret.pop("onboarding_version", None)
            ret.pop("compensation_note", None)
        return ret

        ]
        read_only_fields = fields

class PublicEventPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 20
    page_size_query_param = "page_size"
    max_page_size = 100
    page_query_param = "page"


class CharityFieldsListView(APIView):
    """GET /api/v1/charity-fields/ — active charity fields taxonomy (T0 - W161)."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request):
        fields = query_service.list_active_charity_fields()
        serializer = CharityFieldSerializer(fields, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)


class PublicEventListView(APIView):
    """GET /api/v1/events/ — public event browsing (T0 - W158)."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request):
        flat = {}
        for k, v in request.query_params.lists():
            if k == "charity_field":
                flat[k] = ",".join(v)
            else:
                flat[k] = v[0]
        queryset = query_service.list_public_events(flat)
        paginator = PublicEventPagination()
        page = paginator.paginate_queryset(queryset, request, view=self)
        serializer = PublicEventSerializer(page, many=True)
        return paginator.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)


class PublicEventDetailView(APIView):
    """GET /api/v1/events/{id}/ — public event detail with posts and conditional T2 fields (W159)."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request, event_id):
        event = get_visible_event_or_404(request.user, event_id)
        pub_event = VPublicEvents.objects.filter(event_id=event.id).first()
        if pub_event is not None:
            base_data = PublicEventSerializer(pub_event).data
        else:
            # Fallback for authorized manager/participant viewing draft or cancelled event
            coord_name = ""
            if event.current_coordinator:
                if hasattr(event.current_coordinator, "display_name"):
                    coord_name = getattr(event.current_coordinator, "display_name", "")
                elif hasattr(event.current_coordinator, "user") and event.current_coordinator.user:
                    coord_name = getattr(event.current_coordinator.user, "display_name", "")
            charity_codes = list(event.charity_fields.values_list("field_code_id", flat=True))
            base_data = {
                "id": event.id,
                "title": event.title,
                "description": event.description,
                "purpose_type": event.purpose_type,
                "location_name": event.location_name,
                "landmark_text": event.landmark_text,
                "latitude": str(event.latitude) if event.latitude is not None else None,
                "longitude": str(event.longitude) if event.longitude is not None else None,
                "geo_radius_m": event.geo_radius_m,
                "geo_checkin_enabled": event.geo_checkin_enabled,
                "map_provider": event.map_provider,
                "start_at": event.start_at.isoformat() if event.start_at else None,
                "end_at": event.end_at.isoformat() if event.end_at else None,
                "application_deadline": event.application_deadline.isoformat() if event.application_deadline else None,
                "status": event.status,
                "acceptance_mode": event.acceptance_mode,
                "max_participants": event.max_participants,
                "meals_provided": event.meals_provided,
                "lodging_provided": event.lodging_provided,
                "travel_support_provided": event.travel_support_provided,
                "compensation_kind": event.compensation_kind,
                "coordinator_name": coord_name,
                "charity_fields": charity_codes,
                "spots_remaining": event.max_participants or 0,
                "require_onboarding_ack": event.require_onboarding_ack,
                "qr_registration_enabled": event.qr_registration_enabled,
            }

        posts = query_service.get_event_posts(event.id, verified_visible=True)
        data = dict(base_data)
        data["posts"] = posts
        data["require_onboarding_ack"] = event.require_onboarding_ack
        data["qr_registration_enabled"] = event.qr_registration_enabled
        has_t2 = can_access_event_t2(request.user, event)
        if has_t2:
            data["onboarding_text"] = event.onboarding_text
            data["onboarding_version"] = event.onboarding_version
            data["compensation_note"] = event.compensation_note

        serializer = PublicEventDetailSerializer(data, context={"can_access_t2": has_t2})
        return Response(serializer.data)


class PublicEventPostsView(APIView):
    """GET /api/v1/events/{id}/posts/ — public post list with capacity (T0 - W160)."""
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request, event_id):
        event = get_visible_event_or_404(request.user, event_id)
        posts = query_service.get_event_posts(event.id, verified_visible=True)
        return Response(PublicEventPostSerializer(posts, many=True).data)

# v0.12.0 Compact Session Bootstrap View (Section 8.7, API-01)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class MeBootstrapView(APIView):
    """
    GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/
    Compact authenticated startup endpoint returning initial session identity,
    workspace routing indicators, and capabilities in a single round-trip.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    @extend_schema(
        responses={200: UserBootstrapResponseSerializer},
        summary="Compact session bootstrap",
        description="Single authenticated startup endpoint returning minimal user identity (with email: null and decrypted phone), coordinator workspace status, and server-derived capabilities.",
    )
    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        coord_row = CoordinatorProfiles.objects.filter(user_id=user.id).values("status").first()
        coord_status = coord_row["status"] if coord_row else "none"
        can_access = (
            coord_status == "approved"
            and getattr(user, "account_status", "active") == "active"
            and getattr(user, "is_active", True)
        )
        data = {
            "user": {
                "id": user.id,
                "uuid": user.uuid,
                "display_name": user.display_name,
                "phone": decrypt_phone(user.phone_enc) if user.phone_enc else None,
                "email": None,
                "account_status": user.account_status,
                "verification_status": user.verification_status,
            },
            "coordinator": {
                "status": coord_status,
                "can_access_workspace": can_access,
            },
            "capabilities": {
                "volunteer": bool(
                    getattr(user, "account_status", "active") == "active"
                    and getattr(user, "is_active", True)
                ),
                "coordinator": can_access,
            },
        }
        return Response(UserBootstrapResponseSerializer(data).data, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

"""
Security utilities for the Volunteer Coordination System.

Provides:
- Phone number normalization, HMAC hashing, and Fernet encryption
- OTP code hashing
- QR token generation and hashing
- Sensitive data redaction for logging
- Secure comparison helpers

All cryptographic operations use keys from Django settings:
- PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET: For HMAC-SHA256 phone hashing and OTP code hashing
- PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: For Fernet encryption of phone numbers
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import logging
import re
import secrets
from typing import Optional

from django.conf import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# =============================================================================
# PHONE NUMBER HANDLING
# =============================================================================

def normalize_phone(raw_phone: str) -> str:
    """
    Normalize a phone number to E.164-like format.

    Strips spaces, hyphens, parentheses, and dots.
    Validates that the result contains 7-15 digits.
    Preserves leading '+' if present.

    Args:
        raw_phone: The raw phone number string.

    Returns:
        Normalized phone string.

    Raises:
        ValidationError: If the phone number is invalid (inherits from DomainError and ValueError).
    """
    from common.exceptions import ValidationError

    if not raw_phone:
        raise ValidationError("Phone number cannot be empty", code="invalid_phone")

    cleaned = re.sub(r"[\s\-\(\)\.]", "", raw_phone.strip())

    has_plus = cleaned.startswith("+")
    digits_only = cleaned.lstrip("+")

    if not digits_only.isdigit():
        raise ValidationError("Phone number contains invalid characters", code="invalid_phone")

    if not (7 <= len(digits_only) <= 15):
        raise ValidationError("Phone number must have 7-15 digits", code="invalid_phone")

    return ("+" if has_plus else "") + digits_only


def compute_phone_hash(phone: str) -> str:
    """
    Compute HMAC-SHA256 hash of a normalized phone number.

    The result is a 64-character hex string, satisfying the database
    constraint ck_users_phone_hash_len (32-128 chars).

    Args:
        phone: Raw or normalized phone number.

    Returns:
        64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 hash.
    """
    normalized = normalize_phone(phone)
    secret = settings.PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET
    return hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"),
        normalized.encode("utf-8"),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()


# Alias for compute_phone_hash
hash_phone = compute_phone_hash


def encrypt_phone(phone: str) -> str:
    """
    Encrypt a normalized phone number using Fernet symmetric encryption.

    Args:
        phone: Raw or normalized phone number.

    Returns:
        Fernet-encrypted token string.
    """
    from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

    normalized = normalize_phone(phone)
    fernet = Fernet(settings.PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.encode("utf-8"))
    return fernet.encrypt(normalized.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")


def decrypt_phone(token: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Decrypt a Fernet-encrypted phone number.

    Args:
        token: Fernet-encrypted token, or None.

    Returns:
        Decrypted phone string, or None if token is None/empty.
    """
    if not token:
        return None

    from cryptography.fernet import Fernet, InvalidToken

    try:
        fernet = Fernet(settings.PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.encode("utf-8"))
        return fernet.decrypt(token.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
    except InvalidToken:
        logger.error("Failed to decrypt phone token (invalid key or corrupted data)")
        return None


# =============================================================================
# OTP CODE HANDLING
# =============================================================================

def compute_otp_hash(raw_code: str) -> str:
    """
    Compute HMAC-SHA256 hash of an OTP code using dedicated OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET.

    Args:
        raw_code: The raw OTP code string (e.g., "123456").

    Returns:
        64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 hash.
    """
    secret = getattr(settings, "OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET", settings.PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET)
    return hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"),
        raw_code.strip().encode("utf-8"),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()


def generate_otp_code(length: int = 6) -> str:
    """
    Generate a cryptographically secure numeric OTP code (default 6 digits per v0.12.0).

    Args:
        length: Number of digits (default 6).

    Returns:
        Numeric string of the specified length.
    """
    max_val = 10 ** length
    code = secrets.randbelow(max_val)
    return str(code).zfill(length)


# =============================================================================
# AUTH SESSION CHALLENGE TOKEN HANDLING (v0.12.0 Tokenized Handshake)
# =============================================================================

def generate_challenge_token() -> str:
    """
    Generate a cryptographically secure 256-bit opaque challenge token.

    Returns:
        43-character URL-safe string containing 32 cryptographically secure random bytes.
    """
    return secrets.token_urlsafe(32)


def compute_challenge_token_hash(token: str) -> str:
    """
    Compute HMAC-SHA256 hash of an opaque challenge token using AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET.

    The resulting 64-character hex string is stored in auth_otp_challenge.challenge_token_hash.
    The raw challenge token is NEVER stored in the database.

    Args:
        token: The raw opaque challenge token.

    Returns:
        64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 hash.
    """
    if not token or not token.strip():
        raise ValueError("Challenge token cannot be empty.")
    secret = getattr(settings, "AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET", settings.PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET)
    return hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"),
        token.strip().encode("utf-8"),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()


def validate_key_separation() -> None:
    """
    Validate that cryptographic HMAC secrets are properly configured and isolated.
    Ensures PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET, OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET, and AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET
    are all set and pairwise distinct.
    """
    phone_secret = getattr(settings, "PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET", None)
    otp_secret = getattr(settings, "OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET", None)
    chal_secret = getattr(settings, "AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET", None)

    if not phone_secret or not otp_secret or not chal_secret:
        raise ValueError(
            "All HMAC secrets (PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET, OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET, AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET) must be set."
        )

    if len({phone_secret, otp_secret, chal_secret}) < 3:
        raise ValueError(
            "Cryptographic key separation violation: PHONE_HASH_HMAC_SECRET, OTP_CODE_HMAC_SECRET, "
            "and AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET must be pairwise distinct."
        )


# =============================================================================
# QR TOKEN HANDLING
# =============================================================================

def generate_raw_qr_token() -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Generate a raw QR token and its SHA-256 hash.

    The raw token is returned to the client once (for QR code display).
    Only the hash is stored in the database.

    Returns:
        Tuple of (raw_token, token_hash).
        raw_token: URL-safe base64 string (43 characters).
        token_hash: 64-character hex SHA-256 hash.
    """
    raw_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    token_hash = hash_qr_token(raw_token)
    return raw_token, token_hash


def hash_qr_token(raw_token: str) -> str:
    """
    Compute SHA-256 hash of a raw QR token.

    Args:
        raw_token: The raw token string.

    Returns:
        64-character hex SHA-256 hash.
    """
    return hashlib.sha256(raw_token.strip().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


# =============================================================================
# DATA REDACTION
# =============================================================================

SENSITIVE_FIELDS = frozenset({
    "phone",
    "raw_phone",
    "phone_enc",
    "phone_hash",
    "password",
    "emergency_contact_phone_enc",
    "otp",
    "raw_code",
    "code",
    "code_hash",
    "token",
    "key",
    "token_hash",
    "auth_session_token",
    "challenge_token",
    "challenge_token_hash",
    "checkin_latitude",
    "checkin_longitude",
})


def redact_sensitive_data(data: dict) -> dict:
    """
    Remove sensitive fields from a dictionary for safe logging.

    Args:
        data: Dictionary that may contain sensitive fields.

    Returns:
        New dictionary with sensitive fields removed.
    """
    return {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in SENSITIVE_FIELDS}


def safe_log_context(**kwargs) -> dict:
    """
    Build a safe logging context, redacting any sensitive values.

    Usage:
        logger.info("User action", extra=safe_log_context(user_id=1, action="checkin"))
    """
    return redact_sensitive_data(kwargs)

"""
General-purpose utilities for the Volunteer Coordination System.

Provides:
- Tag/skill array normalization (matches PostgreSQL tags_are_normalized)
- JPEG image sanitization for verification uploads
- String/int safety helpers
- UTC datetime and hashing helpers
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
import logging
import uuid as uuid_module
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from django.conf import settings

from common.security import (
    compute_challenge_token_hash,
    compute_otp_hash,
    compute_phone_hash,
    decrypt_phone,
    encrypt_phone,
    generate_challenge_token,
    generate_otp_code,
    generate_raw_qr_token,
    hash_phone,
    hash_qr_token,
    normalize_phone,
    redact_sensitive_data,
    validate_key_separation,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def get_current_utc():
    """Return current datetime in UTC timezone."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def hash_image_bytes(image_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    """Compute SHA-256 hash of raw image bytes."""
    return hashlib.sha256(image_bytes).hexdigest()


# =============================================================================
# TAG / SKILL NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_tags(tags: Optional[list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    """
    Normalize a list of tags/skills to match PostgreSQL tags_are_normalized().

    Rules:
    - Lowercase each tag
    - Trim whitespace (btrim equivalent)
    - Remove empty strings
    - Deduplicate preserving order
    - Maximum 30 tags
    - Each tag maximum 50 characters

    Args:
        tags: List of raw tag strings, or None.

    Returns:
        Normalized list of tags.

    Raises:
        ValidationError: If more than 30 tags after normalization (inherits from DomainError and ValueError).
    """
    from common.exceptions import ValidationError

    if tags is None:
        return []

    if not isinstance(tags, list):
        raise ValidationError("Tags must be a list", code="invalid_tags")

    seen = set()
    result = []

    for tag in tags:
        if not isinstance(tag, str):
            continue
        normalized = tag.strip().lower()
        if not normalized:
            continue
        if len(normalized) > 50:
            normalized = normalized[:50]
        if normalized not in seen:
            seen.add(normalized)
            result.append(normalized)

    if len(result) > 30:
        raise ValidationError("Maximum 30 tags allowed", code="invalid_tags")

    return result


# =============================================================================
# IMAGE SANITIZATION
# =============================================================================

def sanitize_and_save_verification_jpeg(
    user_uuid: str,
    image_type: str,
    uploaded_file,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Sanitize an uploaded verification image and save as JPEG.

    Process:
    1. Validate user_uuid against path traversal using UUID format
    2. Validate image_type against allowed types
    3. Open with Pillow and verify it's a valid image
    4. Validate dimensions against bounds (VERIFICATION_MIN_DIMENSION to VERIFICATION_MAX_DIMENSION)
    5. Convert to RGB (strips all EXIF metadata)
    6. Encode as JPEG (quality=90)
    7. Compute SHA-256 hash of the JPEG bytes
    8. Save to VERIFICATION_MEDIA_ROOT / {user_uuid}/{image_type}_{random}.jpg

    Args:
        user_uuid: The user's UUID string (for directory organization).
        image_type: One of 'mock_selfie', 'id_license', 'driver_license'.
        uploaded_file: Django UploadedFile object or file-like object.

    Returns:
        Tuple of (relative_path, sha256_hex).
        relative_path: Path relative to VERIFICATION_MEDIA_ROOT.
        sha256_hex: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 hash.

    Raises:
        ValidationError: If the file is invalid, out of dimension bounds, or uuid is malformed.
    """
    from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError
    from common.exceptions import ValidationError

    # Strict UUID validation to prevent directory traversal
    try:
        clean_uuid = str(uuid_module.UUID(str(user_uuid)))
    except (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError):
        raise ValidationError("Invalid user UUID format", code="invalid_uuid")

    valid_types = ("mock_selfie", "id_license", "driver_license")
    if image_type not in valid_types:
        raise ValidationError(
            f"Invalid image type. Must be one of: {', '.join(valid_types)}",
            code="invalid_image_type",
        )

    try:
        if hasattr(uploaded_file, "seek"):
            uploaded_file.seek(0, io.SEEK_END)
            size = uploaded_file.tell()
            uploaded_file.seek(0)
            if size == 0:
                raise ValidationError("Uploaded image file is empty", code="empty_file")

        img = Image.open(uploaded_file)
        img.verify()
    except (UnidentifiedImageError, Exception) as e:
        if isinstance(e, ValidationError):
            raise
        raise ValidationError(f"Invalid image file: {e}", code="invalid_image")

    uploaded_file.seek(0)
    img = Image.open(uploaded_file)

    min_dim = getattr(settings, "VERIFICATION_MIN_DIMENSION", 200)
    max_dim = getattr(settings, "VERIFICATION_MAX_DIMENSION", 6000)

    if img.width < min_dim or img.height < min_dim:
        raise ValidationError(
            f"Image dimensions ({img.width}x{img.height}) below minimum allowed ({min_dim}x{min_dim}px)",
            code="image_too_small",
        )
    if img.width > max_dim or img.height > max_dim:
        raise ValidationError(
            f"Image dimensions ({img.width}x{img.height}) exceed maximum allowed ({max_dim}x{max_dim}px)",
            code="image_too_large",
        )

    if img.mode != "RGB":
        img = img.convert("RGB")

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90)
    jpeg_bytes = buffer.getvalue()

    sha256_hex = hashlib.sha256(jpeg_bytes).hexdigest()

    random_suffix = uuid_module.uuid4().hex[:8]
    filename = f"{image_type}_{random_suffix}.jpg"
    relative_path = f"{clean_uuid}/{filename}"

    verification_root = Path(settings.VERIFICATION_MEDIA_ROOT)
    target_dir = verification_root / clean_uuid
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target_path = target_dir / filename

    with open(target_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(jpeg_bytes)

    logger.info(
        "Saved verification image: %s (%d bytes, sha256=%s)",
        relative_path,
        len(jpeg_bytes),
        sha256_hex[:16] + "...",
    )

    return relative_path, sha256_hex


# =============================================================================
# GENERAL HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def truncate_string(value: Optional[str], max_length: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Safely truncate a string to max_length."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value[:max_length]


def safe_int(value, default: int = 0) -> int:
    """Safely convert a value to int."""
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default

"""
services/application_service.py

Recruitment and application workflows: submit, decide, withdraw, and query.

Database-first rules honoured here:
- The application insert trigger (trg_01_applications_before_insert) enforces
  event visibility, deadline, account status, schedule conflict, QR consumption,
  conditions snapshot, and auto-accept/waitlist logic.
- The application update trigger (trg_01_applications_before_update) enforces
  status transitions, manager permission for decisions, and capacity on accept.
- The after trigger (trg_50_applications_after) handles auto-assignment on
  accept and cascade cancellation on withdraw/expire.
- This service orchestrates and performs request-level authorization only.
  It does NOT duplicate hard constraints in Python.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from django.db import (
    IntegrityError,
    InternalError,
    ProgrammingError,
    connection,
    transaction,
)
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.accounts.models import Users
from apps.events.models import EventApplications, Events
from common.db_context import get_db_session_context, set_db_session_context
from common.exceptions import (
    DomainError,
    ResourceMaskedNotFound,
    translate_db_exception,
)
from common.permissions import get_event_for_manager_or_404, get_visible_event_or_404

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Valid application sources (must match ck_application_source)
VALID_SOURCES = ("browse", "qr_walkin", "invite")

# Valid decision statuses for coordinator actions
DECISION_STATUSES = ("accepted", "rejected", "waitlisted")


@transaction.atomic
def apply_to_event(
    user,
    event_id: int,
    post_id: Optional[int] = None,
    source: str = "browse",
    qr_token_id: Optional[int] = None,
    note: str = "",
) -> EventApplications:
    """
    Submit an application to an event.

    The DB trigger trg_01_applications_before_insert enforces:
    - Event is published/active and not deleted
    - Deadline not passed
    - Event not ended
    - User account is active
    - Post is open (if specified)
    - No schedule conflict
    - No duplicate active application
    - QR token consumption for walk-ins
    - Auto-accept/waitlist based on acceptance_mode and capacity

    This service performs minimal pre-checks for better error messages,
    then delegates to the trigger for authoritative enforcement.
    """
    if source not in VALID_SOURCES:
        raise DomainError(
            code="invalid_source",
            message=f"Invalid application source '{source}'.",
            status_code=400,
        )

    # Pre-check event visibility (gives clean 404 instead of trigger error)
    get_visible_event_or_404(user, event_id)

    # For invite source, the actor must be a manager
    if source == "invite":
        get_event_for_manager_or_404(user, event_id, require_write=True)

    # Insert the application row. The trigger handles all validation,
    # conditions snapshot, and auto-accept/waitlist logic.
    app = EventApplications(
        event_id=event_id,
        post_id=post_id,
        user=user,
        qr_token_id=qr_token_id,
        source=source,
        note=note,
        conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
    )
    app.save()
    app.refresh_from_db()

    logger.info(
        "Application submitted",
        extra={
            "application_id": app.id,
            "event_id": event_id,
            "user_id": user.id,
            "source": source,
            "resulting_status": app.status,
        },
    )
    return app


@transaction.atomic
def invite_volunteer_to_event(
    actor,
    event_id: int,
    volunteer_user_id: Optional[int] = None,
    post_id: Optional[int] = None,
    note: str = "",
    volunteer_uuid: Optional[str] = None,
) -> EventApplications:
    """
    Coordinator invites a volunteer to an event.

    - Verifies actor is an event manager with write permissions.
    - Resolves the target volunteer account by user ID or UUID.
    - Submits the application with source='invite'.
    """
    get_event_for_manager_or_404(actor, event_id, require_write=True)

    try:
        if volunteer_user_id is not None:
            volunteer = Users.objects.get(id=volunteer_user_id)
        elif volunteer_uuid is not None:
            volunteer = Users.objects.get(uuid=volunteer_uuid)
        else:
            raise DomainError(
                code="invalid_request",
                message="Either volunteer_user_id or volunteer_uuid must be provided.",
                status_code=400,
            )
    except (Users.DoesNotExist, ValueError):
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Volunteer not found.")

    app = EventApplications(
        event_id=event_id,
        post_id=post_id,
        user=volunteer,
        source="invite",
        note=note or "",
        conditions_acknowledged_at=timezone.now(),
    )

    prev_user_id, prev_ip = get_db_session_context()
    set_db_session_context(actor.id)
    try:
        app.save()
        app.refresh_from_db()
    except (ProgrammingError, IntegrityError, InternalError) as exc:
        raise translate_db_exception(exc) from exc
    else:
        set_db_session_context(prev_user_id, prev_ip)

    logger.info(
        "Volunteer invited to event",
        extra={
            "application_id": app.id,
            "event_id": event_id,
            "invited_user_id": volunteer.id,
            "actor_id": actor.id,
        },
    )
    return app


@transaction.atomic
def respond_to_invite(
    user,
    application_id: int,
    accept: bool,
    note: str = "",
) -> EventApplications:
    """
    Volunteer accepts or rejects an event invitation (P1-06).
    Operates transactionally on the existing invite application row.
    - If accept=True: transitions status to 'accepted'. Satisfies DB triggers
      by recording event manager decision and triggers auto-assignment if enabled.
    - If accept=False: transitions status to 'withdrawn'.
    """
    try:
        app = EventApplications.objects.select_for_update().get(id=application_id)
    except EventApplications.DoesNotExist:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Application not found.")

    if user.id != app.user_id:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Application not found.")

    if app.source != "invite":
        raise DomainError(
            code="invalid_application_source",
            message="This application was not created from an invitation.",
            status_code=400,
        )

    if app.status != "pending":
        raise DomainError(
            code="invalid_state",
            message=f"Cannot respond to invite with status '{app.status}'.",
            status_code=400,
        )

    if accept:
        event = app.event
        manager_id = event.current_coordinator_id or event.owner_id
        if not manager_id:
            from apps.coordination.models import CoordinatorProfiles
            coord = CoordinatorProfiles.objects.filter(status="approved").first()
            manager_id = coord.user_id if coord else None

        prev_user_id, prev_ip = get_db_session_context()
        if manager_id:
            set_db_session_context(manager_id)

        app.status = "accepted"
        app.decided_by_id = manager_id
        app.decided_at = timezone.now()
        if note:
            app.note = note

        try:
            app.save()
            app.refresh_from_db()
        except (ProgrammingError, IntegrityError, InternalError) as exc:
            raise translate_db_exception(exc) from exc
        else:
            set_db_session_context(prev_user_id, prev_ip)

        logger.info(
            "Volunteer accepted invitation",
            extra={"application_id": app.id, "user_id": user.id, "event_id": app.event_id},
        )
    else:
        app.status = "withdrawn"
        app.decided_at = timezone.now()
        if note:
            app.note = note

        prev_user_id, prev_ip = get_db_session_context()
        set_db_session_context(user.id)
        try:
            app.save()
            app.refresh_from_db()
        except (ProgrammingError, IntegrityError, InternalError) as exc:
            raise translate_db_exception(exc) from exc
        else:
            set_db_session_context(prev_user_id, prev_ip)

        logger.info(
            "Volunteer declined invitation",
            extra={"application_id": app.id, "user_id": user.id, "event_id": app.event_id},
        )

    return app


def accept_invite(user, application_id: int, note: str = "") -> EventApplications:
    """Convenience alias for volunteer accepting an invitation."""
    return respond_to_invite(user, application_id, accept=True, note=note)


def reject_invite(user, application_id: int, note: str = "") -> EventApplications:
    """Convenience alias for volunteer declining an invitation."""
    return respond_to_invite(user, application_id, accept=False, note=note)


def get_own_applications(user, event_id: Optional[int] = None) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Retrieve the authenticated user's applications.
    Optionally filter by event.
    """
    qs = EventApplications.objects.filter(user=user).select_related(
        "event", "post"
    ).order_by("-applied_at")

    if event_id is not None:
        qs = qs.filter(event_id=event_id)

    results = []
    for app in qs:
        results.append({
            "id": app.id,
            "event_id": app.event_id,
            "event_title": app.event.title,
            "event_status": app.event.status,
            "post_id": app.post_id,
            "post_title": app.post.title if app.post else None,
            "source": app.source,
            "status": app.status,
            "applied_at": app.applied_at,
            "decided_at": app.decided_at,
            "note": app.note,
        })
    return results


def get_event_applications(
    actor,
    event_id: int,
    status_filter: Optional[str] = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Retrieve applications for an event (coordinator/admin view).
    Returns T2 semi-private data for accepted applicants,
    T1 minimal data for pending/rejected/waitlisted.
    """
    # Verify actor is event manager (read access)
    get_event_for_manager_or_404(actor, event_id, require_write=False)

    qs = EventApplications.objects.filter(
        event_id=event_id
    ).select_related("user", "post").order_by("applied_at", "id")

    if status_filter:
        qs = qs.filter(status=status_filter)

    results = []
    for app in qs:
        entry = {
            "id": app.id,
            "user_id": app.user_id,
            "display_name": app.user.display_name,
            "post_id": app.post_id,
            "post_title": app.post.title if app.post else None,
            "source": app.source,
            "status": app.status,
            "applied_at": app.applied_at,
            "decided_at": app.decided_at,
            "decided_by_id": app.decided_by_id,
            "note": app.note,
        }
        # T2 data only for accepted applicants
        if app.status == "accepted":
            u = app.user
            entry["uuid"] = str(u.uuid) if u.uuid else None
            entry["skills"] = list(u.skills or [])
            entry["physical_ok"] = u.physical_ok
            entry["good_eyesight"] = u.good_eyesight
            entry["needs_glasses"] = u.needs_glasses
            entry["can_lift_heavy"] = u.can_lift_heavy
            entry["can_work_outdoor"] = u.can_work_outdoor
            entry["has_leader_experience"] = u.has_leader_experience
            entry["new_to_volunteer"] = u.new_to_volunteer
            entry["preferred_language"] = u.preferred_language
            entry["home_area"] = u.home_area
            entry["needs_meal_support"] = u.needs_meal_support
            entry["needs_travel_support"] = u.needs_travel_support
            entry["accepts_unpaid"] = u.accepts_unpaid
            entry["verification_status"] = u.verification_status
        results.append(entry)

    return results


get_user_applications = get_own_applications


@transaction.atomic
def withdraw_application(user, application_id: int) -> EventApplications:
    """
    Volunteer withdraws their own application.
    The DB trigger cascades cancellation to any active assignment.
    """
    try:
        app = EventApplications.objects.get(id=application_id)
    except EventApplications.DoesNotExist:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Application not found.")

    # Only the applicant or an event manager can withdraw
    if user.id != app.user_id:
        get_event_for_manager_or_404(user, app.event_id, require_write=True)

    if app.status not in ("pending", "waitlisted", "accepted"):
        raise DomainError(
            code="invalid_state",
            message=f"Cannot withdraw an application with status '{app.status}'.",
            status_code=400,
        )

    app.status = "withdrawn"
    app.save()
    app.refresh_from_db()

    logger.info(
        "Application withdrawn",
        extra={"application_id": application_id, "user_id": user.id},
    )
    return app


@transaction.atomic
def _decide_application(
    actor,
    application_id: int,
    new_status: str,
    post_id: Optional[int] = None,
    note: Optional[str] = None,
) -> EventApplications:
    """
    Internal helper for coordinator decisions (accept/reject/waitlist).
    The DB trigger validates the transition, permissions, and capacity.
    """
    if new_status not in DECISION_STATUSES:
        raise DomainError(
            code="invalid_decision",
            message=f"Invalid decision status '{new_status}'.",
            status_code=400,
        )

    try:
        app = EventApplications.objects.get(id=application_id)
    except EventApplications.DoesNotExist:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Application not found.")

    # Verify actor is event manager with write access
    get_event_for_manager_or_404(actor, app.event_id, require_write=True)

    # Update fields; trigger validates transition and capacity
    app.status = new_status
    app.decided_by_id = actor.id
    app.decided_at = timezone.now()
    if post_id is not None:
        app.post_id = post_id
    if note is not None:
        app.note = note
    app.save()
    app.refresh_from_db()

    logger.info(
        "Application decided",
        extra={
            "application_id": application_id,
            "new_status": new_status,
            "decided_by": actor.id,
        },
    )
    return app


def accept_application(
    actor,
    application_id: int,
    post_id: Optional[int] = None,
) -> EventApplications:
    """Accept an application. Trigger checks capacity and may auto-assign."""
    return _decide_application(actor, application_id, "accepted", post_id=post_id)


def reject_application(
    actor,
    application_id: int,
    note: Optional[str] = None,
) -> EventApplications:
    """Reject an application."""
    return _decide_application(actor, application_id, "rejected", note=note)


def waitlist_application(actor, application_id: int) -> EventApplications:
    """Move an application to waitlisted."""
    return _decide_application(actor, application_id, "waitlisted")


def get_application_status(user, application_id: int) -> dict:
    """Return the status of a specific application (self or manager)."""
    try:
        app = EventApplications.objects.get(id=application_id)
    except EventApplications.DoesNotExist:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Application not found.")

    # Only the applicant or event manager can view
    if user.id != app.user_id:
        get_event_for_manager_or_404(user, app.event_id, require_write=False)

    return {
        "id": app.id,
        "event_id": app.event_id,
        "post_id": app.post_id,
        "source": app.source,
        "status": app.status,
        "applied_at": app.applied_at,
        "decided_at": app.decided_at,
        "decided_by_id": app.decided_by_id,
    }


def check_user_availability_for_event(user, event_id: int) -> dict:
    """
    Check if the user is available for the event's time window.
    Delegates to the SQL is_user_available() function.
    """
    try:
        event = Events.objects.get(id=event_id, deleted_at__isnull=True)
    except Events.DoesNotExist:
        raise ResourceMaskedNotFound(message="Event not found.")

    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT is_user_available(%s, %s, %s)",
            [user.id, event.start_at, event.end_at],
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        available = bool(row[0]) if row else True

    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT user_has_schedule_conflict(%s, %s, %s, %s)",
            [user.id, event.start_at, event.end_at, event_id],
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        has_conflict = bool(row[0]) if row else False

    return {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "available": available,
        "schedule_conflict": has_conflict,
    }


def expire_stale_applications() -> int:
    """
    Expire pending/waitlisted applications for ended events.
    Delegates to the SQL expire_stale_applications() function.
    Called by the maintenance scheduler.
    """
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT expire_stale_applications()")
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        return int(row[0]) if row else 0
