/**
 * @format
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import { defaultCoordinatorRepository } from '../data/mock/MockCoordinatorRepository';
import {
  approvedCoordinatorUser,
  ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  pendingCoordinatorUser,
} from '../data/mock/fixtures/demoUsers';
import {
  CoordinatorStatus,
  hasCoordinatorAccess,
  UserAccountStatus,
  UserProfileSnapshot,
} from '../domain/models';
import {
  addDataModeListener,
  DataMode,
  getDataMode,
} from './configuration/dataMode';
import { sessionManager } from '../core/auth/sessionManager';
import { authApi } from '../data/endpoints/authApi';
import type {
  OtpDeliveryDto,
  TokenizedOtpDeliveryDto,
} from '../data/dto/authDto';
import { profileApi } from '../data/endpoints/profileApi';
import { resetDiscoveryCache } from '../features/events/screens/EventDiscoveryScreen';
import { resetApplicationsCache } from '../features/events/screens/MyApplicationsScreen';
import { resetAssignmentsCache } from '../features/events/screens/MyAssignmentsScreen';

export type UserPreset = 'volunteer' | 'coordinator' | 'pending';

/**
 * Ephemeral OTP challenge state held strictly in React memory.
 * Never persisted to AsyncStorage or hardware Keystore/Keychain.
 */
export interface EphemeralChallengeState {
  authSessionToken: string;
  expiresIn: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  codeLength: number;
  delivery: TokenizedOtpDeliveryDto | OtpDeliveryDto;
  devCode?: string | null;
  phone?: string;
}

export interface RequestOtpResult {
  success: boolean;
  status?: string;
  authSessionToken?: string;
  expiresIn?: number;
  codeLength?: number;
  delivery?: TokenizedOtpDeliveryDto | OtpDeliveryDto;
  devCode?: string | null;
  error?: string;
}

export interface VerifyOtpResult {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export interface RequestTokenizedOtpParams {
  phone?: string;
  identityToken?: string;
  purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration';
}

export interface VerifyTokenizedOtpParams {
  code: string;
  displayName?: string;
}

export interface UserContextValue {
  currentUser: UserProfileSnapshot;
  setCurrentUser: (user: UserProfileSnapshot) => void;
  isCoordinator: boolean;
  switchUserPreset: (preset: UserPreset) => void;
  isAuthenticated?: boolean;
  isBootstrapping?: boolean;
  challenge?: EphemeralChallengeState | null;
  clearChallenge?: () => void;
  requestOtp?: (
    phone: string,
    purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration',
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyOtp?: (
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  requestTokenizedOtp?: (
    params: RequestTokenizedOtpParams,
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyTokenizedOtp?: (
    params: VerifyTokenizedOtpParams,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  logout?: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshSessionUser?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface FullUserContextValue extends UserContextValue {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isBootstrapping: boolean;
  challenge?: EphemeralChallengeState | null;
  clearChallenge?: () => void;
  requestOtp: (
    phone: string,
    purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration',
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyOtp: (
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  requestTokenizedOtp?: (
    params: RequestTokenizedOtpParams,
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyTokenizedOtp?: (
    params: VerifyTokenizedOtpParams,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshSessionUser: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const UserContext = createContext<UserContextValue | undefined>(
  undefined,
);

export interface UserProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialUser?: UserProfileSnapshot;
  initialAuthenticated?: boolean;
}

export function UserProvider({
  children,
  initialUser = ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  initialAuthenticated,
}: UserProviderProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [dataMode, setDataModeState] = useState<DataMode>(() => getDataMode());
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] =
    useState<UserProfileSnapshot>(initialUser);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (initialAuthenticated !== undefined) {
      return initialAuthenticated;
    }
    return getDataMode() === 'mock';
  });
  const [isBootstrapping, setIsBootstrapping] = useState<boolean>(
    () => getDataMode() === 'http',
  );

  // Ephemeral challenge state held strictly in memory, isolated from persisted DRF token
  const [challenge, setChallenge] = useState<EphemeralChallengeState | null>(null);

  // Sync with global dataMode changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = addDataModeListener(newMode => {
      setDataModeState(newMode);
      if (newMode === 'mock') {
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
        setIsBootstrapping(false);
        setChallenge(null);
      }
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  // Update mock coordinator repository whenever identity changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultCoordinatorRepository.setCoordinatorIdentity) {
      defaultCoordinatorRepository.setCoordinatorIdentity({
        id: currentUser.id,
        displayName: currentUser.displayName,
        email: currentUser.email,
      });
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  // Subscribe to session manager 401 unauthorized notifications
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = sessionManager.onUnauthorized(() => {
      resetDiscoveryCache();
      resetApplicationsCache();
      resetAssignmentsCache();
      setChallenge(null);
      if (getDataMode() === 'http') {
        setIsAuthenticated(false);
      }
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  /**
   * Refreshes active user identity.
   * PHASE 6 / API-01: Uses single-roundtrip GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/ as primary.
   * P1-01 / MAP-01: Removes phone-to-email fallback (email is null/undefined if absent).
   */
  const refreshSessionUser = useCallback(async () => {
    // Attempt single-roundtrip bootstrap first (Phase 3/6 canonical route)
    const bootRes = await authApi.getBootstrap();
    if (bootRes.ok) {
      const user = bootRes.data.user;
      const coord = bootRes.data.coordinator;
      const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
        id: String(user.id),
        displayName: user.display_name,
        phone: user.phone ?? null,
        // P1-01 / MAP-01: Absent email remains null/undefined (NO phone fallback)
        email: user.email ?? undefined,
        coordinatorStatus: (coord.status as CoordinatorStatus) || 'none',
        accountStatus: (user.account_status as UserAccountStatus) || 'active',
      };

      setCurrentUser(snapshot);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      return;
    }

    if (bootRes.status === 401) {
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      return;
    }

    // Graceful fallback to legacy profile endpoints in test environments without bootstrap mock
    const [meRes, coordRes] = await Promise.all([
      profileApi.getProfile(),
      profileApi.getCoordinatorProfile(),
    ]);

    if (!meRes.ok) {
      if (meRes.status === 401) {
        setIsAuthenticated(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
      (coordRes.ok &&
        (coordRes.data?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus)) ||
      'none';
    const acctStatus =
      (meRes.data.account_status as UserAccountStatus) || 'active';

    const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
      id: String(meRes.data.id),
      displayName: meRes.data.display_name,
      phone: meRes.data.phone ?? null,
      // P1-01 / MAP-01: Absent email remains null/undefined (NO phone fallback)
      email: (meRes.data as { email?: string | null }).email ?? undefined,
      coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
      accountStatus: acctStatus,
    };

    setCurrentUser(snapshot);
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
  }, []);

  // Session bootstrap on cold start in HTTP mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dataMode !== 'http') {
      setIsBootstrapping(false);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    setIsBootstrapping(true);

    async function bootstrap() {
      const token = await sessionManager.getToken();
      if (!token || token.trim().length === 0) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsAuthenticated(false);
          setIsBootstrapping(false);
        }
        return;
      }

      try {
        await refreshSessionUser();
      } catch {
        // Network or non-auth error: preserve token, do not invalidate
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsBootstrapping(false);
        }
      }
    }

    bootstrap();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [dataMode, refreshSessionUser]);

  /**
   * Clears the ephemeral OTP challenge state.
   */
  const clearChallenge = useCallback(() => {
    setChallenge(null);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Requests a tokenized challenge OTP code (POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/).
   * Holds the returned challenge token ephemerally in memory.
   */
  const requestTokenizedOtp = useCallback(
    async (params: RequestTokenizedOtpParams): Promise<RequestOtpResult> => {
      // Clear any prior challenge on new phone, resend, or retry
      setChallenge(null);

      const res = await authApi.requestTokenizedOtp({
        phone: params.phone,
        identity_token: params.identityToken,
        purpose: params.purpose || 'login',
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: res.error.message,
        };
      }

      const challengeData: EphemeralChallengeState = {
        authSessionToken: res.data.auth_session_token,
        expiresIn: res.data.expires_in,
        expiresAt: Date.now() + res.data.expires_in * 1000,
        codeLength: res.data.code_length,
        delivery: res.data.delivery,
        devCode: res.data.dev_code,
        phone: params.phone,
      };

      setChallenge(challengeData);

      return {
        success: true,
        status: res.data.status,
        authSessionToken: res.data.auth_session_token,
        expiresIn: res.data.expires_in,
        codeLength: res.data.code_length,
        delivery: res.data.delivery,
        devCode: res.data.dev_code,
      };
    },
    [],
  );

  /**
   * Verifies an OTP code using the active ephemeral challenge token.
   * STRICT ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANT: Does NOT send phone over the wire.
   * Persists the DRF token to sessionManager ONLY after verification succeeds.
   */
  const verifyTokenizedOtp = useCallback(
    async (params: VerifyTokenizedOtpParams): Promise<VerifyOtpResult> => {
      if (!challenge || !challenge.authSessionToken) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'No active OTP challenge found. Please request a new code.',
        };
      }

      if (Date.now() > challenge.expiresAt) {
        setChallenge(null);
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Challenge expired. Please request a new code.',
        };
      }

      const res = await authApi.verifyTokenizedOtp({
        auth_session_token: challenge.authSessionToken,
        code: params.code.trim(),
        display_name: params.displayName?.trim(),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        if (
          res.status === 409 ||
          ('code' in res.error &&
            (res.error.code === 'challenge_consumed' ||
              res.error.code === 'challenge_expired'))
        ) {
          setChallenge(null);
        }
        return {
          success: false,
          error: res.error.message,
        };
      }

      // Persist DRF token ONLY after successful verification
      await sessionManager.setToken(res.data.token);

      // Challenge is consumed — clear ephemeral challenge state
      const savedPhone = challenge.phone;
      setChallenge(null);

      // Bootstrap session via single round-trip
      try {
        await refreshSessionUser();
      } catch {
        // Fallback minimal snapshot if network fails during bootstrap
        const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
          id: String(res.data.user.id),
          displayName: res.data.user.display_name,
          phone: savedPhone ?? null,
          email: undefined, // P1-01 / MAP-01: NO phone fallback!
          coordinatorStatus: 'none',
          accountStatus: 'active',
        };
        setCurrentUser(snapshot);
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
      };
    },
    [challenge, refreshSessionUser],
  );

  /**
   * Request OTP code. Dispatches tokenized challenge if available, falling back to legacy.
   */
  const requestOtp = useCallback(
    async (
      phone: string,
      purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
    ): Promise<RequestOtpResult> => {
      setChallenge(null);

      // Attempt canonical tokenized request
      const res = await authApi.requestTokenizedOtp({ phone, purpose });
      if (res.ok) {
        const challengeData: EphemeralChallengeState = {
          authSessionToken: res.data.auth_session_token,
          expiresIn: res.data.expires_in,
          expiresAt: Date.now() + res.data.expires_in * 1000,
          codeLength: res.data.code_length,
          delivery: res.data.delivery,
          devCode: res.data.dev_code,
          phone,
        };
        setChallenge(challengeData);
        return {
          success: true,
          status: res.data.status,
          authSessionToken: res.data.auth_session_token,
          expiresIn: res.data.expires_in,
          codeLength: res.data.code_length,
          delivery: res.data.delivery,
          devCode: res.data.dev_code,
        };
      }

      // Fallback to legacy requestOtp (e.g. In mock mode or legacy unit test)
      const legacyRes = await authApi.requestOtp({ phone, purpose });
      if (!legacyRes.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: legacyRes.error.message,
        };
      }
      return {
        success: true,
        status: legacyRes.data.status,
        delivery: legacyRes.data.delivery,
        devCode: legacyRes.data.dev_code,
      };
    },
    [],
  );

  /**
   * Verify OTP code. Dispatches tokenized challenge verification if challenge is active,
   * otherwise falls back to legacy verify endpoint.
   */
  const verifyOtp = useCallback(
    async (
      phone: string,
      code: string,
      displayName?: string,
    ): Promise<VerifyOtpResult> => {
      // If we hold an active tokenized challenge, use verifyTokenizedOtp (NO phone sent!)
      if (challenge && challenge.authSessionToken) {
        return verifyTokenizedOtp({ code, displayName });
      }

      // Legacy fallback
      const res = await authApi.verifyOtp({
        phone,
        code,
        purpose: 'login',
        display_name: displayName,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: res.error.message,
        };
      }

      await sessionManager.setToken(res.data.token);
      setChallenge(null);

      try {
        await refreshSessionUser();
      } catch {
        const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
          id: String(res.data.user.id),
          displayName: res.data.user.display_name,
          phone: phone,
          email: undefined, // P1-01 / MAP-01: NO phone fallback!
          coordinatorStatus: 'none',
          accountStatus: 'active',
        };
        setCurrentUser(snapshot);
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
      };
    },
    [challenge, verifyTokenizedOtp, refreshSessionUser],
  );

  const logout = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    resetDiscoveryCache();
    resetApplicationsCache();
    resetAssignmentsCache();
    setChallenge(null);
    if (getDataMode() === 'http') {
      try {
        await authApi.logout();
      } catch {
        // Ignore server error during logout
      }
      await sessionManager.logout();
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const isCoordinator = useMemo(
    () => hasCoordinatorAccess(currentUser),
    [currentUser],
  );

  const switchUserPreset = useCallback((preset: UserPreset) => {
    switch (preset) {
      case 'coordinator':
        setCurrentUser(approvedCoordinatorUser);
        break;
      case 'pending':
        setCurrentUser(pendingCoordinatorUser);
        break;
      case 'volunteer':
      default:
        setCurrentUser(ordinaryVolunteerUser);
        break;
    }
  }, []);

  const contextValue = useMemo<FullUserContextValue>(
    () => ({
      currentUser,
      setCurrentUser,
      isCoordinator,
      switchUserPreset,
      isAuthenticated,
      isBootstrapping,
      challenge,
      clearChallenge,
      requestOtp,
      verifyOtp,
      requestTokenizedOtp,
      verifyTokenizedOtp,
      logout,
      refreshSessionUser,
    }),
    [
      currentUser,
      isCoordinator,
      switchUserPreset,
      isAuthenticated,
      isBootstrapping,
      challenge,
      clearChallenge,
      requestOtp,
      verifyOtp,
      requestTokenizedOtp,
      verifyTokenizedOtp,
      logout,
      refreshSessionUser,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <UserContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</UserContext.Provider>
  );
}

const fallbackUserContext: FullUserContextValue = {
  currentUser: ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  setCurrentUser: () => {},
  isCoordinator: false,
  switchUserPreset: () => {},
  isAuthenticated: true,
  isBootstrapping: false,
  challenge: null,
  clearChallenge: () => {},
  requestOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  verifyOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  requestTokenizedOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  verifyTokenizedOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  logout: async () => {},
  refreshSessionUser: async () => {},
};

export function useCurrentUser(): FullUserContextValue {
  const context = useContext(UserContext);
  if (!context) {
    return fallbackUserContext;
  }

  return {
    ...fallbackUserContext,
    ...context,
  };
}

/**

import { buildApiUrl, getApiConfig } from './apiConfig';
import {
  AppError,
  createNetworkError,
  createTimeoutError,
  normalizeApiError,
} from './apiError';
import { apiFailure, apiSuccess, ApiResult } from './apiResult';
import { defaultTokenStore, TokenStore } from '../auth/tokenStore';
import { sessionManager, SessionManager } from '../auth/sessionManager';

export type TransportAdapter = (
  input: string,
  init?: RequestInit,
) => Promise<Response>;

export interface RequestOptions {
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  authRequired?: boolean;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  params?: Record<
    string,
    string | number | boolean | undefined | null | Array<string | number>
  >;
}

export interface RequestTelemetry {
  requestId: string;
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE';
  url: string;
  status?: number;
  durationMs: number;
  ok: boolean;
  errorCode?: string;
}

export type TelemetryObserver = (telemetry: RequestTelemetry) => void;

/**
 * Standard fetch transport implementation.
 */
const defaultTransport: TransportAdapter = (input, init) => fetch(input, init);

/**
 * Generates a collision-resistant per-request correlation ID.
 */
function generateRequestId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    try {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    } catch {
      // Fallback to timestamp + random entropy
    }
  }
  const ts = Date.now().toString(36);
  const rand = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
  return `req-${ts}-${rand}`;
}

/**
 * Keys whose values must NEVER appear in client telemetry or diagnostic logs.
 */
const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN =
  /^(authorization|phone|raw_phone|otp|code|token|auth_token|auth_session_token|identity_token|cit|password|secret)$/i;

/**
 * Recursively redacts sensitive credentials, tokens, phone numbers, and OTPs from log/telemetry objects.
 */
export function redactSensitiveData(data: unknown): unknown {
  if (data === null || data === undefined) {
    return data;
  }
  if (typeof data !== 'object') {
    return data;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    return data.map(item => redactSensitiveData(item));
  }
  const redacted: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    if (SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN.test(key)) {
      redacted[key] = '[REDACTED]';
    } else if (typeof val === 'object' && val !== null) {
      redacted[key] = redactSensitiveData(val);
    } else {
      redacted[key] = val;
    }
  }
  return redacted;
}

/**
 * Serializes query parameters into URL search string.
 */
function serializeQueryParams(
  params?: Record<
    string,
    string | number | boolean | undefined | null | Array<string | number>
  >,
): string {
  if (!params) {
    return '';
  }
  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) {
      continue;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      for (const item of value) {
        searchParams.append(key, String(item));
      }
    } else {
      searchParams.append(key, String(value));
    }
  }
  const queryString = searchParams.toString();
  return queryString ? `?${queryString}` : '';
}

export class ApiClient {
  private transport: TransportAdapter;
  private tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private sessionMgr: SessionManager;
  private telemetryObservers: Set<TelemetryObserver> = new Set();

  constructor(
    transport: TransportAdapter = defaultTransport,
    tokenStore: TokenStore = defaultTokenStore,
    sessionMgr: SessionManager = sessionManager,
  ) {
    this.transport = transport;
    this.tokenStore = tokenStore;
    this.sessionMgr = sessionMgr;
  }

  /**
   * Registers a callback for request timing and status telemetry.
   * Telemetry payloads strictly redact Authorization, phone, OTP, CIT, and challenge tokens.
   */
  public onTelemetry(observer: TelemetryObserver): () => void {
    this.telemetryObservers.add(observer);
    return () => {
      this.telemetryObservers.delete(observer);
    };
  }

  private emitTelemetry(telemetry: RequestTelemetry): void {
    for (const observer of this.telemetryObservers) {
      try {
        observer(telemetry);
      } catch {
        // Telemetry observer exceptions must never affect API execution
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Allows injecting a custom TransportAdapter (e.g. mock transport in unit tests).
   */
  public setTransport(transport: TransportAdapter): void {
    this.transport = transport;
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether a non-empty session token is stored.
   */
  public async hasValidToken(): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.sessionMgr.hasValidToken();
  }

  /**
   * Internal request executor handling URL construction, correlation ID injection,
   * auth headers, timeouts, cancellation, 204 handling, telemetry, and error normalization.
   *
   * STRICT IDEMPOTENCY INVARIANT:
   * Non-idempotent POST requests are NEVER retried automatically. Explicit idempotency
   * key headers (Idempotency-Key / X-Idempotency-Key) are forwarded directly to the backend.
   */
  public async request<T>(
    method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE',
    endpointPath: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options: RequestOptions = {},
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const config = getApiConfig();
    const query = serializeQueryParams(options.params);
    const fullUrl = `${buildApiUrl(endpointPath, config)}${query}`;

    // Generate or preserve request correlation ID
    const requestId =
      options.headers?.['X-Request-ID'] ||
      options.headers?.['x-request-id'] ||
      generateRequestId();

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'X-Request-ID': requestId,
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    };
    headers['X-Request-ID'] = requestId;

    // Inject DRF Token header when required
    const authRequired = options.authRequired ?? true;
    if (authRequired && !headers.Authorization && !headers.authorization) {
      const token = await this.tokenStore.getToken();
      if (token && token.trim().length > 0) {
        headers.Authorization = `Token ${token.trim()}`;
      }
    }

    let requestBody: RequestInit['body'];
    if (body !== undefined && body !== null) {
      if (typeof FormData !== 'undefined' && body instanceof FormData) {
        requestBody = body as unknown as RequestInit['body'];
      } else if (typeof body === 'string') {
        requestBody = body;
        if (!headers['Content-Type']) {
          headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
        }
      } else {
        requestBody = JSON.stringify(body);
        if (!headers['Content-Type']) {
          headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
        }
      }
    }

    // Timeout & Abort management
    const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? config.defaultTimeoutMs;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let isTimedOut = false;

    let timeoutTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = setTimeout(() => {
      isTimedOut = true;
      controller.abort();
    }, timeoutMs);

    let callerAbortListener: (() => void) | null = null;
    if (options.signal) {
      if (options.signal.aborted) {
        controller.abort();
      } else {
        callerAbortListener = () => {
          controller.abort();
        };
        options.signal.addEventListener('abort', callerAbortListener);
      }
    }

    let responseStatus: number | undefined;
    let requestOk = false;
    let reportedErrorCode: string | undefined;

    try {
      const response = await this.transport(fullUrl, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: requestBody,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });

      responseStatus = response.status;

      // Handle 204 No Content
      if (response.status === 204) {
        requestOk = true;
        return apiSuccess(undefined as unknown as T, 204);
      }

      // Read response body safely
      let responseBody: unknown;
      const text = await response.text();
      if (text && text.trim().length > 0) {
        try {
          responseBody = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch {
          responseBody = text;
        }
      }

      // Check success
      if (response.ok) {
        requestOk = true;
        return apiSuccess(responseBody as T, response.status);
      }

      // STRICT 401 INVARIANT: Invalidate session ONLY on HTTP 401 Unauthorized
      if (response.status === 401) {
        await this.sessionMgr.handleUnauthorized();
      }

      const error = normalizeApiError(response.status, responseBody);
      reportedErrorCode =
        'code' in error && typeof (error as { code?: unknown }).code === 'string'
          ? (error as { code: string }).code
          : error.kind;
      return apiFailure(error, response.status);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isTimedOut) {
        const timeoutErr = createTimeoutError(`Request timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms.`);
        reportedErrorCode = timeoutErr.kind;
        return apiFailure(timeoutErr);
      }

      const message =
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Network request failed.';
      const netErr = createNetworkError(message);
      reportedErrorCode = netErr.kind;
      return apiFailure(netErr);
    } finally {
      // Guarantee timeout timer is cleared and caller AbortSignal listener is detached on ALL exit paths
      if (timeoutTimer !== null) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutTimer);
        timeoutTimer = null;
      }
      if (options.signal && callerAbortListener) {
        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', callerAbortListener);
        callerAbortListener = null;
      }

      // Emit structured request telemetry
      this.emitTelemetry({
        requestId,
        method,
        url: fullUrl,
        status: responseStatus,
        durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.now() - startTime),
        ok: requestOk,
        errorCode: reportedErrorCode,
      });
    }
  }

  public async get<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('GET', endpointPath, undefined, options);
  }

  public async post<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('POST', endpointPath, body, options);
  }

  public async patch<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PATCH', endpointPath, body, options);
  }

  public async put<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PUT', endpointPath, body, options);
  }

  public async delete<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('DELETE', endpointPath, undefined, options);
  }

  public async postMultipart<T>(
    endpointPath: string,
    formData: FormData,
    options?: RequestOptions,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('POST', endpointPath, formData, options);
  }
}

export const defaultApiClient = new ApiClient();

/**
 * @format

import {
  defaultTokenStore,
  SessionStorageError,
  TokenStore,
} from './tokenStore';

export type UnauthorizedListener = () => void;

export class SessionManager {
  private tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private unauthorizedListeners: Set<UnauthorizedListener> = new Set();

  constructor(tokenStore: TokenStore = defaultTokenStore) {
    this.tokenStore = tokenStore;
  }

  /**
   * Registers a listener callback invoked ONLY on HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses.
   * Returns an unsubscribe function.
   */
  public onUnauthorized(listener: UnauthorizedListener): () => void {
    this.unauthorizedListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.unauthorizedListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Invoked ONLY when an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response is received.
   * Clears the active auth token and notifies listeners.
   *
   * STRICT ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANT:
   * NEVER called on HTTP 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 409 (Conflict),
   * 429 (Rate Limited), 5xx (Server Error), or network/timeout errors.
   */
  public async handleUnauthorized(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.tokenStore.clearToken();
    } catch {
      // Storage clear failure during unauthorized handling must not block notifying listeners
    }
    for (const listener of this.unauthorizedListeners) {
      try {
        listener();
      } catch {
        // Listener error must not prevent other listeners from being called
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Stores a new session token.
   */
  public async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.tokenStore.setToken(token);
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves the current session token.
   */
  public async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    return this.tokenStore.getToken();
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether a non-empty token is stored.
   * Returns false if token is null, empty, or if secure storage is unavailable.
   */
  public async hasValidToken(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const token = await this.tokenStore.getToken();
      return Boolean(token && token.trim().length > 0);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof SessionStorageError) {
        return false;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Explicitly logs out the user and clears the persisted session token.
   */
  public async logout(): Promise<void> {
    await this.tokenStore.clearToken();
  }

  /**
   * Allows swapping the underlying TokenStore (useful for tests or custom store injection).
   */
  public setTokenStore(store: TokenStore): void {
    this.tokenStore = store;
  }
}

/**
 * @format

/**
 * Storage key strictly isolated to authentication token storage.
 * Isolated from theme preference (@volunteer_mgmt:theme_preference).
 */
export const AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY = '@volunteer_mgmt:auth_token';

/**
 * Controlled session storage error class for fail-closed storage operations.
 */
export class SessionStorageError extends Error {
  public readonly code: string;

  constructor(message: string, code: string = 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'SessionStorageError';
    this.code = code;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, SessionStorageError.prototype);
  }
}

export type StorageTier = 'keychain' | 'custom' | 'memory';

export interface StorageCapabilityStatus {
  tier: StorageTier;
  isSecure: boolean;
  isAvailable: boolean;
}

export interface TokenStore {
  getToken(): Promise<string | null>;
  setToken(token: string): Promise<void>;
  clearToken(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * In-memory token store strictly for explicit injection in tests and mock environments.
 * Must NEVER be used as a silent fallback in production HTTP mode.
 */
export class MemoryTokenStore implements TokenStore {
  private token: string | null = null;

  constructor(initialToken: string | null = null) {
    this.token = initialToken ? initialToken.trim() : null;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    return this.token;
  }

  async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    this.token = token.trim();
  }

  async clearToken(): Promise<void> {
    this.token = null;
  }
}

/**
 * Declared secure token store utilizing react-native-keychain (Hardware-backed Keystore / Keychain).
 * Fails closed with SessionStorageError if native secure storage is unavailable or fails.
 * Zero AsyncStorage or silent in-memory fallback in production mode.
 */
export class KeychainTokenStore implements TokenStore {
  private serviceName: string;

  constructor(serviceName: string = AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY) {
    this.serviceName = serviceName;
  }

  private getKeychain() {
    try {
      // Dynamic require ensures compatibility across environments and Jest mocking
      const keychain = require('react-native-keychain');
      return keychain.default || keychain;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  public isAvailable(): boolean {
    const kc = this.getKeychain();
    return Boolean(kc && typeof kc.setGenericPassword === 'function');
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    const kc = this.getKeychain();
    if (!kc || typeof kc.getGenericPassword !== 'function') {
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        'Secure token storage (Keychain/Keystore) is unavailable on this device.',
        'SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE',
      );
    }
    try {
      const creds = await kc.getGenericPassword({ service: this.serviceName });
      if (!creds || typeof creds !== 'object') {
        return null;
      }
      return creds.password || null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof SessionStorageError) {
        throw err;
      }
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        `Failed to retrieve authentication token from secure storage: ${msg}`,
        'SECURE_STORAGE_READ_ERROR',
      );
    }
  }

  async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    const trimmed = token.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      await this.clearToken();
      return;
    }
    const kc = this.getKeychain();
    if (!kc || typeof kc.setGenericPassword !== 'function') {
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        'Secure token storage (Keychain/Keystore) is unavailable on this device.',
        'SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE',
      );
    }
    try {
      const result = await kc.setGenericPassword('auth_token', trimmed, {
        service: this.serviceName,
      });
      if (result === false) {
        throw new SessionStorageError(
          'Secure storage driver rejected credential persistence.',
          'SECURE_STORAGE_WRITE_REJECTED',
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof SessionStorageError) {
        throw err;
      }
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        `Failed to persist authentication token to secure storage: ${msg}`,
        'SECURE_STORAGE_WRITE_ERROR',
      );
    }
  }

  async clearToken(): Promise<void> {
    const kc = this.getKeychain();
    if (!kc || typeof kc.resetGenericPassword !== 'function') {
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        'Secure token storage (Keychain/Keystore) is unavailable on this device.',
        'SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE',
      );
    }
    try {
      await kc.resetGenericPassword({ service: this.serviceName });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof SessionStorageError) {
        throw err;
      }
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      throw new SessionStorageError(
        `Failed to clear authentication token from secure storage: ${msg}`,
        'SECURE_STORAGE_CLEAR_ERROR',
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Pluggable token store adapter allowing explicitly injected custom storage (e.g. MemoryTokenStore in tests)
 * while defaulting strictly to KeychainTokenStore in production.
 */
export class PluggableTokenStore implements TokenStore {
  private fallback: TokenStore | null = null;
  private customStorage: TokenStore | null = null;
  private primary: KeychainTokenStore;

  constructor(fallback: TokenStore | null = null) {
    this.fallback = fallback;
    this.primary = new KeychainTokenStore();
  }

  public setCustomStorage(storage: TokenStore | null): void {
    this.customStorage = storage;
  }

  public async getStorageTier(): Promise<StorageTier> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return 'custom';
    }
    if (this.fallback) {
      return this.fallback instanceof MemoryTokenStore ? 'memory' : 'custom';
    }
    return 'keychain';
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.getToken();
    }
    if (this.fallback) {
      return this.fallback.getToken();
    }
    return this.primary.getToken();
  }

  async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    const trimmed = token.trim();
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.setToken(trimmed);
    }
    if (this.fallback) {
      return this.fallback.setToken(trimmed);
    }
    return this.primary.setToken(trimmed);
  }

  async clearToken(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.clearToken();
    }
    if (this.fallback) {
      return this.fallback.clearToken();
    }
    return this.primary.clearToken();
  }
}

/**
 * Exposes non-sensitive storage capability status without ever reading, exposing, or logging token values.
 */
export function getStorageCapabilityStatus(
  store?: TokenStore,
): StorageCapabilityStatus {
  if (store instanceof MemoryTokenStore) {
    return {
      tier: 'memory',
      isSecure: false,
      isAvailable: true,
    };
  }
  const primary = new KeychainTokenStore();
  return {
    tier: 'keychain',
    isSecure: true,
    isAvailable: primary.isAvailable(),
  };
}

/**
 * Default token store utilizing hardware-backed Keychain / Keystore by default,
 * while allowing injected test storage in mock and unit test suites.
 */
export const defaultTokenStore = new PluggableTokenStore();

async function waitForServer(url: string, maxAttempts = 30): Promise<boolean> {
  for (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/api/v1/charity-fields/`);
      if (res.status === 200) {
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      // Server not ready yet
    }
    await new Promise<void>(resolve => {
      setTimeout(resolve, 400);
    });
  }
  return false;
}

describe('Phase 4: Real-HTTP Integration Test Suite (No Mocks)', () => {
  let tokenStore: MemoryTokenStore;
  let sessionMgr: SessionManager;
  let client: ApiClient;

  beforeEach(() => {
    tokenStore = new MemoryTokenStore();
    sessionMgr = new SessionManager(tokenStore);
    // Real fetch transport - no custom/mock transport injected!
    client = new ApiClient(undefined, tokenStore, sessionMgr);
    setApiConfig({ baseUrl: BASE_URL_DEV });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 1: Tokenized Challenge Handshake & Session Bootstrap
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 1: Tokenized Challenge Auth & /me/bootstrap/', () => {
    it('executes real-HTTP OTP request -> verify without phone -> DRF Token -> /me/bootstrap/', async () => {
      const testPhone = `+959${Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000)}`;

      // 1. POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/
      const reqRes = await client.post<{
        status: string;
        auth_session_token: string;
        expires_in: number;
        code_length: number;
        dev_code: string;
        delivery: { delivered: boolean; configured: boolean; channel: string };
      }>(
        '/auth/tokenized/request-otp/',
        { phone: testPhone, purpose: 'login' },
        { authRequired: false },
      );

      expect(reqRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!reqRes.ok) return;

      expect(reqRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(reqRes.data.auth_session_token).toBeDefined();
      expect(reqRes.data.auth_session_token.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(40);
      expect(reqRes.data.expires_in).toBe(180);
      expect(reqRes.data.code_length).toBe(6);
      expect(reqRes.data.dev_code).toBeDefined();
      expect(reqRes.data.dev_code.length).toBe(6);
      expect(reqRes.data.delivery.delivered).toBe(false);
      expect(reqRes.data.delivery.configured).toBe(false);

      const challengeToken = reqRes.data.auth_session_token;
      const devCode = reqRes.data.dev_code;

      // 2. POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/ (Strictly NO phone sent)
      const verifyRes = await client.post<{
        token: string;
        user: { id: number; uuid: string; display_name: string; verification_status: string };
      }>(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        {
          auth_session_token: challengeToken,
          code: devCode,
          display_name: 'Real HTTP Verified Volunteer',
        },
        { authRequired: false },
      );

      expect(verifyRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!verifyRes.ok) return;

      expect(verifyRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(verifyRes.data.token).toBeDefined();
      expect(verifyRes.data.token.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(30);
      expect(verifyRes.data.user.id).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(verifyRes.data.user.display_name).toBe('Real HTTP Verified Volunteer');

      // 3. Store DRF Token in session manager
      await sessionMgr.setToken(verifyRes.data.token);
      expect(await sessionMgr.hasValidToken()).toBe(true);

      // 4. GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/ with Authorization: Token ...
      const bootRes = await client.get<{
        user: {
          id: number;
          uuid: string;
          display_name: string;
          phone: string;
          email: string | null;
          account_status: string;
          verification_status: string;
        };
        coordinator: {
          status: string;
          can_access_workspace: boolean;
        };
        capabilities: {
          volunteer: boolean;
          coordinator: boolean;
        };
      }>('/me/bootstrap/', { authRequired: true });

      expect(bootRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!bootRes.ok) return;

      expect(bootRes.status).toBe(200);
      // P1-01 / Section 8.7: email MUST be real null, never phone fallback
      expect(bootRes.data.user.email).toBeNull();
      expect(bootRes.data.user.phone).toBe(testPhone);
      expect(bootRes.data.user.account_status).toBe('active');
      expect(bootRes.data.coordinator.status).toBe('none');
      expect(bootRes.data.coordinator.can_access_workspace).toBe(false);
      expect(bootRes.data.capabilities.volunteer).toBe(true);
      expect(bootRes.data.capabilities.coordinator).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 2: Replay Prevention & Deterministic Error Mapping
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 2: OTP Replay & Parallel Verify Fail Safely', () => {
    it('fails on OTP replay with 409 challenge_consumed', async () => {
      const testPhone = `+959${Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000)}`;

      const reqRes = await client.post<{
        auth_session_token: string;
        dev_code: string;
      }>('/auth/tokenized/request-otp/', { phone: testPhone }, { authRequired: false });
      expect(reqRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!reqRes.ok) return;

      const { auth_session_token, dev_code } = reqRes.data;

      // First verify succeeds
      const v1 = await client.post(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        { auth_session_token, code: dev_code },
        { authRequired: false },
      );
      expect(v1.ok).toBe(true);

      // Second verify (replay) fails with HTTP 409 challenge_consumed
      const v2 = await client.post(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        { auth_session_token, code: dev_code },
        { authRequired: false },
      );
      expect(v2.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(v2.status).toBe(409);
      if (!v2.ok && 'code' in v2.error) {
        expect(v2.error.code).toBe('challenge_consumed');
      }
    });

    it('handles concurrent/parallel verify requests safely (one wins, one fails 409)', async () => {
      const testPhone = `+959${Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000)}`;

      const reqRes = await client.post<{
        auth_session_token: string;
        dev_code: string;
      }>('/auth/tokenized/request-otp/', { phone: testPhone }, { authRequired: false });
      expect(reqRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!reqRes.ok) return;

      const { auth_session_token, dev_code } = reqRes.data;

      // Two concurrent calls over real HTTP
      const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
        client.post(
          '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
          { auth_session_token, code: dev_code },
          { authRequired: false },
        ),
        client.post(
          '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
          { auth_session_token, code: dev_code },
          { authRequired: false },
        ),
      ]);

      const statuses = [res1.status, res2.status].sort();
      // Exactly one succeeds (200) and one fails (409)
      expect(statuses).toEqual([200, 409]);
    });

    it('rejects bogus challenge token with 400 invalid_challenge', async () => {
      const res = await client.post(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        {
          auth_session_token: 'bogus-challenge-token-that-cannot-exist-1234567890',
          code: '123456',
        },
        { authRequired: false },
      );
      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      if (!res.ok && 'code' in res.error) {
        expect(res.error.code).toBe('invalid_challenge');
      }
    });

    it('rejects wrong OTP code with 400 invalid_code', async () => {
      const testPhone = `+959${Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000)}`;

      const reqRes = await client.post<{
        auth_session_token: string;
      }>('/auth/tokenized/request-otp/', { phone: testPhone }, { authRequired: false });
      expect(reqRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!reqRes.ok) return;

      const res = await client.post(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        {
          auth_session_token: reqRes.data.auth_session_token,
          code: '000000',
        },
        { authRequired: false },
      );
      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      if (!res.ok && 'code' in res.error) {
        expect(res.error.code).toBe('invalid_code');
      }
    });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 3: Production Configuration Smoke Check
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 3: Production Configuration Smoke Check', () => {
    let prodServerProcess: ChildProcess | null = null;

    beforeAll(async () => {
      // Boot temporary production-configured live Django server on 127.0.0.1:8001
      prodServerProcess = spawn(
        pythonExecutable,
        ['backend/manage.py', 'runserver', '127.0.0.1:8001', '--noreload'],
        {
          cwd: repoRoot,
          stdio: 'ignore',
          env: {
            ...process.env,
            ENVIRONMENT: 'production',
            ALLOW_DEV_CODE_IN_AUTH_RESPONSE: 'False',
          },
        },
      );
      const ready = await waitForServer(BASE_URL_PROD, 30);
      if (!ready) {
        throw new Error('Production smoke server failed to start on 127.0.0.1:8001');
      }
    }, 20000);

    afterAll(() => {
      if (prodServerProcess) {
        prodServerProcess.kill();
        prodServerProcess = null;
      }
    });

    it('proves dev_code is strictly absent in production configuration over real HTTP', async () => {
      setApiConfig({ baseUrl: BASE_URL_PROD });
      const testPhone = `+959${Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000)}`;

      const res = await client.post<{
        status: string;
        auth_session_token: string;
        expires_in: number;
        code_length: number;
        dev_code?: string;
        delivery: { provider: string; channel: string; delivered: boolean; configured: boolean };
      }>('/auth/tokenized/request-otp/', { phone: testPhone }, { authRequired: false });

      expect(res.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!res.ok) return;

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data.auth_session_token).toBeDefined();
      // CRITICAL SECURITY INVARIANT: dev_code MUST be absent / undefined
      expect(res.data.dev_code).toBeUndefined();
      expect(res.data.delivery.delivered).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 4: Coordinator Loads Roster -> Manual Check-In -> Authoritative Match
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 4: Coordinator Loads Roster & Manual Check-In', () => {
    it('executes coordinator roster fetch -> manual check-in -> authoritative response -> refreshed roster match', async () => {
      // Authenticate as event coordinator
      await sessionMgr.setToken(fixtures.coordinatorToken);

      // 1. Coordinator loads event roster: GET /checkin/coordinator/events/:id/attendance/
      const initialRosterRes = await client.get<{
        results: Array<{
          user_id: number;
          attendance_status: string;
          method: string;
          checkin_at: string | null;
        }>;
      }>(`/checkin/coordinator/events/${fixtures.eventId}/attendance/`);

      expect(initialRosterRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!initialRosterRes.ok) return;

      expect(initialRosterRes.status).toBe(200);
      const volunteerRow = initialRosterRes.data.results.find(
        r => r.user_id === fixtures.volunteer1UserId,
      );
      expect(volunteerRow).toBeDefined();
      expect(volunteerRow?.attendance_status).not.toBe('checked_in');

      // 2. POST /api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/
      const checkinRes = await client.post<{
        attendance_id: number;
        event_id: number;
        user_id: number;
        status: string;
        method: string;
        checkin_at: string;
        recorded_by_user_id: number;
        already_checked_in: boolean;
      }>('/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/', {
        event_id: fixtures.eventId,
        user_id: fixtures.volunteer1UserId,
        note: 'Real HTTP desk checkin',
      });

      expect(checkinRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!checkinRes.ok) return;

      expect(checkinRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(checkinRes.data.status).toBe('checked_in');
      expect(checkinRes.data.method).toBe('coordinator_manual');
      expect(checkinRes.data.checkin_at).toBeDefined();
      expect(checkinRes.data.recorded_by_user_id).toBe(fixtures.coordinatorUserId);
      expect(checkinRes.data.already_checked_in).toBe(false);

      const serverTimestamp = checkinRes.data.checkin_at;

      // 3. Coordinator refreshes roster and verifies authoritative match
      const refreshedRosterRes = await client.get<{
        results: Array<{
          user_id: number;
          attendance_status: string;
          method: string;
          checkin_at: string | null;
        }>;
      }>(`/checkin/coordinator/events/${fixtures.eventId}/attendance/`);

      expect(refreshedRosterRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!refreshedRosterRes.ok) return;

      const updatedRow = refreshedRosterRes.data.results.find(
        r => r.user_id === fixtures.volunteer1UserId,
      );
      expect(updatedRow).toBeDefined();
      expect(updatedRow?.attendance_status).toBe('checked_in');
      expect(updatedRow?.method).toBe('coordinator_manual');
      expect(new Date(updatedRow?.checkin_at || '').toISOString()).toBe(
        new Date(serverTimestamp).toISOString(),
      );

      // 4. Repeated check-in call is idempotent
      const repeatRes = await client.post<{
        status: string;
        method: string;
        already_checked_in: boolean;
        checkin_at: string;
      }>('/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/', {
        event_id: fixtures.eventId,
        user_id: fixtures.volunteer1UserId,
      });

      expect(repeatRes.ok).toBe(true);
      if (!repeatRes.ok) return;

      expect(repeatRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(repeatRes.data.already_checked_in).toBe(true);
      expect(repeatRes.data.method).toBe('coordinator_manual');
      expect(new Date(repeatRes.data.checkin_at).toISOString()).toBe(
        new Date(serverTimestamp).toISOString(),
      );
    });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 5: Authorization and Resource Masking Enforcement
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 5: Authorization & Resource Masking', () => {
    it('blocks Event Owner with 403 Forbidden in monitor mode (W51/W52)', async () => {
      // Authenticate as Event Owner (current_coordinator is different)
      await sessionMgr.setToken(fixtures.ownerToken);

      const res = await client.post('/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/', {
        event_id: fixtures.eventId,
        user_id: fixtures.volunteer2UserId,
      });

      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      if (!res.ok && 'code' in res.error) {
        expect(res.error.code).toBe('owner_monitor_read_only');
      }
    });

    it('rejects unrelated coordinator with 404 resource masking', async () => {
      // Authenticate as third-party coordinator
      await sessionMgr.setToken(fixtures.unrelatedToken);

      const res = await client.post('/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/', {
        event_id: fixtures.eventId,
        user_id: fixtures.volunteer2UserId,
      });

      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('rejects unauthenticated requests with 401 Unauthorized', async () => {
      await sessionMgr.logout();

      const res = await client.post(
        '/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/',
        {
          event_id: fixtures.eventId,
          user_id: fixtures.volunteer2UserId,
        },
        { authRequired: false },
      );

      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
    });
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scenario 6: Client Session Invalidation Invariant Check
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('Scenario 6: Session Invalidation Invariant', () => {
    it('clears token and triggers listener ONLY on HTTP 401 Unauthorized', async () => {
      let unauthorizedFired = false;
      sessionMgr.onUnauthorized(() => {
        unauthorizedFired = true;
      });

      // Set an invalid token
      await sessionMgr.setToken('invalid-stale-or-revoked-token-123456');
      expect(await sessionMgr.hasValidToken()).toBe(true);

      // Call authenticated endpoint with bad token -> returns 401
      const res = await client.get('/me/bootstrap/', { authRequired: true });

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(unauthorizedFired).toBe(true);
      expect(await sessionMgr.hasValidToken()).toBe(false);
    });

    it('does NOT clear session token on HTTP 403, 404, 409, or network timeout', async () => {
      let unauthorizedFired = false;
      sessionMgr.onUnauthorized(() => {
        unauthorizedFired = true;
      });

      const validToken = fixtures.coordinatorToken;
      await sessionMgr.setToken(validToken);

      // 1. HTTP 404 (non-existent route)
      const res404 = await client.get('/nonexistent/resource/endpoint/');
      expect(res404.status).toBe(404);
      expect(unauthorizedFired).toBe(false);
      expect(await sessionMgr.getToken()).toBe(validToken);

      // 2. HTTP 400 (bad verify)
      const res400 = await client.post(
        '/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/',
        { auth_session_token: 'bogus', code: '000000' },
        { authRequired: false },
      );
      expect(res400.status).toBe(400);
      expect(unauthorizedFired).toBe(false);
      expect(await sessionMgr.getToken()).toBe(validToken);

      // 3. Network timeout simulation (timeoutMs: 1ms)
      const resTimeout = await client.get('/charity-fields/', {
        authRequired: false,
        timeoutMs: 1,
      });
      expect(resTimeout.ok).toBe(false);
      if (!resTimeout.ok) {
        expect(resTimeout.error.kind).toBe('timeout');
      }
      expect(unauthorizedFired).toBe(false);
      expect(await sessionMgr.getToken()).toBe(validToken);
    });
  });
});

import type {
  CoordinatorApplicationItem,
  CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  CoordinatorAssignmentItem,
  CoordinatorAttendanceItem,
  CoordinatorEventDetail,
  CoordinatorEventStatus,
  CoordinatorEventSummary,
  CoordinatorHistoryItem,
  CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
  CreateEventWizardDraft,
  EventPostCapacity,
  GeoAttemptReview,
  VolunteerUuidLookup,
} from '../../domain/models/coordinator';
import type { EventPost } from '../../domain/models/event';

export interface CoordinatorOperationResult<T = void> {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  data?: T;
}

export interface CoordinatorRepository {
  /**
   * Fetches high-level metrics for the coordinator dashboard.
   */
  getOverviewMetrics(): Promise<CoordinatorOverviewMetrics>;

  /**
   * Fetches the list of events owned or coordinated by the user.
   */
  getMyEvents(): Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches full coordinator details for an event by ID.
   */
  getEventDetail(eventId: string): Promise<CoordinatorEventDetail | null>;

  /**
   * Creates a new draft event using the validated wizard data.
   * Enforces that status is 'draft', version is 1, and owner is the coordinator.
   */
  createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Updates an existing event details/onboarding text (C-06, C-07).
   */
  updateEvent(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Transitions an event to a valid target status.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Creates a new post for an event (C-08).
   */
  createEventPost(
    eventId: string,
    post: {
      title: string;
      requiredHeadcount: number;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
      leaderNeeded?: boolean;
      newVolunteersAllowed?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>>;

  /**
   * Updates an event post headcount, requirements, or status (C-09).
   */
  updateEventPost(
    postId: string,
    updates: {
      requiredHeadcount?: number;
      status?: string;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>>;

  /**
   * Closes an event post to stop accepting new applications (C-10).
   */
  closeEventPost(postId: string): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<void>>;

  /**
   * Hands over event coordination to another approved coordinator (C-15).
   */
  handoverEvent(
    eventId: string,
    newCoordinatorUserId: string,
    reason?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult>;

  /**
   * Retakes event coordination as the original event owner (C-16).
   */
  retakeEvent(
    eventId: string,
    reason?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult>;

  /**
   * Fetches event coordinator handover audit history (C-18 / P1-05).
   */
  getCoordinatorHistory(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorHistoryItem[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches applications for coordinator events, optionally filtered by eventId.
   */
  getApplications(eventId?: string): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]>;

  /**
   * Updates an application status (accept, reject, waitlist).
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  updateApplicationStatus(
    applicationId: string,
    status: CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>>;

  /**
   * Invites a volunteer to an event (C-23 / V-24).
   */
  inviteVolunteer(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    postId?: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>>;

  /**
   * Fetches active and confirmed assignments for coordinator events.
   */
  getAssignments(eventId?: string): Promise<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches accepted applications that do not currently have an active assignment.
   */
  getUnassignedApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]>;

  /**
   * Runs auto-assignment demo preview.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  runAutoAssignment(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]>>;

  /**
   * Manually assigns an accepted application to a post.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  assignVolunteerManually(
    applicationId: string,
    postId: string,
    groupCode?: string,
    isGroupLeader?: boolean,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>>;

  /**
   * Cancels an existing assignment.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>>;

  /**
   * Fetches post capacity breakdown for an event (C-28 / P1-05).
   */
  getPostCapacity(eventId: string): Promise<EventPostCapacity[]>;

  /**
   * Resolves volunteer identity and capabilities by UUID for check-in / roster (C-29 / P1-05).
   */
  lookupVolunteerByUuid(
    uuid: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<VolunteerUuidLookup>;

  /**
   * Generates a new coordinator QR token for an event (C-30).
   */
  createQrToken(
    eventId: string,
    purpose: 'walkin_registration' | 'checkin' | 'join_event',
    maxUses?: number | null,
    ttlMinutes?: number,
  ): Promise<
    CoordinatorOperationResult<{
      id: number;
      rawToken: string;
      expiresAt: string;
    }>
  >;

  /**
   * Revokes an active coordinator QR token (C-31).
   */
  revokeQrToken(qrId: string): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult>;

  /**
   * Fetches the full attendance roster for an event.
   */
  getAttendanceRoster(eventId?: string): Promise<CoordinatorAttendanceItem[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches pending geo check-in attempts requiring coordinator confirmation.
   */
  getPendingGeoConfirmations(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorAttendanceItem[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches geo check-in attempts for review matching v_geo_attempts_review (C-35 / P1-05).
   */
  getGeoAttempts(eventId: string): Promise<GeoAttemptReview[]>;

  /**
   * Confirms a pending geo check-in attempt.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;

  /**
   * Rejects a pending geo check-in attempt.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;

  /**
   * Manually checks in a volunteer on-site (C-34 / ATT-02).
   * Supports explicit { eventId, volunteerUserId, note? }, (eventId, volunteerUserId, note?),
   * or legacy attendanceId lookup.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  manualCheckIn(
    params: { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  manualCheckIn(
    eventId: string | number,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  manualCheckIn(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;

  /**
   * Submits coordinator feedback for a volunteer shift (C-38).
   */
  submitCoordinatorFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult>;
}

import type {
  CharityCategory,
  EventApplicationState,
  EventDetail,
  EventFilters,
  EventSummary,
  VolunteerApplicationItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentItem,
} from '../../domain/models/event';

export interface EventApplyResult {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  application?: EventApplicationState;
}

export interface PaginatedEventsResult {
  count: number;
  next: string | null;
  previous: string | null;
  results: EventSummary[];
}

export interface OnboardingStatusResult {
  eventId: string;
  onboardingText: string | null;
  onboardingVersion: number;
  requireOnboardingAck: boolean;
  acknowledged: boolean;
}

export interface QrResolveResult {
  eventId: string;
  purpose: string;
  isValid: boolean;
  reason?: string | null;
}

export interface QrRedeemResult {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  result?: string;
  eventId?: string;
  attendanceId?: string;
  applicationId?: string;
}

export interface GeoCheckInResult {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  result?: string;
  distanceM?: number;
  confirmationStatus?: string;
  attendanceId?: string;
}

export interface EventFeedbackItem {
  id: string;
  score: number;
  comment?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface EventRepository {
  /**
   * Fetches the list of published/active events matching optional filter criteria.
   */
  getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches a paginated slice of published/active events (P1-13).
   */
  getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult>;

  /**
   * Fetches full event details by ID, including posts and current user application state.
   */
  getEventById(id: string): Promise<EventDetail | null>;

  /**
   * Fetches active charity fields taxonomy (V-19 / P1-05).
   */
  getCharityFields(): Promise<CharityCategory[]>;

  /**
   * Submits an application to an open post on an event.
   */
  applyToPost(
    eventId: string,
    postId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult>;

  /**
   * Fetches the volunteer's submitted applications.
   */
  getUserApplications(): Promise<VolunteerApplicationItem[]>;

  /**
   * Accepts a coordinator invitation to an event (V-24 / P1-06 / INV-01).
   */
  acceptInvite(
    applicationId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; applicationId: string }>;

  /**
   * Declines / rejects a coordinator invitation to an event (P1-06 / INV-01).
   */
  rejectInvite(
    applicationId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; applicationId: string }>;

  /**
   * Withdraws a pending or waitlisted volunteer application.
   */
  withdrawApplication(
    applicationId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;

  /**
   * Fetches the volunteer's assigned, confirmed, and completed shifts.
   */
  getUserAssignments(): Promise<VolunteerAssignmentItem[]>;

  /**
   * Confirms the volunteer's assigned shift participation.
   */
  confirmAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;

  /**
   * Cancels the volunteer's own scheduled shift participation (not the event).
   * Completed participation cannot be cancelled.
   */
  cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;

  /**
   * Fetches the onboarding briefing status for an event (V-31).
   */
  getEventOnboarding(eventId: string): Promise<OnboardingStatusResult>;

  /**
   * Acknowledges the onboarding briefing for an event (V-32).
   */
  acknowledgeOnboarding(
    eventId: string,
    notes?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; acknowledged: boolean }>;

  /**
   * Previews / resolves a QR token without consuming it (V-33).
   */
  resolveQrToken(token: string): Promise<QrResolveResult>;

  /**
   * Redeems a QR token (check-in, walk-in, join event) (V-34).
   */
  redeemQrToken(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult>;

  /**
   * Checks in using a QR token (V-35).
   */
  qrCheckIn(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult>;

  /**
   * Submits volunteer geo check-in telemetry for an event (V-36).
   */
  submitGeoCheckIn(
    eventId: string,
    latitude: number,
    longitude: number,
    accuracyM?: number,
  ): Promise<GeoCheckInResult>;

  /**
   * Checks out of an active attendance shift (V-37).
   */
  checkOutAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; checkedOutAt?: string }>;

  /**
   * Submits feedback for an event (V-40).
   */
  submitEventFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
    direction?:
      | 'coordinator_to_volunteer'
      | 'volunteer_to_event'
      | 'volunteer_to_coordinator',
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; feedbackId?: string }>;

  /**
   * Fetches public feedback list for an event (P1-12).
   */
  getEventFeedbackList(eventId: string): Promise<EventFeedbackItem[]>;
}

/**
 * @format
 */

/**
 * Request payload for legacy `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request/`.
 */
export interface OtpRequestDto {
  phone: string;
  purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration';
}

/**
 * Details of OTP delivery channel and status (P0-09).
 */
export interface OtpDeliveryDto {
  delivered: boolean;
  channel: string;
  method?: string;
  provider_configured?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Success response for legacy `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request/`.
 */
export interface OtpRequestResponseDto {
  status: string;
  delivery?: OtpDeliveryDto;
  dev_code?: string;
}

/**
 * Request payload for legacy `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify/`.
 */
export interface OtpVerifyDto {
  phone: string;
  code: string;
  purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration';
  display_name?: string;
}

/**
 * User object nested inside OtpVerifyResponseDto and TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseDto.
 */
export interface AuthUserDto {
  id: number;
  uuid: string | null;
  display_name: string;
  verification_status: string;
}

/**
 * Success response for legacy `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify/`.
 */
export interface OtpVerifyResponseDto {
  token: string;
  user: AuthUserDto;
}

// =========================================================================
// Phase 6 Tokenized Challenge Handshake DTOs (AUTH-02, AUTH-03)
// =========================================================================

/**
 * Truthful delivery metadata returned in TokenizedOtpResponseDto.
 */
export interface TokenizedOtpDeliveryDto {
  provider: string;
  channel: string;
  delivered: boolean;
  configured: boolean;
}

/**
 * Request payload for `POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/`.
 * Accepts phone (over TLS) or identity_token (CIT envelope), with optional request_id.
 */
export interface TokenizedOtpRequestDto {
  phone?: string;
  identity_token?: string;
  purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration';
  request_id?: string;
}

/**
 * Success response for `POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/request-otp/`.
 * Returns ephemeral auth_session_token, expiry, code length, and delivery metadata.
 */
export interface TokenizedOtpResponseDto {
  status: string;
  auth_session_token: string;
  expires_in: number;
  code_length: number;
  delivery: TokenizedOtpDeliveryDto;
  dev_code?: string | null;
}

/**
 * Request payload for `POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/`.
 * STRICT ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANT:
 * MUST NOT accept or contain a `phone` property. Verification is bound
 * to the session-bound challenge token and code only.
 */
export interface TokenizedOtpVerifyRequestDto {
  auth_session_token: string;
  code: string;
  display_name?: string;
}

/**
 * User object returned in TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseDto.
 */
export interface TokenizedAuthUserDto {
  id: number;
  uuid: string | null;
  display_name: string;
  verification_status: string;
}

/**
 * Success response for `POST /api/v1/auth/tokenized/verify-otp/`.
 * Returns the DRF token and initial user identity.
 */
export interface TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseDto {
  token: string;
  user: TokenizedAuthUserDto;
}

// =========================================================================
// Phase 6 Compact Startup Bootstrap DTOs (API-01, Section 8.7)
// =========================================================================

/**
 * Identity payload returned by `GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/`.
 * P1-01 / MAP-01: email is explicitly null or string; never phone fallback.
 */
export interface BootstrapUserDto {
  id: number;
  uuid: string | null;
  display_name: string;
  phone: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  account_status: string;
  verification_status: string;
}

/**
 * Coordinator routing and permission payload in `GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/`.
 */
export interface BootstrapCoordinatorDto {
  status: string; // 'none' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'suspended' | 'revoked'
  can_access_workspace: boolean;
}

/**
 * Server-derived capabilities in `GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/`.
 */
export interface BootstrapCapabilitiesDto {
  volunteer: boolean;
  coordinator: boolean;
}

/**
 * Response payload for `GET /api/v1/me/bootstrap/`.
 * Replaces parallel getProfile + getCoordinatorProfile startup roundtrips.
 */
export interface BootstrapResponseDto {
  user: BootstrapUserDto;
  coordinator: BootstrapCoordinatorDto;
  capabilities: BootstrapCapabilitiesDto;
}

/**
 * @format
 */

import { ApiClient, defaultApiClient } from '../../core/api/apiClient';
import type { ApiResult } from '../../core/api/apiResult';
import type {
  BootstrapResponseDto,
  OtpRequestDto,
  OtpRequestResponseDto,
  OtpVerifyDto,
  OtpVerifyResponseDto,
  TokenizedOtpRequestDto,
  TokenizedOtpResponseDto,
  TokenizedOtpVerifyRequestDto,
  TokenizedOtpVerifyResponseDto,
} from '../dto/authDto';

export interface LogoutResponseDto {
  status: string;
  message?: string;
}

export const authApi = {
  /**
   * Request OTP code via legacy route.
   * Public endpoint (no auth required).
   */
  requestOtp(
    data: OtpRequestDto,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<OtpRequestResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<OtpRequestResponseDto>('auth/otp/request/', data, {
      authRequired: false,
    });
  },

  /**
   * Verify OTP code via legacy route.
   * Public endpoint (no auth required).
   */
  verifyOtp(
    data: OtpVerifyDto,

  verifyTokenizedOtp(

/**
