 */

import { ApiClient, defaultApiClient } from '../../core/api/apiClient';
import type {
  CoordinatorApplicationItem,
  CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  CoordinatorAssignmentItem,
  CoordinatorAttendanceItem,
  CoordinatorEventDetail,
  CoordinatorEventStatus,
  CoordinatorEventSummary,
  CoordinatorHistoryItem,
  CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
  CreateEventWizardDraft,
  EventPostCapacity,
  EventPurposeType,
  GeoAttemptReview,
  VolunteerUuidLookup,
} from '../../domain/models/coordinator';
import type {
  CoordinatorOperationResult,
  CoordinatorRepository,
} from '../contracts/coordinatorRepository';
import { coordinatorApi } from '../endpoints/coordinatorApi';
import { checkinApi } from '../endpoints/checkinApi';
import { eventApi } from '../endpoints/eventApi';
import { profileApi } from '../endpoints/profileApi';
import {
  mapAttendanceRosterItem,
  mapCoordinatorApplication,
  mapCoordinatorAssignment,
  mapCoordinatorEventSummary,
  mapCoordinatorHistoryItem,
  mapCreateEventDraftToRequest,
  mapEventPostCapacity,
  mapGeoAttemptReview,
  mapVolunteerUuidLookup,
} from '../mappers/coordinatorMapper';
import { mapPublicEventPost } from '../mappers/eventMapper';
import type { PublicEventPostDto } from '../dto/eventDto';
import type { EventPost } from '../../domain/models/event';
import type {
  AttendanceRosterDto,
  CoordinatorApplicationDto,
  CoordinatorAssignmentDto,
  CoordinatorEventListItemDto,
  CoordinatorHistoryItemDto,
  EventPostCapacityDto,
} from '../dto/coordinatorDto';
import type { GeoAttemptReviewDto } from '../dto/checkinDto';
import type { UserUuidLookupDto } from '../dto/profileDto';

export class HttpCoordinatorRepository implements CoordinatorRepository {
  private client: ApiClient;
  private appToEventMap: Map<string, string> = new Map();
  private applicationCache: Map<string, CoordinatorApplicationItem> = new Map();
  private attendanceCache: Map<string, CoordinatorAttendanceItem> = new Map();
  private inFlightMyEventsPromise: Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]> | null =
    null;
  private coordinatorIdentity = {
    id: 'usr-coord',
    displayName: 'Coordinator',
    email: 'coordinator@example.com',
  };

  constructor(client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  public setCoordinatorIdentity(identity: {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    email?: string;
  }): void {
    this.coordinatorIdentity = {
      id: identity.id,
      displayName: identity.displayName,
      email: identity.email ?? 'coordinator@example.com',
    };
  }

  public getCoordinatorIdentity(): {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    email: string;
  } {
    return { ...this.coordinatorIdentity };
  }

  public async getMyEvents(): Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]> {
    if (this.inFlightMyEventsPromise) {
      return this.inFlightMyEventsPromise;
    }

    this.inFlightMyEventsPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await coordinatorApi.getMyEvents(this.client);
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Failed to load events: ${res.error.message}`);
        }

        const list: CoordinatorEventListItemDto[] = res.data.results || [];
        const summaries = await Promise.all(
          list.map(e =>
            coordinatorApi.getEventSummary(e.id, this.client).catch(() => null),
          ),
        );

        return list.map((e, idx) => {
          const summaryRes = summaries[idx];
          const summaryDto =
            summaryRes && summaryRes.ok ? summaryRes.data : null;
          return mapCoordinatorEventSummary(e, summaryDto);
        });
      } finally {
        this.inFlightMyEventsPromise = null;
      }
    })();

    return this.inFlightMyEventsPromise;
  }

  public async getOverviewMetrics(): Promise<CoordinatorOverviewMetrics> {
    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const totalEventsCount = events.length;
    const activeEventsCount = events.filter(
      e => e.status === 'active' || e.status === 'published',
    ).length;
    const draftEventsCount = events.filter(e => e.status === 'draft').length;

    let pendingApplicationsCount = 0;
    let acceptedApplicantsCount = 0;
    let checkedInTodayCount = 0;

    for (const e of events) {
      pendingApplicationsCount += e.pendingApplicationCount || 0;
      acceptedApplicantsCount += e.acceptedApplicantCount || 0;
      checkedInTodayCount += e.checkedInCount || 0;
    }

    return {
      totalEventsCount,
      activeEventsCount,
      draftEventsCount,
      pendingApplicationsCount,
      acceptedApplicantsCount,
      checkedInTodayCount,
    };
  }

  public async getEventDetail(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorEventDetail | null> {
    const [summaryRes, postsRes, eventsRes, publicDetailRes] = await Promise.all([
      coordinatorApi.getEventSummary(eventId, this.client),
      coordinatorApi.getEventPosts(eventId, this.client).catch(() => null),
      coordinatorApi.getMyEvents(this.client).catch(() => null),
      eventApi.getEventDetail(eventId, this.client).catch(() => null),
    ]);

    if (!summaryRes.ok) {
      if (summaryRes.status === 404) {
        return null;
      }
      throw new Error(`Failed to load event detail: ${summaryRes.error.message}`);
    }

    const summary = summaryRes.data;
    const events: CoordinatorEventListItemDto[] =
      eventsRes && eventsRes.ok && eventsRes.data?.results ? eventsRes.data.results : [];
    const currentEventItem = events.find(e => String(e.id) === String(eventId));

    const publicDetail =
      publicDetailRes && publicDetailRes.ok ? publicDetailRes.data : null;

    let rawPosts: PublicEventPostDto[] = [];
    if (publicDetail?.posts && Array.isArray(publicDetail.posts) && publicDetail.posts.length > 0) {
      rawPosts = publicDetail.posts;
    } else if (postsRes && postsRes.ok) {
      rawPosts = Array.isArray(postsRes.data)
        ? postsRes.data
        : postsRes.data?.results || [];
    }

    const isMonitor = currentEventItem?.is_read_only_monitor ?? false;

    return {
      id: String(summary.id),
      title: publicDetail?.title || summary.title,
      description: publicDetail?.description || '',
      status:
        (publicDetail?.status as CoordinatorEventStatus) ||
        (summary.status as CoordinatorEventStatus) ||
        'draft',
      purposeType:
        (publicDetail?.purpose_type as EventPurposeType) || 'charity_event',
      startAt: publicDetail?.start_at || summary.start_at,
      endAt: publicDetail?.end_at || summary.end_at,
      applicationDeadline: publicDetail?.application_deadline ?? undefined,
      locationName: publicDetail?.location_name || 'Designated Location',
      landmarkText: publicDetail?.landmark_text ?? undefined,
      charityFields: (publicDetail?.charity_fields as any[]) || [],
      ownerId: currentEventItem ? String(currentEventItem.owner_id) : this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      currentCoordinatorId: currentEventItem ? String(currentEventItem.current_coordinator_id) : this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      coordinatorName: publicDetail?.coordinator_name || this.coordinatorIdentity.displayName,
      isOwnerAsMonitor: isMonitor,
      pendingApplicationCount: summary.pending_count || 0,
      acceptedApplicantCount: summary.accepted_count || 0,
      assignedCount: summary.assignment_count || 0,
      checkedInCount: summary.checked_in_count || 0,
      latitude: typeof publicDetail?.latitude === 'number'
        ? publicDetail.latitude
        : parseFloat(String(publicDetail?.latitude || 0)) || 0,
      longitude: typeof publicDetail?.longitude === 'number'
        ? publicDetail.longitude
        : parseFloat(String(publicDetail?.longitude || 0)) || 0,
      geoRadiusM: publicDetail?.geo_radius_m ?? 200,
      geoCheckinEnabled: publicDetail?.geo_checkin_enabled ?? summary.geo_checkin_enabled ?? true,
      geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin: 30,
      requireCheckinConfirmation: summary.pending_confirmations > 0,
      mapProvider: publicDetail?.map_provider || summary.map_provider || 'openstreetmap',
      acceptanceMode: (publicDetail?.acceptance_mode as any) || (summary.acceptance_mode as any) || 'manual',
      autoAssignEnabled: summary.auto_assign_enabled ?? false,
      leaderStrategy: 'none',
      maxParticipants: publicDetail?.max_participants ?? summary.max_participants ?? 0,
      mealsProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.meals_provided),
      lodgingProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.lodging_provided),
      travelSupportProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.travel_support_provided),
      compensationKind: (publicDetail?.compensation_kind as any) || 'unpaid',
      compensationNote: publicDetail?.compensation_note ?? undefined,
      onboardingText: publicDetail?.onboarding_text ?? undefined,
      onboardingVersion: publicDetail?.onboarding_version ?? 1,
      requireOnboardingAck: false,
      qrRegistrationEnabled: false,
      posts: rawPosts.map(p => mapPublicEventPost(p, summary.id)),
    };
  }

  public async createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const payload = mapCreateEventDraftToRequest(draft);
    const res = await coordinatorApi.createEvent(payload, this.client);

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

  }

  public async updateEvent(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const payload = mapCreateEventDraftToRequest(data as CreateEventWizardDraft);
    const res = await coordinatorApi.updateEvent(eventId, payload, this.client);

      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,

    };
  }

  public async transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    let res;
    if (targetStatus === 'published') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.publishEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'active') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.activateEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'completed') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.completeEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'cancelled') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.cancelEvent(
        eventId,
        'Cancelled by coordinator',
        this.client,
      );
    } else {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Unsupported event status transition to '${targetStatus}'.`,
      };
    }

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const updated = await this.getEventDetail(eventId);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Event transitioned to ${targetStatus}`,
      data: updated ?? undefined,
    };
  }

      message: 'Post created successfully',
      data: createdPost,
    };
  }

  public async getApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]> {
    if (eventId) {
      const res = await coordinatorApi.getApplications(
        eventId,
        undefined,
        this.client,
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load applications: ${res.error.message}`);
      }
      const list: CoordinatorApplicationDto[] = res.data.results || [];
      const items = list.map(a => {
        const mapped = mapCoordinatorApplication(a, eventId);
        this.appToEventMap.set(mapped.id, String(eventId));
        this.applicationCache.set(mapped.id, mapped);
        return mapped;
      });
      return items;
    }

    // If no eventId, aggregate over coordinator's events
    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const appLists = await Promise.all(
      events.map(e => this.getApplications(e.id).catch(() => [])),
    );
    return appLists.flat();
  }

  public async updateApplicationStatus(
    applicationId: string,
    status: CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {
    const action =
      status === 'accepted'
        ? 'accept'
        : status === 'rejected'
        ? 'reject'
        : 'waitlist';

    const res = await coordinatorApi.decideApplication(
      applicationId,
      action,
      {},
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    // P0-02: Merge updated status into cached application item or refetch from event
    let updatedItem = this.applicationCache.get(applicationId);
    if (updatedItem) {
      updatedItem = {
        ...updatedItem,
        status,
      };
      this.applicationCache.set(applicationId, updatedItem);
    } else {
      const eventId = this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId);
      if (eventId) {
        const apps = await this.getApplications(eventId);
        updatedItem = apps.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
      }
    }

    if (!updatedItem) {
      updatedItem = {
        id: applicationId,
        eventId: this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId) || '',
        eventTitle: 'Volunteer Event',
        userId: '88',
        applicantName: 'Volunteer Applicant',
        status,
        source: 'browse',
        appliedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Application ${status} successfully`,
      data: updatedItem,
    };
  }

  public async inviteVolunteer(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    postId?: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {

    );

      return {
        success: false,

      };
    }

    const item = mapCoordinatorApplication(res.data, eventId);
    this.applicationCache.set(item.id, item);
    this.appToEventMap.set(item.id, eventId);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Volunteer invited successfully',
      data: item,
    };
  }

  public async assignVolunteerManually(
    applicationId: string,
    postId: string,
    groupCode?: string,
    isGroupLeader?: boolean,
    eventIdOverride?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const eventId = eventIdOverride || this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId);
    if (!eventId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Unable to determine event for volunteer assignment.',
      };
    }

    const numericPostId =
      !postId || !postId.trim() || isNaN(Number(postId)) || Number(postId) <= 0
        ? null
        : Number(postId);
    const res = await coordinatorApi.manualAssign(
      eventId,
      {
        application_id: Number(applicationId),
        post_id: numericPostId,
        group_code: groupCode ?? null,
        is_group_leader: isGroupLeader ?? false,
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    // P1-03: Deterministically refetch assignments from server; do not fabricate fake assignment fallback
    const assignments = await this.getAssignments(eventId);
    const returnedAssignmentId =
      res.data.assignment_id != null
        ? String(res.data.assignment_id)
        : res.data.id != null
        ? String(res.data.id)
        : null;
    const created = assignments.find(
      a =>
        (returnedAssignmentId !== null && a.id === returnedAssignmentId) ||
        (Boolean(a.applicationId) && a.applicationId === applicationId),
    );

    if (created) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'Volunteer assigned successfully',
        data: created,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'Assignment succeeded on server but failed to synchronize updated assignment record.',
    };
  }

    };
  }

  public async confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.confirmAttendance(
      attendanceId,
      'Confirmed by coordinator',
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const cached = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
    if (cached) {
      cached.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
      cached.status = 'checked_in';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Geo attendance confirmed',
      data: cached,
    };
  }

  public async rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.rejectAttendance(
      attendanceId,
      'Rejected by coordinator',
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const cached = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
    if (cached) {
      cached.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
      cached.status = 'scheduled';
      if (cached.geoAttempt) {
        cached.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'rejected';
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Geo attendance rejected',
      data: cached,
    };
  }

  public async manualCheckIn(
    params: { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    eventId: string | number,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    arg1: string | number | { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
    arg2?: string | number,
    arg3?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    let targetEventId: number | null = null;
    let targetUserId: number | null = null;
    let targetNote: string | undefined = undefined;
    let cachedRecord: CoordinatorAttendanceItem | undefined = undefined;

    if (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null && 'eventId' in arg1 && 'volunteerUserId' in arg1) {
      targetEventId = Number(arg1.eventId);
      targetUserId = Number(arg1.volunteerUserId);
      targetNote = arg1.note;
    } else if (arg2 !== undefined && arg2 !== null) {
      targetEventId = Number(arg1);
      targetUserId = Number(arg2);
      targetNote = arg3;
    } else {
      const attendanceId = String(arg1);
      cachedRecord = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
      if (!cachedRecord) {
        for (const item of this.attendanceCache.values()) {
          if (item.id === attendanceId || item.assignmentId === attendanceId) {
            cachedRecord = item;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!cachedRecord) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: 'Attendance record not found in active roster cache.',
        };
      }

      targetEventId = Number(cachedRecord.eventId);
      targetUserId = Number(cachedRecord.userId);
      targetNote = 'Manual on-site check-in';
    }

    if (!targetEventId || isNaN(targetEventId) || !targetUserId || isNaN(targetUserId)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid event or volunteer user identifier for manual check-in.',
      };
    }

    // Call canonical BFF endpoint: POST /api/v1/checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/
    const res = await checkinApi.manualCheckIn(
      {
        event_id: targetEventId,
        user_id: targetUserId,
        note: targetNote ?? 'Manual on-site check-in',
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const data = res.data;
    const attendanceIdStr = String(data.attendance_id || data.id);

    // If item was in cache or can be found in cache
    if (!cachedRecord) {
      cachedRecord = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceIdStr);
      if (!cachedRecord) {
        for (const item of this.attendanceCache.values()) {
          if (
            (item.id === attendanceIdStr || item.userId === String(targetUserId)) &&
            item.eventId === String(targetEventId)
          ) {
            cachedRecord = item;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (cachedRecord) {
      cachedRecord.status = (data.status as any) || 'checked_in';
      // Authoritative method from server: never overwrite qr_scan / geo to manual
      if (data.method) {
        cachedRecord.checkInMethod = (data.method as any);
      }
      // Authoritative server timestamp (never fabricated with new Date())
      cachedRecord.checkedInAt = data.checkin_at;
      // Do not clear pending geo confirmation unless verified by server
      if (data.status === 'checked_in' || data.status === 'completed') {
        cachedRecord.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
      }
    }

    const resultItem: CoordinatorAttendanceItem = cachedRecord
      ? { ...cachedRecord }
      : {
          id: attendanceIdStr,
          eventId: String(targetEventId),
          eventTitle: 'Event',
          assignmentId: attendanceIdStr,
          userId: String(targetUserId),
          volunteerName: 'Volunteer',
          postTitle: 'Assigned Role',
          status: (data.status as any) || 'checked_in',
          checkInMethod: (data.method as any) || 'coordinator_manual',
          checkedInAt: data.checkin_at,
          isPendingGeoConfirmation: false,
        };

    // Store in cache for subsequent lookups
    this.attendanceCache.set(resultItem.id, resultItem);
    this.attendanceCache.set(resultItem.userId, resultItem);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: data.already_checked_in
        ? 'Volunteer already checked in'
        : 'Volunteer checked in manually',
      data: resultItem,
    };
  }

  public async createQrToken(
    eventId: string,
    purpose: 'walkin_registration' | 'checkin' | 'join_event',
    maxUses?: number | null,
    ttlMinutes: number = 240,
  ): Promise<
    CoordinatorOperationResult<{
      id: number;
      rawToken: string;
      expiresAt: string;
    }>
  > {
    const res = await checkinApi.createCoordinatorQrToken(
      eventId,
      {
        purpose,
        max_uses: maxUses,
        ttl_minutes: ttlMinutes,
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'QR token generated successfully',
      data: {
        id: res.data.id,
        rawToken: res.data.raw_token,
        expiresAt: res.data.expires_at,
      },
    };
  }

  public async revokeQrToken(
    qrId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const res = await checkinApi.revokeCoordinatorQrToken(qrId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'QR token revoked successfully',
    };
  }

  public async getPostCapacity(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<EventPostCapacity[]> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.getPostCapacity(eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load post capacity: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    const list = res.data.results || [];
    return list.map(mapEventPostCapacity);
  }

  public async lookupVolunteerByUuid(
    uuid: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<VolunteerUuidLookup> {
    const res = await profileApi.lookupUserByUuid(uuid, eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to lookup volunteer by UUID: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return mapVolunteerUuidLookup(res.data);
  }

  public async getGeoAttempts(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<GeoAttemptReview[]> {
    const res = await checkinApi.getGeoAttempts(eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load geo attempts: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    const list = res.data.results || [];
    return list.map(mapGeoAttemptReview);
  }

  public async submitCoordinatorFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const res = await checkinApi.submitEventFeedback(

        target_user_id: Number(volunteerUserId),

        tags: tags || [],
      },
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,

      };

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator feedback submitted successfully',
    };
  }
}

  public async getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]> {
    const params: EventQueryParams = {};

    if (filters) {
      if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
        params.search = filters.query.trim();
      }
      if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
        params.charity_field = filters.charityFieldCodes.join(',');
      }
      if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length === 1) {
        params.status = filters.statuses[0];
      }
      if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
        params.meals_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
        params.lodging_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
        params.travel_support_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.startAfter) {
        params.starts_after = filters.startAfter;
      }
      if (filters.endBefore) {
        params.starts_before = filters.endBefore;
      }
    }

    const res = await eventApi.getEvents(params, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load events: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    const events: PublicEventDto[] = Array.isArray(res.data)
      ? res.data
      : 'results' in res.data
      ? res.data.results
      : [];

    return events.map(mapPublicEventSummary);
  }

  public async getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page: number = 1,
    pageSize: number = 20,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult> {
    const params: EventQueryParams = {
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
    };

    if (filters) {
      if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
        params.search = filters.query.trim();
      }
      if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
        params.charity_field = filters.charityFieldCodes.join(',');
      }
      if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length === 1) {
        params.status = filters.statuses[0];
      }
      if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
        params.meals_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
        params.lodging_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
        params.travel_support_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.startAfter) {
        params.starts_after = filters.startAfter;
      }
      if (filters.endBefore) {
        params.starts_before = filters.endBefore;
      }
    }

    const res = await eventApi.getEvents(params, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load paginated events: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    const count =
      'count' in res.data && typeof res.data.count === 'number'
        ? res.data.count
        : Array.isArray(res.data)
        ? res.data.length
        : 0;
    const next = 'next' in res.data ? res.data.next : null;
    const previous = 'previous' in res.data ? res.data.previous : null;
    const events: PublicEventDto[] = Array.isArray(res.data)
      ? res.data
      : 'results' in res.data
      ? res.data.results
      : [];

    return {
      count,
      next,
      previous,
      results: events.map(mapPublicEventSummary),
    };
  }

  public async getEventById(id: string): Promise<EventDetail | null> {
    const hasToken = await this.client.hasValidToken();

    const [eventRes, postsRes, appsRes] = await Promise.all([
      eventApi.getEventDetail(id, this.client),
      eventApi.getEventPosts(id, this.client),
      hasToken
        ? eventApi.getMyApplications({ event_id: id }, this.client)
        : Promise.resolve({
            ok: true as const,
            status: 200,
            data: { results: [] as VolunteerApplicationDto[] },
          }),
    ]);

    if (!eventRes.ok) {
      if (eventRes.status === 404) {
        return null;
      }
      throw new Error(`Failed to load event: ${eventRes.error.message}`);
    }

    let posts: PublicEventPostDto[] = [];
    if (postsRes.ok) {
      posts = Array.isArray(postsRes.data)
        ? postsRes.data
        : 'results' in postsRes.data
        ? postsRes.data.results
        : [];
    } else if (eventRes.data.posts && eventRes.data.posts.length > 0) {
      posts = eventRes.data.posts;
    }

    if (posts.length > 0) {
      eventRes.data.posts = posts;
    }

    let userAppDto: VolunteerApplicationDto | null = null;
    if (appsRes.ok) {
      const apps: VolunteerApplicationDto[] = Array.isArray(appsRes.data)
        ? appsRes.data
        : 'results' in appsRes.data
        ? appsRes.data.results
        : [];

      userAppDto = apps.find(a => String(a.event_id) === String(id)) ?? null;
    }

    return mapPublicEventDetail(eventRes.data, userAppDto);
  }

  public async applyToPost(
    eventId: string,
    postId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult> {
    const numericPostId = isNaN(Number(postId)) ? null : Number(postId);
    const res = await eventApi.applyToEvent(
      eventId,
      {
        event_id: Number(eventId),
        post_id: numericPostId,
        note: note ?? '',
        source: 'browse',
      },
      this.client,
    );

      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };

    const app = res.data;
    const applicationState: EventApplicationState = {
      id: String(app.id),
      eventId: String(app.event_id),
      postId: app.post_id ? String(app.post_id) : postId,
      postTitle: app.post_title || 'Applied Role',
      status: (app.status as EventApplicationStatus) || 'pending',
      appliedAt: app.applied_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      volunteerNote: app.note ?? note,
    };

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Application submitted successfully',
      application: applicationState,
    };
  }

describe('Phase 8: Onboarding, QR, Attendance & Feedback Integration', () => {
  let mockClient: ApiClient;
  let eventRepo: HttpEventRepository;
  let coordinatorRepo: HttpCoordinatorRepository;

  beforeEach(() => {

      sessionManager,

    coordinatorRepo.setCoordinatorIdentity({
      id: 'usr-coord-99',
      displayName: 'Alice Coordinator',
      email: 'alice@example.com',
    });
  });

  describe('1. Volunteer Onboarding Briefing & Acknowledgment', () => {
    it('fetches event onboarding briefing status', async () => {

        event_id: 101,
        onboarding_text: 'Please review safety protocols before arrival.',
        onboarding_version: 2,
        require_onboarding_ack: true,
        acknowledged: false,
      };

      jest
        .spyOn(checkinApi, 'getOnboarding')
        .mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, status: 200, data: mockStatus });

      const result = await eventRepo.getEventOnboarding!('101');

      expect(result.eventId).toBe('101');
      expect(result.onboardingText).toBe('Please review safety protocols before arrival.');
      expect(result.onboardingVersion).toBe(2);
      expect(result.requireOnboardingAck).toBe(true);
      expect(result.acknowledged).toBe(false);
    });

    it('acknowledges event onboarding briefing', async () => {

        event_id: 101,
        onboarding_version: 2,
        acknowledged: true,
      };

      const ackSpy = jest
        .spyOn(checkinApi, 'acknowledgeOnboarding')

      const result = await eventRepo.acknowledgeOnboarding!('101', 'Reviewed gear checklist');

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.acknowledged).toBe(true);

      );
    });
  });

  describe('2. Volunteer Geo Check-In Telemetry & Error Normalization', () => {
    it('handles successful geo check-in within geofence', async () => {
      const mockResponse: GeoCheckinResponseDto = {
        result: 'accepted',
        attendance_id: 801,
        distance_m: 25.5,
        confirmation_status: 'confirmed',
        message: 'Checked in successfully within event geofence.',
        success: true,
      };

      const checkInSpy = jest
        .spyOn(checkinApi, 'submitGeoCheckIn')
        .mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, status: 200, data: mockResponse });

      const result = await eventRepo.submitGeoCheckIn!('101', 16.805, 96.155, 10);

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.result).toBe('accepted');
      expect(result.distanceM).toBeCloseTo(25.5);
      expect(result.attendanceId).toBe('801');
      expect(checkInSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        {
          event_id: 101,
          latitude: 16.805,
          longitude: 96.155,
          accuracy_m: 10,
        },
        mockClient,
      );
    });

    it('preserves distance_m and error message on outside_geofence HTTP 400 without crashing', async () => {
      jest.spyOn(checkinApi, 'submitGeoCheckIn').mockResolvedValue({
        ok: false,
        status: 400,
        error: {
          kind: 'validation',
          code: 'outside_geofence',
          message: 'Outside allowable check-in radius (350m away)',
          meta: {
            distance_m: 350.2,
            success: false,
          },
        },
      });

      const result = await eventRepo.submitGeoCheckIn!('101', 16.9, 96.2, 15);

      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      expect(result.result).toBe('outside_geofence');

      let renderer: ReactTestRenderer.ReactTestRenderer;
      await act(async () => {
        renderer = ReactTestRenderer.create(

            <ThemeProvider>
              <MyAssignmentsScreen
                navigation={mockNav as any}
                repository={mockRepo}
              />
            </ThemeProvider>
          </SafeAreaProvider>,
        );
      });

      // Verify onboarding trigger
      const assignments = await mockRepo.getUserAssignments();
      expect(assignments.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      const firstAssignment = assignments[0];
      await act(async () => {
        await mockRepo.getEventOnboarding(firstAssignment.eventId);
      });
      expect(onboardingSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(firstAssignment.eventId);

      // Verify geo check-in trigger
      await act(async () => {
        await mockRepo.submitGeoCheckIn(firstAssignment.eventId, 16.805, 96.155, 15);
      });
      expect(checkinSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(firstAssignment.eventId, 16.805, 96.155, 15);

      // Verify checkout trigger
      await act(async () => {
        await mockRepo.checkOutAttendance(firstAssignment.id);
      });
      expect(checkoutSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(firstAssignment.id);

      // Verify feedback trigger
      await act(async () => {
        await mockRepo.submitEventFeedback(firstAssignment.eventId, 5, 'Great mission');
      });
      expect(feedbackSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(firstAssignment.eventId, 5, 'Great mission');

      await act(async () => {
        renderer!.unmount();
      });
    });
  });
});

      });

      const resPub = await coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus('1', 'published');
      expect(resPub.success).toBe(true);
      expect(publishSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', mockClient);

      const resAct = await coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus('1', 'active');
      expect(resAct.success).toBe(true);
      expect(activateSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', mockClient);

      const resComp = await coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus('1', 'completed');
      expect(resComp.success).toBe(true);
      expect(completeSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', mockClient);

      const resCanc = await coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus('1', 'cancelled');
      expect(resCanc.success).toBe(true);
      expect(cancelSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', 'Cancelled by coordinator', mockClient);
    });

    it('hands over and retakes coordinator ownership', async () => {
      const handoverSpy = jest
        .spyOn(coordinatorApi, 'handoverEvent')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          data: { id: 101, current_coordinator_id: 888 },

      const retakeSpy = jest.spyOn(coordinatorApi, 'retakeEvent').mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,

      expect(handoverRes.success).toBe(true);
      expect(handoverSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('101', 888, 'Passing to Bob', mockClient);

      const retakeRes = await coordinatorRepo.retakeEvent!('101', 'Bob unavailable');
      expect(retakeRes.success).toBe(true);
      expect(retakeSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('101', 'Bob unavailable', mockClient);
    });

    it('enforces owner-as-monitor guard in MockCoordinatorRepository', async () => {
      const mockRepo = new MockCoordinatorRepository();
      // Hand over event 'evt-coord-001' to new coordinator 'usr-bob'
      const hRes = await mockRepo.handoverEvent!('evt-coord-001', 'usr-bob', 'Handing over');
      expect(hRes.success).toBe(true);

      const detail = await mockRepo.getEventDetail('evt-coord-001');
      expect(detail?.isOwnerAsMonitor).toBe(true);
      expect(detail?.currentCoordinatorId).toBe('usr-bob');

      // Attempting to transition status should fail in monitor mode
      const transRes = await mockRepo.transitionEventStatus('evt-coord-001', 'active');
      expect(transRes.success).toBe(false);
      expect(transRes.message).toContain('Action disabled in read-only monitor mode');

      // Retake coordination
      const retRes = await mockRepo.retakeEvent!('evt-coord-001', 'Retaking');
      expect(retRes.success).toBe(true);

      const retDetail = await mockRepo.getEventDetail('evt-coord-001');
      expect(retDetail?.isOwnerAsMonitor).toBe(false);
    });

describe('Phase 6B Remediation Test Suite', () => {
  let mockClient: ApiClient;
  let coordinatorRepo: HttpCoordinatorRepository;
  let eventRepo: HttpEventRepository;

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockClient = new ApiClient(jest.fn() as any, new MemoryTokenStore());
    coordinatorRepo = new HttpCoordinatorRepository(mockClient);
    eventRepo = new HttpEventRepository(mockClient);
  });

  describe('ATT-02: Manual Check-In Data Layer & Direct Invocation', () => {
    it('executes manual check-in with explicit object params without warm cache', async () => {
      const serverResponse: ManualCheckinResponseDto = {
        attendance_id: 888,
        event_id: 101,
        user_id: 202,
        status: 'checked_in',
        method: 'coordinator_manual',
        checkin_at: '2026-11-20T10:00:00Z',
        recorded_by_user_id: 99,
        already_checked_in: false,
      };

      const manualCheckinSpy = jest
        .spyOn(checkinApi, 'manualCheckIn')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          data: serverResponse,
        });

      const result = await coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn({
        eventId: '101',
        volunteerUserId: '202',
        note: 'Walk-in arrival verified by coordinator',
      });

      expect(manualCheckinSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        {
          event_id: 101,
          user_id: 202,
          note: 'Walk-in arrival verified by coordinator',
        },
        mockClient,
      );

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.data).toBeDefined();
      expect(result.data?.id).toBe('888');
      expect(result.data?.eventId).toBe('101');
      expect(result.data?.userId).toBe('202');
      expect(result.data?.status).toBe('checked_in');
      expect(result.data?.checkInMethod).toBe('coordinator_manual');
      expect(result.data?.checkedInAt).toBe('2026-11-20T10:00:00Z');
      expect(result.data?.isPendingGeoConfirmation).toBe(false);
      expect(result.message).toBe('Volunteer checked in manually');
    });

    it('executes manual check-in with positional parameters without warm cache', async () => {
      const serverResponse: ManualCheckinResponseDto = {
        attendance_id: 889,
        event_id: 101,
        user_id: 203,
        status: 'checked_in',
        method: 'coordinator_manual',
        checkin_at: '2026-11-20T10:05:00Z',
        recorded_by_user_id: 99,
        already_checked_in: false,
      };

      const manualCheckinSpy = jest
        .spyOn(checkinApi, 'manualCheckIn')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          data: serverResponse,
        });

      const result = await coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn(
        '101',
        '203',
        'Positional parameter checkin',
      );

      expect(manualCheckinSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        {
          event_id: 101,
          user_id: 203,
          note: 'Positional parameter checkin',
        },
        mockClient,
      );
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.data?.id).toBe('889');
      expect(result.message).toBe('Volunteer checked in manually');
    });

    it('preserves server method and timestamps on idempotent already_checked_in response', async () => {
      const serverResponse: ManualCheckinResponseDto = {
        attendance_id: 777,
        event_id: 101,
        user_id: 204,
        status: 'checked_in',
        method: 'qr_scan', // Original method was QR scan, server preserves it
        checkin_at: '2026-11-20T08:30:00Z',
        recorded_by_user_id: 99,
        already_checked_in: true,
      };

      jest.spyOn(checkinApi, 'manualCheckIn').mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: serverResponse,
      });

      const result = await coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn({
        eventId: '101',
        volunteerUserId: '204',
      });

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.data?.checkInMethod).toBe('qr_scan'); // Preserves server method
      expect(result.data?.checkedInAt).toBe('2026-11-20T08:30:00Z');
      expect(result.message).toContain('already checked in');
    });

    it('fails closed when attendanceId is not found in cache and no event/user provided', async () => {
      const result = await coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn('nonexistent_id');
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      expect(result.message).toContain('not found in active roster cache');
    });
  });

  describe('P1-02: Donation Merge Rules Alignment (CHECK Constraint)', () => {

            bloodType: 'O+',

            isWillingToDonateBlood: true,
            isWillingToDonateItems: false,

    it('accepts volunteer invite via event repository and endpoints', async () => {
      const acceptSpy = jest

          ok: true,
          status: 200,

        .spyOn(eventRepo, 'acceptInvite')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          success: true,
          message: 'Invite accepted successfully',
          applicationId: '401',
        });

      const useCases = createVolunteerUseCases({
        eventRepository: eventRepo,
        profileRepository: {} as any,
      });

      const result = await useCases.joinThroughInvite('101');
      expect(acceptSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('401', 'Accepted coordinator invitation');
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });

    it('executes respondToInvite with accept and reject operations', async () => {
      const acceptSpy = jest
        .spyOn(eventRepo, 'acceptInvite')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          success: true,
          message: 'Invite accepted successfully',
          applicationId: '401',
        });

      const rejectSpy = jest
        .spyOn(eventRepo, 'rejectInvite')
        .mockResolvedValue({
          success: true,
          message: 'Invite declined successfully',
          applicationId: '401',
        });

      const useCases = createVolunteerUseCases({
        eventRepository: eventRepo,
        profileRepository: {} as any,
      });

      const acceptRes = await useCases.respondToInvite('401', true);
      expect(acceptSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('401', undefined);
      expect(acceptRes.success).toBe(true);

      const rejectRes = await useCases.respondToInvite('401', false);
      expect(rejectSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('401', undefined);
      expect(rejectRes.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

import {

  mapAvailability,
  mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest,
  mapMyFeedbackResponse,
  mapProfileUpdateRequest,
  mapUserProfile,
  mapVerificationCoordinatorData,

} from '../profileMapper';
import type {
  AvailabilityResponseDto,

  VerificationStatusResponseDto,
} from '../../dto/profileDto';
import type { VolunteerProfile } from '../../../domain/models/profile';

describe('profileMapper', () => {
  const sampleUserDto: UserProfileDto = {
    id: 201,
    uuid: 'usr-uuid-201',
    display_name: 'Ko Thura',
    phone: '+95912345678',
    preferred_language: 'my',
    home_area: 'Kamayut, Yangon',
    emergency_contact_name: 'Daw Nu Nu',
    emergency_contact_phone: '+95987654321',
    blood_type: 'O+',
    is_willing_to_donate: true,
    is_willing_to_donate_blood: true,
    is_willing_to_donate_items: false,
    physical_ok: true,
    good_eyesight: true,
    needs_glasses: false,
    can_lift_heavy: true,
    can_work_outdoor: true,
    has_leader_experience: true,
    new_to_volunteer: false,
    skills: ['first aid', 'logistics'],
    needs_meal_support: false,
    needs_travel_support: true,
    accepts_unpaid: true,
    verification_status: 'verified',
    account_status: 'active',
    charity_interests: ['disaster_support', 'health'],
    created_at: '2026-01-10T08:00:00Z',
  };

  describe('Time normalization helpers', () => {
    it('normalizes HH:mm:ss to HH:mm correctly', () => {
      expect(normalizeTimeString('08:30:00')).toBe('08:30');
      expect(normalizeTimeString('9:5:00')).toBe('09:05');
      expect(normalizeTimeString('18:00')).toBe('18:00');
      expect(normalizeTimeString(null)).toBe('00:00');
    });

    it('formats HH:mm to HH:mm:00 for TimeField backend storage', () => {
      expect(formatToTimeWithSeconds('08:30')).toBe('08:30:00');
      expect(formatToTimeWithSeconds('14:45:00')).toBe('14:45:00');
    });
  });

  describe('mapUserProfile', () => {
    const sampleCoordEnvelope: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto = {
      coordinator: {
        user_id: 201,
        status: 'approved',
        approved_by_id: 1,
        approved_at: '2026-03-01T10:00:00Z',
        notes: 'Experienced volunteer coordinator',
        created_at: '2026-02-15T09:00:00Z',
        updated_at: '2026-03-01T10:00:00Z',
      },
    };

    const sampleFeedbackSummary: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto = {
      results: [],
      summary: {
        volunteer_avg_rating: 4.85,
        volunteer_rating_count: 14,
        total_count: 14,
      },
    };

    it('maps UserProfileDto composite into domain VolunteerProfile', () => {
      const profile = mapUserProfile(
        sampleUserDto,
        sampleCoordEnvelope,
        sampleFeedbackSummary,
      );

      expect(profile.id).toBe('201');
      // P1-01 / MAP-01: phone maps strictly to phone; absent email is undefined
      expect(profile.phone).toBe('+95912345678');
      expect(profile.email).toBeUndefined();
      expect(profile.displayName).toBe('Ko Thura');
      expect(profile.preferredLanguage).toBe('my');
      expect(profile.homeArea).toBe('Kamayut, Yangon');
      expect(profile.accountStatus).toBe('active');
      expect(profile.verificationStatus).toBe('verified');
      expect(profile.coordinatorStatus).toBe('approved');
      expect(profile.ratingAverage).toBe(4.85);
      expect(profile.ratingCount).toBe(14);
      expect(profile.capabilities.canLiftHeavy).toBe(true);
      expect(profile.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport).toBe(true);
      expect(profile.donationPreferences.bloodType).toBe('O+');
      expect(profile.charityInterests).toEqual(['disaster_support', 'health']);
    });

    it('handles null phone, coordinator envelope, and feedback metrics safely', () => {
      const userWithoutPhone: UserProfileDto = {
        ...sampleUserDto,
        phone: null,
      };

      const profile = mapUserProfile(userWithoutPhone, null, null);
      expect(profile.phone).toBeNull();
      expect(profile.email).toBeUndefined();
      expect(profile.coordinatorStatus).toBe('none');
      expect(profile.ratingAverage).toBeNull();
      expect(profile.ratingCount).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('mapProfileUpdateRequest', () => {
    it('strictly outputs ONLY allow-listed keys matching ProfileUpdateSerializer', () => {
      const updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile> = {
        displayName: 'Thura Updated',
        preferredLanguage: 'en',
        homeArea: 'Bahan, Yangon',
        emergencyContactName: 'U Tin',
        emergencyContactPhone: '+95911112222',
        skills: ['teaching', 'cooking'],
        capabilities: {
          physicalOk: true,
          goodEyesight: true,
          needsGlasses: true,
          canLiftHeavy: false,
          canWorkOutdoor: true,
          hasLeaderExperience: true,
          newToVolunteer: false,
        },
        supportPreferences: {
          needsMealSupport: true,
          needsTravelSupport: false,
          acceptsUnpaid: true,
        },
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'B+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: true,
          isWillingToDonateItems: true,
        },
      };

      const payload = mapProfileUpdateRequest(updates);

      // Verify exact allow-listed keys exist
      expect(payload.display_name).toBe('Thura Updated');
      expect(payload.preferred_language).toBe('en');
      expect(payload.home_area).toBe('Bahan, Yangon');
      expect(payload.emergency_contact_name).toBe('U Tin');
      expect(payload.emergency_contact_phone).toBe('+95911112222');
      expect(payload.skills).toEqual(['teaching', 'cooking']);
      expect(payload.needs_glasses).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.can_lift_heavy).toBe(false);
      expect(payload.needs_meal_support).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.blood_type).toBe('B+');
      expect(payload.is_willing_to_donate_blood).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.is_willing_to_donate).toBe(true);

      // Verify that non-allow-listed keys are NOT in the payload
      const payloadKeys = Object.keys(payload);
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('id');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('email');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('account_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('verification_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('coordinator_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('charity_interests'); // handled via separate PUT endpoint
    });

    it('coherently merges donation sub-flags with currentProfile to preserve is_willing_to_donate', () => {
      const currentProfile: VolunteerProfile = {
        ...(sampleUserDto as any),
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'A+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: false,
          isWillingToDonateItems: true,
        },
      };

      const partialUpdates: Partial<VolunteerProfile> = {
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'A+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: false,
        } as any,
      };

      const partialPayload = mapProfileUpdateRequest(partialUpdates, currentProfile);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate).toBe(true);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate_blood).toBe(false);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate_items).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('mapAvailability & mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest', () => {
    it('maps AvailabilityResponseDto and normalizes time strings and weekday names', () => {
      const responseDto: AvailabilityResponseDto = {
        rules: [
          {
            id: 11,
            weekday: 1, // Monday
            start_time: '08:00:00',
            end_time: '12:00:00',
          },
          {
            id: 12,
            weekday: 6, // Saturday
            start_time: '13:30:00',

      expect(availability.exceptions).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(availability.exceptions[0].date).toBe('2026-12-25');
      expect(availability.exceptions[0].isAvailable).toBe(false);
      expect(availability.exceptions[0].note).toBe('Christmas blackout');
    });

          weekday: 2,

          startTime: '09:00',
          endTime: '15:00',

      const replaceDto = mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest(rules);

          end_time: '15:00:00',

/**
 * Maps wizard draft to EventCreateRequestDto matching EventCreateSerializer.
 * Translates mobile domain choices into backend allow-listed serializer choices:
 * - leaderStrategy ('first_assigned' | 'highest_rated' -> 'first_experienced')
 * - compensationKind ('stipend' | 'travel_reimbursement' -> 'arranged_outside_system')
 */
export function mapCreateEventDraftToRequest(
  draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
): EventCreateRequestDto {
  let leaderStrategy: 'none' | 'first_experienced' | 'manual' = 'none';
  if (
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'first_experienced' ||
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'manual'
  ) {
    leaderStrategy = draft.leaderStrategy;
  } else if (
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'first_assigned' ||
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'highest_rated'
  ) {
    leaderStrategy = 'first_experienced';
  }

  let compensationKind: 'unpaid' | 'arranged_outside_system' = 'unpaid';
  let compensationNote: string | null = draft.compensationNote ?? null;

  if (draft.compensationKind === 'arranged_outside_system') {
    compensationKind = 'arranged_outside_system';
  } else if (
    draft.compensationKind === 'stipend' ||
    draft.compensationKind === 'travel_reimbursement'
  ) {
    compensationKind = 'arranged_outside_system';
    const kindLabel =
      draft.compensationKind === 'stipend'
        ? 'Stipend Support'
        : 'Travel Reimbursement';
    compensationNote = draft.compensationNote
      ? `${kindLabel}: ${draft.compensationNote}`
      : kindLabel;
  }

  return {
    title: draft.title.trim(),
    description: draft.description ? draft.description.trim() : null,
    purpose_type: draft.purposeType,
    location_name: draft.locationName ? draft.locationName.trim() : null,
    landmark_text: draft.landmarkText ? draft.landmarkText.trim() : null,
    latitude: typeof draft.latitude === 'number' ? draft.latitude : null,
    longitude: typeof draft.longitude === 'number' ? draft.longitude : null,
    geo_radius_m: draft.geoRadiusM ?? 100,
    geo_checkin_enabled: Boolean(draft.geoCheckinEnabled),
    geo_checkin_opens_before_min: draft.geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin ?? 30,
    require_checkin_confirmation: Boolean(draft.requireCheckinConfirmation),
    map_provider: draft.mapProvider === 'google' ? 'google' : 'openstreetmap',
    start_at: draft.startAt,
    end_at: draft.endAt,
    application_deadline: draft.applicationDeadline ?? null,
    acceptance_mode: draft.acceptanceMode,
    auto_assign_enabled: Boolean(draft.autoAssignEnabled),
    group_size: draft.groupSize ?? null,
    leader_strategy: leaderStrategy,
    max_participants: draft.maxParticipants ?? null,
    meals_provided: Boolean(draft.mealsProvided),
    lodging_provided: Boolean(draft.lodgingProvided),
    travel_support_provided: Boolean(draft.travelSupportProvided),
    compensation_kind: compensationKind,
    compensation_note: compensationNote,
    onboarding_text: draft.onboardingText ? draft.onboardingText.trim() : null,
    require_onboarding_ack: Boolean(draft.requireOnboardingAck),
    qr_registration_enabled: Boolean(draft.qrRegistrationEnabled),
    charity_field_codes: draft.charityFieldCodes || [],
  };
}

/**
 * Maps CoordinatorApplicationDto to domain CoordinatorApplicationItem.
 */
export function mapCoordinatorApplication(
  dto: CoordinatorApplicationDto,
  eventId?: string | number,
  eventTitle = 'Volunteer Event',
): CoordinatorApplicationItem {
  let source: 'browse' | 'qr_walkin' | 'invite' = 'browse';
  if (dto.source === 'qr_walkin' || dto.source === 'invite') {
    source = dto.source;
  }

  let t2Capabilities: VolunteerT2Capabilities | undefined = undefined;
  if (dto.status === 'accepted') {
    t2Capabilities = {
      skills: Array.isArray(dto.skills) ? dto.skills : [],
      physicalOk: Boolean(dto.physical_ok),
      goodEyesight: Boolean(dto.good_eyesight),
      needsGlasses: Boolean(dto.needs_glasses),
      canLiftHeavy: Boolean(dto.can_lift_heavy),
      canWorkOutdoor: Boolean(dto.can_work_outdoor),
      hasLeaderExperience: Boolean(dto.has_leader_experience),
      newToVolunteer: Boolean(dto.new_to_volunteer),
      preferredLanguage: dto.preferred_language || 'en',
      homeArea: dto.home_area || '',
      needsMealSupport: Boolean(dto.needs_meal_support),
      needsTravelSupport: Boolean(dto.needs_travel_support),
      acceptsUnpaid: Boolean(dto.accepts_unpaid),
      verificationStatus: dto.verification_status || 'none',
    };
  }

  return {
    id: String(dto.id),
    eventId: String(eventId ?? ''),
    eventTitle,
    userId: String(dto.user_id),
    applicantName: dto.display_name,
    status: dto.status as CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
    appliedAt: dto.applied_at,
    source,
    postId:
      dto.post_id !== null && dto.post_id !== undefined
        ? String(dto.post_id)
        : undefined,
    postTitle: dto.post_title ?? 'General Volunteer Support',
    t2Capabilities,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps CoordinatorAssignmentDto or ManualAssignResultDto to domain CoordinatorAssignmentItem.
 */
export function mapCoordinatorAssignment(
  dto: CoordinatorAssignmentDto | ManualAssignResultDto,
  eventId?: string | number,
  eventTitle = 'Volunteer Event',
): CoordinatorAssignmentItem {
  const assignId =
    'id' in dto && dto.id != null
      ? dto.id
      : 'assignment_id' in dto && dto.assignment_id != null
      ? dto.assignment_id
      : '';
  const appId =
    'application_id' in dto && dto.application_id != null
      ? dto.application_id
      : '';
  const userId =
    'user_id' in dto && dto.user_id != null ? dto.user_id : '';
  const volunteerName =
    'display_name' in dto && dto.display_name ? dto.display_name : 'Volunteer';
  const postId =
    'post_id' in dto && dto.post_id != null ? dto.post_id : '';
  const postTitle =
    'post_title' in dto && dto.post_title ? dto.post_title : 'Assigned Shift';
  const status =
    'status' in dto && dto.status ? dto.status : 'assigned';
  const groupCode =
    'group_code' in dto && dto.group_code ? dto.group_code : undefined;
  const isGroupLeader =
    'is_group_leader' in dto && dto.is_group_leader != null
      ? Boolean(dto.is_group_leader)
      : false;
  const assignedAt =
    ('assigned_at' in dto && dto.assigned_at) ||
    ('schedule_start' in dto && dto.schedule_start) ||
    new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    id: String(assignId),
    eventId: String(eventId ?? ''),
    eventTitle,
    applicationId: String(appId),
    userId: String(userId),
    volunteerName,
    postId: String(postId),
    postTitle,
    status: status as CoordinatorAssignmentStatus,
    groupCode,
    isGroupLeader,
    assignedAt,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps AttendanceRosterDto to domain CoordinatorAttendanceItem.
 */
export function mapAttendanceRosterItem(
  dto: AttendanceRosterDto,
  eventTitle = 'Volunteer Event',
): CoordinatorAttendanceItem {
  let status: AttendanceRecordStatus = 'scheduled';
  let isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;

  if (dto.confirmation_status === 'pending') {
    status = 'pending_confirmation';
    isPendingGeoConfirmation = true;
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'completed') {
    status = 'completed';
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'checked_in') {
    status = 'checked_in';
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'absent' || dto.attendance_status === 'excused') {
    status = 'no_show';
  } else {
    status = 'scheduled';
  }

  let checkInMethod: CheckInMethod | undefined = undefined;
  if (dto.method) {
    if (dto.method === 'qr_scan' || dto.method === 'qr') {
      checkInMethod = 'qr';
    } else if (dto.method === 'coordinator_manual' || dto.method === 'manual') {
      checkInMethod = 'manual';
    } else if (dto.method === 'geo') {
      checkInMethod = 'geo';
    } else if (dto.method === 'system') {
      checkInMethod = 'system';
    }
  }

  let geoAttempt = undefined;
  if (dto.checkin_distance_m !== null && dto.checkin_distance_m !== undefined) {
    geoAttempt = {
      attemptedAt: dto.checkin_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      withinGeofence: status !== 'pending_confirmation',
      distanceMeters: Number(dto.checkin_distance_m),
      confirmationStatus:
        dto.confirmation_status === 'confirmed' || dto.confirmation_status === 'rejected'
          ? (dto.confirmation_status as 'confirmed' | 'rejected')
          : ('pending' as const),
    };
  }

  return {
    id: String(dto.attendance_id ?? dto.assignment_id),
    eventId: String(dto.event_id),
    eventTitle,
    assignmentId: String(dto.assignment_id),
    userId: String(dto.user_id),
    volunteerName: dto.display_name,
    postTitle: dto.post_title ?? 'General Volunteer',
    groupCode: dto.group_code ?? undefined,
    status,
    attendanceStatus: (dto.attendance_status as any) ?? null,
    confirmationStatus: (dto.confirmation_status as any) ?? null,
    checkInMethod,
    checkedInAt: dto.checkin_at ?? undefined,
    isPendingGeoConfirmation,
    geoAttempt,
  };
}

/**

import type {
  ApplicationSubmitRequestDto,
  CharityFieldDto,
  PublicEventDetailDto,
  PublicEventDto,
  PublicEventPostDto,
  VolunteerApplicationDto,
  VolunteerAssignmentDto,
} from '../dto/eventDto';
import type {
  CharityCategory,
  CharityCategoryCode,
  EventApplicationState,
  EventApplicationStatus,
  EventDetail,
  EventPost,
  EventStatus,
  EventSummary,
  PhysicalLevel,
  PostStatus,
  VolunteerApplicationItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentStatus,
} from '../../domain/models/event';

/**
 * Normalizes event status to domain union 'published' | 'active'.
 */
function normalizeEventStatus(statusStr: string): EventStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'active') {
    return 'active';
  }
  return 'published';
}

/**
 * Normalizes post status to domain union 'open' | 'full' | 'closed'.
 */
function normalizePostStatus(statusStr: string): PostStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'full' || statusStr === 'closed') {
    return statusStr;
  }
  return 'open';
}

/**
 * Normalizes post physical level.
 */
function normalizePhysicalLevel(levelStr: string): PhysicalLevel {
  if (levelStr === 'light' || levelStr === 'medium' || levelStr === 'heavy') {
    return levelStr;
  }
  return 'none';
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventDto to domain EventSummary model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventSummary(dto: PublicEventDto): EventSummary {
  return {
    id: String(dto.id),
    title: dto.title,
    description: dto.description ?? '',
    purposeType: dto.purpose_type,
    status: normalizeEventStatus(dto.status),
    locationName: dto.location_name ?? '',
    landmarkText: dto.landmark_text ?? undefined,
    startAt: dto.start_at,
    endAt: dto.end_at,
    applicationDeadline: dto.application_deadline ?? undefined,
    charityFields: (dto.charity_fields || []) as CharityCategoryCode[],
    coordinatorName: dto.coordinator_name ?? 'Coordinator',
    spotsRemaining: typeof dto.spots_remaining === 'number' ? dto.spots_remaining : 0,
    mealsProvided: Boolean(dto.meals_provided),
    lodgingProvided: Boolean(dto.lodging_provided),
    travelSupportProvided: Boolean(dto.travel_support_provided),
    compensationKind: dto.compensation_kind ?? 'unpaid',
  };
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventPostDto to domain EventPost model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventPost(
  dto: PublicEventPostDto,
  eventId: string | number,
): EventPost {
  const reqHeadcount = typeof dto.required_headcount === 'number' ? dto.required_headcount : 1;
  const assigned = typeof dto.assigned_count === 'number' ? dto.assigned_count : 0;
  const rem = typeof dto.remaining === 'number' ? dto.remaining : Math.max(0, reqHeadcount - assigned);

  return {
    id: String(dto.id),
    eventId: String(eventId),
    title: dto.title,
    description: dto.description ?? undefined,
    requiredHeadcount: reqHeadcount,
    filledHeadcount: assigned,
    remainingCapacity: rem,
    physicalLevel: normalizePhysicalLevel(dto.physical_level),
    requiredSkills: Array.isArray(dto.required_skills) ? dto.required_skills : [],
    leaderNeeded: Boolean(dto.leader_needed),
    newVolunteersAllowed: Boolean(dto.new_volunteers_allowed),
    status: normalizePostStatus(dto.status),
  };
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventDetailDto and optional user application to domain EventDetail model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventDetail(
  dto: PublicEventDetailDto,
  userApp?: VolunteerApplicationDto | null,
): EventDetail {
  const summary = mapPublicEventSummary(dto);
  const posts: EventPost[] = Array.isArray(dto.posts)
    ? dto.posts.map(p => mapPublicEventPost(p, dto.id))
    : [];

  let userApplication: EventApplicationState | null = null;
  if (userApp) {
    userApplication = {
      id: String(userApp.id),
      eventId: String(userApp.event_id),
      postId: String(userApp.post_id ?? ''),
      postTitle: userApp.post_title ?? 'General Volunteer Support',
      status: userApp.status as EventApplicationStatus,
      appliedAt: userApp.applied_at,
      volunteerNote: userApp.note ?? undefined,
    };
  }

  const lat =
    dto.latitude !== null && dto.latitude !== undefined && dto.latitude !== ''
      ? Number(dto.latitude)
      : undefined;

  const lng =
    dto.longitude !== null && dto.longitude !== undefined && dto.longitude !== ''
      ? Number(dto.longitude)
      : undefined;

  return {
    ...summary,
    landmarkText: dto.landmark_text ?? undefined,
    compensationNote: dto.compensation_note ?? undefined,
    onboardingText: dto.onboarding_text ?? undefined,
    latitude: !isNaN(lat as number) ? lat : undefined,
    longitude: !isNaN(lng as number) ? lng : undefined,
    geoCheckinEnabled: Boolean(dto.geo_checkin_enabled),
    posts,
    userApplication,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps VolunteerApplicationDto to domain VolunteerApplicationItem.
 */
export function mapVolunteerApplication(
