const WEEKDAY_NAMES: Record<number, string> = {
  1: 'Monday',
  2: 'Tuesday',
  3: 'Wednesday',
  4: 'Thursday',
  5: 'Friday',
  6: 'Saturday',
  7: 'Sunday',
};

/**
 * Trims PostgreSQL TimeField values ("08:00:00" -> "08:00").
 */
export function normalizeTimeString(timeStr?: string | null): string {
  if (!timeStr) {
    return '00:00';
  }
  const parts = timeStr.trim().split(':');
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return `${parts[0].padStart(2, '0')}:${parts[1].padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return timeStr;
}

/**
 * Ensures TimeField string has seconds ("08:00" -> "08:00:00").
 */
export function formatToTimeWithSeconds(timeStr: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeTimeString(timeStr);
  return `${normalized}:00`;
}

/**
 * Maps UserProfileDto composite into domain VolunteerProfile.
 * P1-01 / MAP-01: phone maps strictly to phone; absent email remains null/undefined (no fallback).
 */
export function mapUserProfile(
  userDto: UserProfileDto,
  coordinatorEnvelope?: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto | null,
  feedbackSummary?: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto | null,
): VolunteerProfile {
  const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
    (coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus) || 'none';

  const verifStatus =
    (userDto.verification_status as 'none' | 'pending' | 'verified' | 'rejected') || 'none';

  const acctStatus =
    (userDto.account_status as 'active' | 'blocked' | 'closed') || 'active';

  const summary = feedbackSummary?.summary;
  const ratingAverage =
    summary?.volunteer_avg_rating ??
    summary?.overall_avg_rating ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.avg_overall ??
    null;

  const ratingCount =
    summary?.volunteer_rating_count ??
    summary?.total_count ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.count ??
    0;

  return {
    id: String(userDto.id),
    phone: userDto.phone ?? null,
    email: (userDto as { email?: string | null }).email ?? undefined,
    accountStatus: acctStatus,
    verificationStatus: verifStatus,
    coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
    isAdmin: false,
    isStaff: false,
    ratingAverage,
    ratingCount,

    displayName: userDto.display_name || 'Volunteer',
    preferredLanguage: (userDto.preferred_language as UserLanguage) || 'en',
    homeArea: userDto.home_area || '',
    emergencyContactName: userDto.emergency_contact_name || '',
    emergencyContactPhone: userDto.emergency_contact_phone || '',
    skills: Array.isArray(userDto.skills) ? userDto.skills : [],
    charityInterests: (userDto.charity_interests || []) as CharityCategoryCode[],

    capabilities: {
      physicalOk: Boolean(userDto.physical_ok),
      goodEyesight: Boolean(userDto.good_eyesight),
      needsGlasses: Boolean(userDto.needs_glasses),
      canLiftHeavy: Boolean(userDto.can_lift_heavy),
      canWorkOutdoor: Boolean(userDto.can_work_outdoor),
      hasLeaderExperience: Boolean(userDto.has_leader_experience),
      newToVolunteer: Boolean(userDto.new_to_volunteer),
    },

    supportPreferences: {
      needsMealSupport: Boolean(userDto.needs_meal_support),
      needsTravelSupport: Boolean(userDto.needs_travel_support),
      acceptsUnpaid: Boolean(userDto.accepts_unpaid),
    },

    donationPreferences: {
      bloodType: (userDto.blood_type as BloodType) || 'unknown',
      isWillingToDonate: Boolean(
        userDto.is_willing_to_donate ??
          (userDto.is_willing_to_donate_blood || userDto.is_willing_to_donate_items),
      ),
      isWillingToDonateBlood: Boolean(userDto.is_willing_to_donate_blood),
      isWillingToDonateItems: Boolean(userDto.is_willing_to_donate_items),
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Maps partial VolunteerProfile updates to strict ProfileUpdateSerializer allow-list.
 * CRITICAL: Emits ONLY the 20 approved keys; any extraneous property causes HTTP 400.
 * Merges with currentProfile?.donationPreferences to avoid partial patches clobbering sub-flags.
 */
export function mapProfileUpdateRequest(
  updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile>,
  currentProfile?: VolunteerProfile | null,
): ProfileUpdateRequestDto {
  const payload: ProfileUpdateRequestDto = {};

  if (updates.displayName !== undefined) {
    payload.display_name = updates.displayName.trim();
  }
  if (updates.preferredLanguage !== undefined) {
    payload.preferred_language = updates.preferredLanguage;
  }
  if (updates.homeArea !== undefined) {
    payload.home_area = updates.homeArea.trim();
  }
  if (updates.emergencyContactName !== undefined) {
    payload.emergency_contact_name = updates.emergencyContactName.trim();
  }
  if (updates.emergencyContactPhone !== undefined) {
    payload.emergency_contact_phone = updates.emergencyContactPhone.trim();
  }
  if (updates.skills !== undefined) {
    payload.skills = updates.skills;
  }

  if (updates.capabilities) {
    if (updates.capabilities.physicalOk !== undefined) {
      payload.physical_ok = updates.capabilities.physicalOk;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.goodEyesight !== undefined) {
      payload.good_eyesight = updates.capabilities.goodEyesight;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.needsGlasses !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_glasses = updates.capabilities.needsGlasses;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.canLiftHeavy !== undefined) {
      payload.can_lift_heavy = updates.capabilities.canLiftHeavy;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.canWorkOutdoor !== undefined) {
      payload.can_work_outdoor = updates.capabilities.canWorkOutdoor;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.hasLeaderExperience !== undefined) {
      payload.has_leader_experience = updates.capabilities.hasLeaderExperience;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.newToVolunteer !== undefined) {
      payload.new_to_volunteer = updates.capabilities.newToVolunteer;
    }
  }

  if (updates.supportPreferences) {
    if (updates.supportPreferences.needsMealSupport !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_meal_support = updates.supportPreferences.needsMealSupport;
    }
    if (updates.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_travel_support = updates.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport;
    }
    if (updates.supportPreferences.acceptsUnpaid !== undefined) {
      payload.accepts_unpaid = updates.supportPreferences.acceptsUnpaid;
    }
  }

  if (updates.donationPreferences) {
    if (updates.donationPreferences.bloodType !== undefined) {
      payload.blood_type = updates.donationPreferences.bloodType;
    }

    if (updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonate === false) {
      // P1-02: Setting master donation flag to false cascades both sub-flags to false
      // to avoid DB constraint violation and keep consistency with backend PATCH rules.
      payload.is_willing_to_donate = false;
      payload.is_willing_to_donate_blood =
        updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood ?? false;
      payload.is_willing_to_donate_items =
        updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems ?? false;
    } else {
      const currentDonateBlood =
        currentProfile?.donationPreferences?.isWillingToDonateBlood;
      const currentDonateItems =
        currentProfile?.donationPreferences?.isWillingToDonateItems;

      const donateBlood =
        updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood !== undefined
          ? updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood
          : currentDonateBlood;

      const donateItems =
        updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems !== undefined
          ? updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems
          : currentDonateItems;

      if (donateBlood !== undefined) {
        payload.is_willing_to_donate_blood = donateBlood;
      }
      if (donateItems !== undefined) {
        payload.is_willing_to_donate_items = donateItems;
      }

      if (updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonate !== undefined) {
        payload.is_willing_to_donate = updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonate;
      } else if (donateBlood !== undefined || donateItems !== undefined) {
        payload.is_willing_to_donate = Boolean(donateBlood || donateItems);
      }
    }
  }

  return payload;
}

/**
 * Maps FeedbackSummaryResponseDto into domain MyFeedbackResponse with separate authored feedback
 * and received aggregate metrics (V-41, V-42, P2-02).
 */
export function mapMyFeedbackResponse(
  dto: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto,
): MyFeedbackResponse {
  const results = Array.isArray(dto.results) ? dto.results : [];
  const authoredFeedback: AuthoredFeedbackItem[] = results.map(item => ({
    id: String(item.id),
    eventId: String(item.event_id),
    eventTitle: item.event_title ?? undefined,
    direction: item.direction,
    ratingOverall: item.rating_overall,
    tags: Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [],
    comments: item.comments ?? undefined,
    createdAt: item.created_at,
  }));

  const s = dto.summary || {};
  const asVol = s.as_volunteer || {
    count: s.volunteer_rating_count ?? 0,
    avg_overall: s.volunteer_avg_rating ?? null,
  };
  const asCoord = s.as_coordinator || {
    count: s.coordinator_rating_count ?? 0,
    avg_overall: s.coordinator_avg_rating ?? null,
  };

  const totalCount =
    s.total_count ?? (asVol.count + asCoord.count);
  const overallAvg =
    s.overall_avg_rating ??
    (totalCount > 0 ? asVol.avg_overall ?? asCoord.avg_overall : null);

  const receivedSummary: FeedbackRatingSummary = {
    userId: s.user_id !== undefined ? String(s.user_id) : undefined,
    overallAvgRating: overallAvg,
    totalCount,
    volunteerAvgRating: s.volunteer_avg_rating ?? asVol.avg_overall ?? null,
    volunteerRatingCount: s.volunteer_rating_count ?? asVol.count ?? 0,
    coordinatorAvgRating: s.coordinator_avg_rating ?? asCoord.avg_overall ?? null,
    coordinatorRatingCount: s.coordinator_rating_count ?? asCoord.count ?? 0,
    asVolunteer: {
      count: asVol.count,
      avgOverall: asVol.avg_overall,
    },
    asCoordinator: {
      count: asCoord.count,
      avgOverall: asCoord.avg_overall,
    },
    ratingDistribution: s.rating_distribution || {},
  };

  return {
    authoredFeedback,
    receivedSummary,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps AvailabilityResponseDto to domain VolunteerAvailability model.
 */
export function mapAvailability(
  dto: AvailabilityResponseDto,
): VolunteerAvailability {
  const weeklyRules: WeeklyAvailabilityRule[] = (dto.rules || []).map(r => {
    const normStart = normalizeTimeString(r.start_time);
    const normEnd = normalizeTimeString(r.end_time);
    const deterministicId =
      r.id != null ? String(r.id) : `${r.weekday}-${normStart}-${normEnd}`;

    return {
      id: deterministicId,
      weekday: r.weekday,
      weekdayName: WEEKDAY_NAMES[r.weekday] || `Day ${r.weekday}`,
      startTime: normStart,
      endTime: normEnd,
      validFrom: r.valid_from ?? undefined,
      validTo: r.valid_to ?? undefined,
    };
  });

  const exceptions: AvailabilityException[] = (dto.exceptions || []).map(e => ({
    id: String(e.id ?? `exc-${e.date}`),
    date: e.date,
    isAvailable: Boolean(e.is_available),
    startTime: e.start_time ? normalizeTimeString(e.start_time) : undefined,
    endTime: e.end_time ? normalizeTimeString(e.end_time) : undefined,
    note: e.note ?? undefined,
  }));

  return {
    weeklyRules,
    exceptions,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps domain weekly rules into AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto payload.
 */
export function mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest(
  rules: WeeklyAvailabilityRule[],
): AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto {
  return {
    rules: rules.map(r => {
      const item: AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto['rules'][number] = {
        weekday: r.weekday,
        start_time: formatToTimeWithSeconds(r.startTime),
        end_time: formatToTimeWithSeconds(r.endTime),
      };
      if (r.validFrom !== undefined && r.validFrom !== null) {
        item.valid_from = r.validFrom;
      }
      if (r.validTo !== undefined && r.validTo !== null) {
        item.valid_to = r.validTo;
      }
      return item;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Normalizes backend verification image status to domain status.
 */
function normalizeVerificationStatus(statusStr: string): VerificationStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'approved' || statusStr === 'verified') {
    return 'verified';
  }
  if (statusStr === 'pending') {
    return 'pending';
  }
  if (statusStr === 'rejected') {
    return 'rejected';
  }
  return 'none';
}

/**
 * Maps VerificationStatusResponseDto and coordinator envelope to VerificationCoordinatorData.
 */
export function mapVerificationCoordinatorData(
  verificationDto: VerificationStatusResponseDto,
  coordinatorEnvelope?: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto | null,
): VerificationCoordinatorData {
  const verifStatus = normalizeVerificationStatus(
    verificationDto.verification_status,
  );
  const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
    (coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus) || 'none';

  const imageMap = new Map(
    (verificationDto.images || []).map(img => [img.image_type, img]),
  );

  const slotConfigs: Array<{
    imageType: VerificationImageType;
    label: string;
    description: string;
  }> = [
    {
      imageType: 'mock_selfie',
      label: 'Photo Selfie',
      description: 'Clear frontal photo of your face for on-site visual identity match.',
    },
    {
      imageType: 'id_license',
      label: 'NRC / Citizen ID',
      description: 'Official national identity card (front and back clearly legible).',
    },
    {
      imageType: 'driver_license',
      label: "Driver's License (Optional)",
      description: 'Required if volunteering for logistics or transport roles.',
    },
  ];

  const imageSlots: VerificationImageSlot[] = slotConfigs.map(cfg => {
    const record = imageMap.get(cfg.imageType);
    return {
      imageType: cfg.imageType,
      label: cfg.label,
      description: cfg.description,
      status: record ? normalizeVerificationStatus(record.status) : 'none',
      fileFormat: 'jpeg',
      uploadedAt: record ? record.created_at : undefined,
    };
  });

  return {
    verificationStatus: verifStatus,
    coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
    canApplyForCoordinator: verifStatus === 'verified',
    imageSlots,
    coordinatorApplicationNote: coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.notes ?? undefined,
  };
}

  public async createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    // 1. Validate charity categories count (must be between 1 and 3)
    if (
      !draft.charityFieldCodes ||
      draft.charityFieldCodes.length < 1 ||
      draft.charityFieldCodes.length > 3
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Ensure between 1 and 3 charity fields are provided.',
      };
    }

    // 2. Validate schedule: end must be later than start
    const startTime = new Date(draft.startAt).getTime();
    const endTime = new Date(draft.endAt).getTime();
    if (isNaN(startTime) || isNaN(endTime) || endTime <= startTime) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event end time must be later than start time.',
      };
    }

    if (draft.applicationDeadline) {
      const deadlineTime = new Date(draft.applicationDeadline).getTime();
      if (!isNaN(deadlineTime) && deadlineTime > startTime) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message:
            'Application deadline must be on or before the event start time.',
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Validate geoRadius contract: 20 to 5000 meters
    if (
      draft.geoRadiusM !== undefined &&
      (draft.geoRadiusM < 20 || draft.geoRadiusM > 5000)
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Geofence radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.',
      };

  public async updateEvent(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }
    if (data.title !== undefined) event.title = data.title.trim();
    if (data.description !== undefined)
      event.description = data.description.trim();
    if (data.locationName !== undefined)
      event.locationName = data.locationName.trim();
    if (data.onboardingText !== undefined) {
      event.onboardingText = data.onboardingText.trim();
      event.onboardingVersion = (event.onboardingVersion || 1) + 1;
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(event),
    };
  }

  public async transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    // Owner-as-monitor guard: writes and transitions are disabled
    if (event.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    // Lifecycle state machine validation
    const current = event.status;
    const allowed = getAllowedTransitions(current);
    if (!allowed.includes(targetStatus)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Invalid transition from ${current} to ${targetStatus}`,
      };
    }

    event.status = targetStatus;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(event),
    };
  }

  public async getApplications(

      : this.applications;
    return deepClone(list);

  public async updateApplicationStatus(
    applicationId: string,
    status: CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Application not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    app.status = status;

    // Enforce privacy rule: T2 capabilities appear only for accepted applicants
    if (status === 'accepted') {
      if (!app.t2Capabilities) {
        app.t2Capabilities = {
          skills: ['general_assistance', 'community_outreach'],
          physicalOk: true,
          goodEyesight: true,
          needsGlasses: false,
          canLiftHeavy: false,
          canWorkOutdoor: true,
          hasLeaderExperience: false,
          newToVolunteer: false,
          preferredLanguage: 'my',
          homeArea: 'Yangon',
          needsMealSupport: true,
          needsTravelSupport: false,
          acceptsUnpaid: true,
          verificationStatus: 'verified',
        };
      }
    } else {
      // Remove T2 semi-private capabilities for pending/waitlisted/rejected applicants
      delete app.t2Capabilities;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(app),
    };
  }

  public async getAssignments(

  public async getUnassignedApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]> {
    const acceptedApps = this.applications.filter(
      a =>
        a.status === 'accepted' &&
        (!eventId || a.eventId === eventId) &&
        !this.assignments.some(
          asg => asg.applicationId === a.id && asg.status !== 'cancelled',
        ),
    );
    return deepClone(acceptedApps);
  }

  public async runAutoAssignment(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    if (event.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    const unassigned = await this.getUnassignedApplications(eventId);
    if (unassigned.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'All accepted volunteers are already assigned.',
        data: [],
      };
    }

    const created: CoordinatorAssignmentItem[] = [];
    unassigned.forEach((app, index) => {
      const newAsg: CoordinatorAssignmentItem = {
        id: this.idGenerator('asg-auto'),
        eventId: app.eventId,
        eventTitle: app.eventTitle,
        applicationId: app.id,
        userId: app.userId,
        volunteerName: app.applicantName,
        postId: app.postId ?? 'post-default',
        postTitle: app.postTitle ?? 'General Volunteer Support',
        status: 'assigned',
        groupCode: `GRP-${String.fromCharCode(65 + (index % 3))}`,
        isGroupLeader: index === 0,
        assignedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
      };
      this.assignments.push(newAsg);
      created.push(newAsg);
    });

    event.assignedCount += created.length;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(created),
    };
  }

  public async assignVolunteerManually(
    applicationId: string,
    postId: string,
    groupCode = 'GRP-MANUAL',
    isGroupLeader = false,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Application not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    if (app.status !== 'accepted') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Only accepted applicants may be assigned to posts.',
      };
    }

    const newAsg: CoordinatorAssignmentItem = {
      id: this.idGenerator('asg-manual'),
      eventId: app.eventId,
      eventTitle: app.eventTitle,
      applicationId: app.id,
      userId: app.userId,
      volunteerName: app.applicantName,
      postId: postId,
      postTitle: app.postTitle ?? 'Volunteer Post',
      status: 'assigned',
      groupCode,
      isGroupLeader,
      assignedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
    };

    this.assignments.push(newAsg);
    if (event) {
      event.assignedCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newAsg),
    };
  }

  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const asg = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asg) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Assignment not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === asg.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    if (asg.status === 'completed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Completed assignments cannot be cancelled.',
      };
    }

    asg.status = 'cancelled';
    if (event && event.assignedCount > 0) {
      event.assignedCount -= 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(asg),
    };
  }

  public async confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'checked_in';
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
    record.checkedInAt = this.clock().toISOString();
    if (record.geoAttempt) {
      record.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'confirmed';
    }

    if (event) {
      event.checkedInCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'scheduled';
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
    if (record.geoAttempt) {
      record.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'rejected';
      record.geoAttempt.note = 'Rejected by coordinator in on-site verification.';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async manualCheckIn(
    params: { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    eventId: string | number,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,

    attendanceId: string,

  public async manualCheckIn(
    arg1: string | number | { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
    arg2?: string | number,
    _arg3?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    let record: CoordinatorAttendanceItem | undefined;
    if (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null && 'eventId' in arg1 && 'volunteerUserId' in arg1) {
      record = this.attendance.find(
        a => a.eventId === String(arg1.eventId) && a.userId === String(arg1.volunteerUserId),
      );
    } else if (arg2 !== undefined && arg2 !== null) {
      record = this.attendance.find(
        a => a.eventId === String(arg1) && a.userId === String(arg2),
      );
    } else {
      const attendanceId = String(arg1);
      record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId || a.assignmentId === attendanceId);
    }

    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record!.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'checked_in';
    record.checkInMethod = 'manual';
    record.checkedInAt = this.clock().toISOString();
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;

    if (event) {
      event.checkedInCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async createEventPost(
    eventId: string,
    post: {
      title: string;
      requiredHeadcount: number;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
      leaderNeeded?: boolean;
      newVolunteersAllowed?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }
    const newPost: EventPost = {
      id: this.idGenerator('post'),
      eventId,
      title: post.title,
      requiredHeadcount: post.requiredHeadcount,
      filledHeadcount: 0,
      remainingCapacity: post.requiredHeadcount,
      physicalLevel: (post.physicalLevel as any) || 'light',
      requiredSkills: post.requiredSkills || [],
      leaderNeeded: post.leaderNeeded ?? false,
      newVolunteersAllowed: post.newVolunteersAllowed ?? true,
      status: 'open',
    };
    event.posts.push(newPost);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newPost),
    };
  }

  public async updateEventPost(
    postId: string,
    updates: {
      requiredHeadcount?: number;
      status?: string;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    for (const event of this.events) {
      const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
      if (post) {
        if (updates.requiredHeadcount !== undefined) {
          post.requiredHeadcount = updates.requiredHeadcount;
          post.remainingCapacity = Math.max(
            0,
            post.requiredHeadcount - post.filledHeadcount,
          );
        }
        if (updates.status !== undefined) post.status = updates.status as any;
        if (updates.physicalLevel !== undefined)
          post.physicalLevel = updates.physicalLevel as any;
        if (updates.requiredSkills !== undefined)
          post.requiredSkills = updates.requiredSkills;
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
          data: deepClone(post),
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Post not found',
    };
  }

  public async closeEventPost(
    postId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<void>> {
    for (const event of this.events) {
      const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
      if (post) {
        post.status = 'closed';
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Post not found',
    };
  }

function getAllowedTransitions(
  status: CoordinatorEventStatus,
): CoordinatorEventStatus[] {
  switch (status) {
    case 'draft':
      return ['published', 'cancelled'];
    case 'published':
      return ['active', 'cancelled'];
    case 'active':
      return ['completed', 'cancelled'];
    case 'completed':
    case 'cancelled':
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

export interface MockEventRepositoryOptions {
  idGenerator?: IdGenerator;
  clock?: Clock;
}

export class MockEventRepository implements EventRepository {
  private events: EventDetail[];
  private applications: VolunteerApplicationItem[];
  private assignments: VolunteerAssignmentItem[];
  private idGenerator: IdGenerator;
  private clock: Clock;
  private acknowledgedOnboarding: Set<string> = new Set();

  constructor(
    initialData: EventDetail[] = createEventsFixture(),
    initialApps: VolunteerApplicationItem[] = initialVolunteerApplications,
    initialAssignments: VolunteerAssignmentItem[] = initialVolunteerAssignments,
    options?: MockEventRepositoryOptions,
  ) {
    this.events = deepClone(initialData);
    this.applications = deepClone(initialApps);
    this.assignments = deepClone(initialAssignments);
    this.idGenerator = options?.idGenerator ?? createSequentialIdGenerator(2000);
    this.clock = options?.clock ?? (() => new Date());
  }

  public reset(
    data?: EventDetail[],
    apps?: VolunteerApplicationItem[],
    assignments?: VolunteerAssignmentItem[],
    options?: MockEventRepositoryOptions,
  ): void {
    this.events = deepClone(data ?? createEventsFixture());
    this.applications = deepClone(apps ?? initialVolunteerApplications);
    this.assignments = deepClone(assignments ?? initialVolunteerAssignments);
    if (options?.idGenerator) {
      this.idGenerator = options.idGenerator;
    } else {
      this.idGenerator = createSequentialIdGenerator(2000);
    }
    if (options?.clock) {
      this.clock = options.clock;
    }
  }

  public seed(data: {
    events?: EventDetail[];
    applications?: VolunteerApplicationItem[];
    assignments?: VolunteerAssignmentItem[];
    idGenerator?: IdGenerator;
    clock?: Clock;
  }): void {
    this.reset(data.events, data.applications, data.assignments, {
      idGenerator: data.idGenerator,
      clock: data.clock,
    });
  }

  public setIdGenerator(idGenerator: IdGenerator): void {
    this.idGenerator = idGenerator;
  }

  public setClock(clock: Clock): void {
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  public async getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]> {
    let result = [...this.events];

    if (!filters) {
      return result.map(toSummary);
    }

    // 1. Search text filter (title, description, locationName)
    if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
      const q = filters.query.trim().toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter(
        e =>
          e.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.locationName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (e.landmarkText && e.landmarkText.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
      );
    }

    // 2. Charity category filter (match any of the selected codes)
    if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
      const selectedCodes = new Set(filters.charityFieldCodes);
      result = result.filter(e =>
        e.charityFields.some(code => selectedCodes.has(code)),
      );
    }

    // 3. Status filter (published or active)
    if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length > 0) {
      const statusSet = new Set(filters.statuses);
      result = result.filter(e => statusSet.has(e.status));
    }

    // 4. Meals filter
    if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.mealsProvided);
    }

    // 5. Lodging filter
    if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.lodgingProvided);
    }

    // 6. Travel support filter
    if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.travelSupportProvided);
    }

    return result.map(toSummary);
  }

  public async getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page: number = 1,
    pageSize: number = 20,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult> {
    const all = await this.getEvents(filters);
    const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
    const paginated = all.slice(start, start + pageSize);
    return {
      count: all.length,
      next: start + pageSize < all.length ? `page=${page + 1}` : null,
      previous: page > 1 ? `page=${page - 1}` : null,
      results: paginated,
    };
  }

  public async getCharityFields(): Promise<CharityCategory[]> {
    return CHARITY_CATEGORIES.map(c => ({ ...c }));
  }

  public async getEventById(id: string): Promise<EventDetail | null> {
    const found = this.events.find(e => e.id === id);
    if (!found) {
      return null;
    }
    return deepClone(found);
  }

  public async applyToPost(
    eventId: string,
    postId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
    if (!post) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Selected role/post not found',
      };
    }

    if (post.status === 'closed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'This post is closed for applications',
      };
    }

    if (event.userApplication && event.userApplication.postId === postId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'You have already applied to this role',
      };
    }

    const newApplication: EventApplicationState = {
      id: this.idGenerator('app-demo'),
      eventId,
      postId,
      postTitle: post.title,
      status: 'pending',
      appliedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
      volunteerNote: note,
    };

    // Update local mock state
    event.userApplication = newApplication;
    if (post.remainingCapacity > 0) {
      post.filledHeadcount += 1;
      post.remainingCapacity = Math.max(
        0,
        post.requiredHeadcount - post.filledHeadcount,
      );
      if (post.remainingCapacity === 0) {
        post.status = 'full';
      }
    }
    event.spotsRemaining = Math.max(0, event.spotsRemaining - 1);

    // Also record in the volunteer's submitted applications list
    this.applications.unshift({
      id: newApplication.id,
      eventId: newApplication.eventId,
      eventTitle: event.title,
      postId: newApplication.postId,
      postTitle: newApplication.postTitle,
      status: newApplication.status,
      appliedAt: newApplication.appliedAt,
      volunteerNote: newApplication.volunteerNote,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      application: newApplication,
    };
  }

  public async getUserApplications(): Promise<VolunteerApplicationItem[]> {
    return deepClone(this.applications);
  }

  public async withdrawApplication(
    applicationId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application not found' };
    }
    if (app.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application is already withdrawn' };
    }

    app.status = 'withdrawn';

    // Synchronize event.userApplication if matching
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.userApplication && event.userApplication.id === applicationId) {
      event.userApplication.status = 'withdrawn';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Application withdrawn locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async acceptInvite(
    applicationId: string,
    _note?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; applicationId: string }> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application not found', applicationId };
    }
    app.status = 'accepted';
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Invitation accepted successfully (Demo only)',
      applicationId,
    };
  }

  public async rejectInvite(
    applicationId: string,
    _note?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; applicationId: string }> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application not found', applicationId };
    }
    app.status = 'withdrawn';
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Invitation declined successfully (Demo only)',
      applicationId,
    };
  }

  public async getUserAssignments(): Promise<VolunteerAssignmentItem[]> {
    return deepClone(this.assignments);
  }

  public async confirmAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asgn) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Assignment not found' };
    }

    if (asgn.status !== 'assigned') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Cannot confirm an assignment with status '${asgn.status}'.`,
      };
    }

    asgn.status = 'confirmed';

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Assignment confirmed locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asgn) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Assignment not found' };
    }

    // Completed participation cannot be cancelled per business rules
    if (asgn.status === 'completed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Completed participation cannot be cancelled.',
      };
    }

    if (asgn.status === 'cancelled') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Assignment is already cancelled',
      };
    }

    asgn.status = 'cancelled';

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Participation cancelled locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async getEventOnboarding(eventId: string): Promise<{
    eventId: string;
    onboardingText: string | null;
    onboardingVersion: number;
    requireOnboardingAck: boolean;
    acknowledged: boolean;
  }> {
    const ev = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    return {
      eventId,
      onboardingText:
        ev?.onboardingText ??
        'Please review the event mission, safety instructions, and gear requirements before reporting for your shift.',
      onboardingVersion: 1,
      requireOnboardingAck: true,
      acknowledged: this.acknowledgedOnboarding.has(eventId),
    };
  }

  public async acknowledgeOnboarding(
    eventId: string,
    _notes?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; acknowledged: boolean }> {
    this.acknowledgedOnboarding.add(eventId);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Onboarding acknowledged locally (Demo only)',
      acknowledged: true,
    };
  }

  public async submitGeoCheckIn(
    eventId: string,
    _latitude: number,
    _longitude: number,
    _accuracyM?: number,
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    message: string;
    result?: string;
    distanceM?: number;
    confirmationStatus?: string;
    attendanceId?: string;
  }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(
      a => a.eventId === eventId && (a.status === 'confirmed' || a.status === 'assigned'),
    );
    if (asgn) {
      asgn.attendanceStatus = 'checked_in';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Geo check-in verified successfully within event geofence.',
      result: 'accepted',
      distanceM: 32,
      confirmationStatus: 'confirmed',
      attendanceId: 'att-mock-geo-01',
    };
  }

  public async redeemQrToken(token: string): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    message: string;
    result?: string;
    eventId?: string;
    attendanceId?: string;
    applicationId?: string;
  }> {
    if (!token || !token.trim()) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid or empty QR token provided.',
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'QR code verified. Shift check-in completed.',
      result: 'checked_in',
      eventId: 'evt-101',
      attendanceId: 'att-mock-qr-01',
    };
  }

  public async checkOutAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; checkedOutAt?: string }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === attendanceId || a.attendanceStatus === 'checked_in');
    if (asgn) {
      asgn.status = 'completed';
      asgn.attendanceStatus = 'completed';
      asgn.verifiedHours = 4.0;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Checked out of volunteer shift successfully.',
      checkedOutAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  public async submitEventFeedback(
    _eventId: string,
    score: number,
    _comment?: string,
    _tags?: string[],
    _direction?:
      | 'coordinator_to_volunteer'
      | 'volunteer_to_event'
      | 'volunteer_to_coordinator',
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; feedbackId?: string }> {
    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Thank you for rating your shift (${score}/5 stars)! Feedback recorded.`,
      feedbackId: this.idGenerator('fb'),
    };
  }

  public async resolveQrToken(token: string): Promise<QrResolveResult> {
    if (!token || !token.trim()) {
      return {
        eventId: '',
        purpose: '',
        isValid: false,
        reason: 'Invalid or empty QR token provided.',
      };
    }
    return {
      eventId: 'evt-101',
      purpose: 'checkin',
      isValid: true,
      reason: null,
    };
  }

  public async qrCheckIn(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult> {
    return this.redeemQrToken(token);
  }

  public async getEventFeedbackList(
    _eventId: string,
  ): Promise<EventFeedbackItem[]> {
    return [
      {
        id: 'fb-101',
        score: 5,
        comment: 'Great community project and well organized!',
        tags: ['supportive', 'organized'],
        createdAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
      },
    ];
  }
}

function toSummary(event: EventDetail): EventSummary {
  return {
    id: event.id,
    title: event.title,
    description: event.description,
    purposeType: event.purposeType,
    status: event.status,
    locationName: event.locationName,
    landmarkText: event.landmarkText,
    startAt: event.startAt,
    endAt: event.endAt,
    applicationDeadline: event.applicationDeadline,
    charityFields: [...event.charityFields],
    coordinatorName: event.coordinatorName,
    spotsRemaining: event.spotsRemaining,
    mealsProvided: event.mealsProvided,
    lodgingProvided: event.lodgingProvided,
    travelSupportProvided: event.travelSupportProvided,
    compensationKind: event.compensationKind,
  };
}

  | 'waitlisted'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'withdrawn'
  | 'expired';

/**
 * @format
 * Feature-facing Coordinator Use Cases (C-01 through C-39).
 * Exposes strongly-typed domain actions decoupled from HTTP transports and raw DTO shapes.
 */

import type {
  CoordinatorOperationResult,
  CoordinatorRepository,
  ProfileRepository,
} from '../../data/contracts';
import type {
  CoordinatorApplicationItem,
  CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  CoordinatorAssignmentItem,
  CoordinatorAttendanceItem,
  CoordinatorEventDetail,
  CoordinatorEventSummary,
  CoordinatorHistoryItem,
  CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
  CreateEventWizardDraft,
  EventPost,
  EventPostCapacity,
  GeoAttemptReview,
  VolunteerUuidLookup,
} from '../models';

export interface CoordinatorUseCasesDeps {
  coordinatorRepository: CoordinatorRepository;
  profileRepository?: ProfileRepository;
}

export class CoordinatorUseCases {
  private coordinatorRepo: CoordinatorRepository;
  private profileRepo?: ProfileRepository;

  constructor(deps: CoordinatorUseCasesDeps) {
    this.coordinatorRepo = deps.coordinatorRepository;
    this.profileRepo = deps.profileRepository;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Coordinator Status & Eligibility (C-01 .. C-03)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * C-01: Reads own coordinator status and eligibility criteria.
   */
  public async getCoordinatorStatus(): Promise<{
    isVerified: boolean;
    completedEvents: number;
    ratingAverage: number | null;
  }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      const eligibility = await this.profileRepo.getCoordinatorEligibility();
      return {
        isVerified: eligibility.isVerified,
        completedEvents: eligibility.completedAttendanceEventsCount,
        ratingAverage: eligibility.ratingAverage,
      };
    }
    return {
      isVerified: true,
      completedEvents: 5,
      ratingAverage: 4.8,
    };
  }

  /**
   * C-02: Submits an application to become an approved event coordinator.
   */
  public async submitCoordinatorApplication(
    note: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      return this.profileRepo.submitCoordinatorApplication(note);
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application submitted successfully',
    };
  }

  /**
   * C-03: Updates notes on a pending coordinator application.
   */
  public async updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(
    notes: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      return this.profileRepo.updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(notes);
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application notes updated',
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. Managed Events & Lifecycle Transitions (C-04 .. C-06, C-11 .. C-15)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Fetches high-level metrics for the coordinator overview dashboard.
   */
  public async getOverviewMetrics(): Promise<CoordinatorOverviewMetrics> {
    return this.coordinatorRepo.getOverviewMetrics();
  }

  /**
   * C-04: Lists all events owned or coordinated by the user.
   */
  public async getMyEvents(): Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]> {
    return this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents();
  }

  /**
   * C-05: Fetches full coordinator details for an event by ID.
   */
  public async getEventDetail(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorEventDetail | null> {
    return this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId);
  }

  /**
   * C-06: Creates a new draft event using validated wizard draft data.
   */
  public async createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.createDraftEvent(draft);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents();
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-11: Updates existing event metadata/onboarding text.
   */
  public async updateEventMetadata(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.updateEvent(eventId, data);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-12: Publishes an event with open-post preflight verification.
   * Enforces: at least 1 open post with headcount > 0 exists before transition.
   */
  public async publishEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const detail = await this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId);
    const posts = detail?.posts || [];
    const openPostsCount = posts.filter(
      p => p.status === 'open' && p.requiredHeadcount > 0,
    ).length;

    if (openPostsCount === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Cannot publish event: at least one open role with required headcount is required before publication.',
      };
    }

    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'published',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-13: Activates a published event.
   */
  public async activateEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'active',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-14: Completes an active event.
   */
  public async completeEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'completed',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-15: Cancels an event and initiates cascade reconciliation.
   */
  public async cancelEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'cancelled',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. Event Post / Role Management (C-07 .. C-10, C-28)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * C-07: Reads event posts/roles.
   */
  public async getEventPosts(eventId: string): Promise<EventPost[]> {
    const detail = await this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId);
    return detail?.posts || [];
  }

  /**
   * C-08: Creates a new post for an event with capacity reconciliation.
   */
  public async createEventPost(
    eventId: string,
    post: {
      title: string;
      requiredHeadcount: number;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
      leaderNeeded?: boolean;
      newVolunteersAllowed?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.createEventPost(eventId, post);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getPostCapacity(eventId),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-09: Updates an existing post with capacity reconciliation.
   */
  public async updateEventPost(
    postId: string,
    eventId: string,
    updates: {
      requiredHeadcount?: number;
      status?: string;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.updateEventPost(postId, updates);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getPostCapacity(eventId),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-10: Closes an event post to stop accepting new applications.
   */
  public async closeEventPost(
    postId: string,
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<void>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.closeEventPost(postId);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getPostCapacity(eventId),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-28: Fetches post capacity breakdown for an event (P1-05).
   */
  public async getPostCapacity(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<EventPostCapacity[]> {
    return this.coordinatorRepo.getPostCapacity(eventId);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. Coordinator Handover & Audit History (C-16 .. C-18)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * C-16: Hands over event coordination to another approved coordinator.
   */
  public async handoverEvent(
    eventId: string,

  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.handoverEvent(

    );

  public async retakeEvent(

  public async getCoordinatorHistory(

  public async acceptApplication(

  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.updateApplicationStatus(
      applicationId,
      'accepted',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getApplications(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getUnassignedApplications(eventId),
        eventId ? this.coordinatorRepo.getPostCapacity(eventId) : Promise.resolve([]),
      ]);
    }

  }

    );
    if (result.success) {
      await this.coordinatorRepo.getApplications(eventId);

  public async waitlistApplication(

  /**
   * C-31: Manually marks an eligible volunteer as checked-in on-site (C-34 / ATT-02).
   * Supports explicit { eventId, volunteerUserId, note? }, (eventId, volunteerUserId, note?),
   * or legacy attendanceId lookup.
   */
  public async manualCheckIn(
    params: { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    eventId: string | number,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    attendanceId: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>>;
  public async manualCheckIn(
    arg1: string | number | { eventId: string | number; volunteerUserId: string | number; note?: string },
    arg2?: string | number,
    arg3?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    let result: CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>;
    let targetEventId: string | undefined;

    if (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null && 'eventId' in arg1) {
      targetEventId = String(arg1.eventId);
      result = await this.coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn(arg1);
    } else if (arg2 !== undefined && typeof arg2 === 'number') {
      targetEventId = String(arg1);
      result = await this.coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn(arg1, arg2, arg3);
    } else {
      targetEventId = arg2 !== undefined ? String(arg2) : undefined;
      result = await this.coordinatorRepo.manualCheckIn(String(arg1));
    }

    if (result.success && (targetEventId || result.data?.eventId)) {
      await this.coordinatorRepo.getAttendanceRoster(targetEventId || result.data?.eventId);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**

  public async createQrToken(

    ttlMinutes?: number,

      ttlMinutes,

  }

  public async getGeoAttempts(eventId: string): Promise<GeoAttemptReview[]> {

  }

  /**
   * C-36: Confirms a pending geo check-in attempt with roster reconciliation.
   */
  public async confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.confirmGeoAttendance(attendanceId);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getPendingGeoConfirmations(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getAttendanceRoster(eventId),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-37: Rejects a pending geo check-in attempt.
   */
  public async rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.rejectGeoAttendance(attendanceId);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.coordinatorRepo.getPendingGeoConfirmations(eventId);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. Coordinator Feedback (C-38, C-39)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * C-38: Submits coordinator feedback for a volunteer's shift participation.
   */
  public async submitCoordinatorToVolunteerFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    return this.coordinatorRepo.submitCoordinatorFeedback(
      eventId,
      volunteerUserId,
      score,
      comment,
      tags,
    );
  }

  /**
   * C-39: Reads received coordinator feedback metrics (P1-04).
   * Removes hard-coded 4.9 invented metrics; returns source-backed data or empty/unavailable state.
   */
  public async getCoordinatorFeedbackSummary(
    _userId?: string,
  ): Promise<{ avgRating: number | null; totalRatings: number }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      const feedback = await this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback();
      return {
        avgRating: feedback.receivedSummary.coordinatorAvgRating,
        totalRatings: feedback.receivedSummary.coordinatorRatingCount,
      };
    }
    return {
      avgRating: null,
      totalRatings: 0,
    };
  }
}

export function createCoordinatorUseCases(
  deps: CoordinatorUseCasesDeps,
): CoordinatorUseCases {
  return new CoordinatorUseCases(deps);
}

export interface VolunteerUseCasesDeps {
  profileRepository: ProfileRepository;

export interface PaginationContinuation {
  filters?: EventFilters;

export class VolunteerUseCases {
  private profileRepo: ProfileRepository;
  private eventRepo: EventRepository;
  private dashboardRepo?: IDashboardRepository;
  private locProvider: LocationProvider;
  private authClient: typeof authApi;
  private session: SessionManager;

  constructor(deps: VolunteerUseCasesDeps) {
    this.profileRepo = deps.profileRepository;
    this.eventRepo = deps.eventRepository;
    this.dashboardRepo = deps.dashboardRepository;
    this.locProvider = deps.locationProvider ?? defaultLocationProvider;
    this.authClient = deps.authClient ?? authApi;
    this.session = deps.session ?? sessionManager;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Authentication & Session Lifecycle (V-01 .. V-03)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * V-01: Requests an OTP code for phone login or QR registration.
   */
  public async requestOtp(
    phone: string,
    purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    status: string;
    delivery?: OtpDeliveryDto;
    devCode?: string;
    message?: string;
  }> {
    const res = await this.authClient.requestOtp({ phone, purpose });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'failed',
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      status: res.data.status,
      delivery: res.data.delivery,
      devCode: res.data.dev_code,
    };
  }

  /**
   * V-02: Verifies an OTP code, issues session token, and establishes authenticated identity.
   */
  public async verifyOtp(
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
    purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    token?: string;
    user?: {
      id: number;
      uuid: string | null;
      displayName: string;
      verificationStatus: string;
    };
    message?: string;
  }> {
    const res = await this.authClient.verifyOtp({
      phone,
      code,
      purpose,
      display_name: displayName,
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    await this.session.setToken(res.data.token);
    return {
      success: true,
      token: res.data.token,
      user: {
        id: res.data.user.id,
        uuid: res.data.user.uuid,
        displayName: res.data.user.display_name,
        verificationStatus: res.data.user.verification_status,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * V-03: Logs out the current session and clears persisted tokens.
   */
  public async logout(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.authClient.logout();
    } catch {
      // Best-effort remote revocation
    } finally {
      await this.session.logout();
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. Profile, Charity Interests & Public Identity (V-04 .. V-06, V-18)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * V-04: Reads the volunteer's own complete profile.

  public async getProfile(): Promise<VolunteerProfile> {

  public async updateProfile(

  public async getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]> {

  /**
   * V-20: Discovers public events with paginated slicing and continuation support.
   */
  public async getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page: number = 1,
    pageSize: number = 10,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult> {
    return this.eventRepo.getEventsPage(filters, page, pageSize);
  }

  /**
   * V-20: Helper for paginated continuation loading.
   */
  public async loadNextPage(
    current: PaginationContinuation,
  ): Promise<PaginationContinuation> {
    if (!current.hasMore) {
      return current;
    }
    const nextPage = current.currentPage + 1;
    const pageResult = await this.eventRepo.getEventsPage(
      current.filters,
      nextPage,
      current.pageSize,
    );
    return {
      filters: current.filters,
      currentPage: nextPage,
      pageSize: current.pageSize,
      hasMore: pageResult.next !== null,
      totalCount: pageResult.count,
      items: [...current.items, ...pageResult.results],
    };
  }

  /**
   * V-21 / V-22: Fetches full details for an event including open roles, requirements, and capacity.
   */
  public async getEventDetail(eventId: string): Promise<EventDetail | null> {
    return this.eventRepo.getEventById(eventId);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. Applications & Shift Participation (V-23 .. V-30)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * V-23: Submits an application for an event post with automatic state reconciliation.
   */
  public async applyToPost(
    eventId: string,
    postId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.applyToPost(eventId, postId, note);
    // State reconciliation: refresh own applications and event detail cache
    await Promise.allSettled([
      this.eventRepo.getUserApplications(),
      this.eventRepo.getEventById(eventId),
    ]);
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-24: Joins an event via an invite (P1-06 / INV-01).
   * Checks for an existing pending invite application first so coordinator-invite ->
   * volunteer-response -> coordinator-view round trip works cleanly.
   */
  public async joinThroughInvite(
    eventIdOrApplicationId: string,
    postId?: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult> {
    const apps = await this.eventRepo.getUserApplications();
    const existingInvite = apps.find(
      a =>
        (a.id === eventIdOrApplicationId || a.eventId === eventIdOrApplicationId) &&
        a.source === 'invite' &&
        a.status === 'pending',
    );

    if (existingInvite) {
      const res = await this.eventRepo.acceptInvite(
        existingInvite.id,
        note ?? 'Accepted coordinator invitation',
      );
      if (res.success) {
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'Invitation accepted successfully',
          application: {
            id: existingInvite.id,
            eventId: existingInvite.eventId,
            postId: existingInvite.postId || postId || '',
            postTitle: existingInvite.postTitle || 'Invited Role',
            status: 'accepted',
            appliedAt: existingInvite.appliedAt,
            volunteerNote: note ?? 'Accepted coordinator invitation',
          },
        };
      }
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.message,
      };
    }

    return this.applyToPost(
      eventIdOrApplicationId,
      postId ?? '',
      note ?? 'Accepted coordinator invitation',
    );
  }

  /**
   * Responds to an invitation directly with accept/reject (P1-06 / INV-01).
   */
  public async respondToInvite(
    applicationId: string,
    accept: boolean,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; applicationId: string }> {
    if (accept) {
      return this.eventRepo.acceptInvite(applicationId, note);
    }
    return this.eventRepo.rejectInvite(applicationId, note);
  }

  /**
   * V-25: Joins an event through QR walk-in registration.
   */
  public async joinThroughQrWalkIn(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult> {
    const res = await this.eventRepo.redeemQrToken(token);
    if (res.success && res.eventId) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.eventRepo.getUserApplications(),
        this.eventRepo.getEventById(res.eventId),
      ]);
    }
    return res;
  }

  /**

   */
  public async getUserApplications(): Promise<VolunteerApplicationItem[]> {
    return this.eventRepo.getUserApplications();
  }

  /**
   * V-27: Withdraws a pending or waitlisted application with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async withdrawApplication(
    applicationId: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.withdrawApplication(applicationId);
    if (result.success) {
      const tasks: Promise<any>[] = [this.eventRepo.getUserApplications()];
      if (eventId) {
        tasks.push(this.eventRepo.getEventById(eventId));
      }
      await Promise.allSettled(tasks);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-28: Reads all assigned, confirmed, and completed shifts for the volunteer.
   */
  public async getUserAssignments(): Promise<VolunteerAssignmentItem[]> {
    return this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
  }

  /**
   * V-29: Confirms participation in an assigned shift with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async confirmAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.confirmAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-30: Cancels participation in a scheduled shift with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.cancelAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. Onboarding, QR & Geo Check-in (V-31 .. V-38)

  public async acknowledgeOnboarding(

  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; acknowledged: boolean }> {
    return this.eventRepo.acknowledgeOnboarding(eventId, notes);
  }

  /**
   * V-33: Previews/resolves a QR token without consuming a redemption use.
   */
  public async resolveQrToken(token: string): Promise<QrResolveResult> {
    return this.eventRepo.resolveQrToken(token);
  }

  /**
   * V-34: Redeems a general-purpose QR token.
   */
  public async redeemQrToken(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult> {
    return this.eventRepo.redeemQrToken(token);
  }

  /**
   * V-35: Checks in to an assigned shift using a QR token.
   */
  public async qrCheckIn(token: string): Promise<QrRedeemResult> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.qrCheckIn(token);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-36: Submits geo check-in using device GPS via LocationProvider.
   * Fails fast if location permission is denied or device hardware is unavailable.
   */
  public async submitGeoCheckIn(
    eventId: string,
    customCoordinates?: {
      latitude: number;
      longitude: number;
      accuracyM?: number;
    },
  ): Promise<GeoCheckInResult> {
    let fix: LocationFix;

    if (customCoordinates) {
      fix = {
        latitude: customCoordinates.latitude,
        longitude: customCoordinates.longitude,
        accuracyM: customCoordinates.accuracyM ?? null,
        capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        isMocked: false,
      };
    } else {
      const perm = await this.locProvider.requestPermission();
      if (perm === 'denied') {
        throw new Error('Location permission denied. Cannot capture device GPS telemetry.');
      }
      if (perm === 'unavailable') {
        throw new Error('Device location services are unavailable.');
      }
      fix = await this.locProvider.getCurrentPosition();
    }

    const result = await this.eventRepo.submitGeoCheckIn(
      eventId,
      fix.latitude,
      fix.longitude,
      fix.accuracyM ?? undefined,
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-37: Checks out of an active attendance shift with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async checkOutAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; checkedOutAt?: string }> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.checkOutAttendance(attendanceId);
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

    return this.profileRepo.getAttendanceHistory();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. Direction-Safe Feedback & Dashboard Summary (V-39 .. V-43)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * V-39: Submits feedback about an event.
   */
  public async submitVolunteerToEventFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; feedbackId?: string }> {
    return this.eventRepo.submitEventFeedback(
      eventId,
      score,
      comment,
      tags,
      'volunteer_to_event',
    );
  }

  /**
   * V-40: Submits direction-safe feedback about an event coordinator.
   */
  public async submitVolunteerToCoordinatorFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; feedbackId?: string }> {
    return this.eventRepo.submitEventFeedback(
      eventId,
      score,
      comment,
      tags,
      'volunteer_to_coordinator',
    );
  }

  /**
   * V-39: Reads public feedback ratings and reviews for an event.
   */
  public async getEventFeedbackList(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<EventFeedbackItem[]> {
    return this.eventRepo.getEventFeedbackList(eventId);
  }

  /**
   * V-41 / V-42: Reads authored reviews and received aggregate feedback metrics.
   */
  public async getMyFeedback(): Promise<MyFeedbackResponse> {
    return this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback();
  }

  /**
   * V-43: Composes high-level dashboard metrics for the volunteer home screen.
   */
  public async getDashboardSummary(): Promise<DashboardSummary> {
    if (this.dashboardRepo) {
      return this.dashboardRepo.getDashboardSummary();
    }
    // Fallback composition using eventRepo + profileRepo
    const [assignments, history, feedback] = await Promise.all([
      this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments(),
      this.profileRepo.getAttendanceHistory(),
      this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback(),
    ]);

    const upcoming = assignments
      .filter((a): a is VolunteerAssignmentItem & { status: 'confirmed' | 'assigned' } =>
        a.status === 'assigned' || a.status === 'confirmed',
      )
      .map(a => ({
        id: a.id,
        eventId: a.eventId,
        eventTitle: a.eventTitle,
        roleName: a.postTitle,
        startAt: a.startAt,
        endAt: a.endAt,
        location: a.location,
        status: a.status,
      }));

    const recent = history.slice(0, 5).map(h => ({
      id: h.id,
      eventId: h.eventId,
      eventTitle: h.eventTitle || 'Event',
      roleName: h.postTitle || 'Volunteer Role',
      completedAt: h.checkoutAt ?? h.checkinAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      attendanceStatus: 'completed' as const,
      verifiedHours: h.verifiedHours ?? 0,
      location: h.locationName || 'Location',
      attendanceVerifiedAt: h.checkoutAt ?? h.checkinAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    }));

    return {
      completedShiftCount: history.length,
      completedEventCount: new Set(history.map(h => h.eventId)).size,
      upcomingCommitmentCount: upcoming.length,
      ratingAverage: feedback.receivedSummary.overallAvgRating ?? 5.0,
      ratingCount: feedback.receivedSummary.totalCount,
      upcomingCommitments: upcoming,
      recentCompletedActivities: recent,
    };
  }
}

export function createVolunteerUseCases(
  deps: VolunteerUseCasesDeps,
): VolunteerUseCases {
  return new VolunteerUseCases(deps);
}

      <ThemeProvider initialMode="light">{ui}</ThemeProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}

function safeStringify(obj: unknown): string {
  const seen = new WeakSet();
  return JSON.stringify(obj, (key, value) => {
    if (key === '_owner') return undefined;
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
      if (seen.has(value)) return undefined;
      seen.add(value);
    }
    return value;
  });
}

    goBack: jest.fn(),
    isFocused: jest.fn(() => true),
    canGoBack: jest.fn(() => true),
    getParent: jest.fn(),
    getState: jest.fn(),
    addListener: jest.fn(() => () => {}),
    removeListener: jest.fn(),
    setParams: jest.fn(),
    setOptions: jest.fn(),
  } as any;
}

    it('renders Step 1 with phone input, optional display name, and send code button', async () => {
      await act(async () => {
        root = ReactTestRenderer.create(
          renderWithTheme(<OtpLoginScreen />),
        );
      });

      const rootInstance = root!.root;
      const inputs = rootInstance.findAllByType(AppInput);
      expect(inputs.length).toBe(2);
